plain.zh: Amazon 的雲端服務，全球最大的「電腦出租」平台，也自己設計 AI 晶片。
plain.en: Amazon's cloud — the world's biggest place to rent computers — which also designs its own AI chips.

nvidiaBond.zh: AWS 長年把 NVIDIA GPU 放進雲端出租；2023 年宣布替 NVIDIA 研究團隊打造 AI 超級電腦 Project Ceiba，2024 年升級為 Blackwell 世代。後來也宣布支援 NVLink Fusion。2026 年它是 OpenShell 的夥伴。
nvidiaBond.en: AWS has long rented NVIDIA GPUs. In 2023 it announced Project Ceiba, an AI supercomputer for NVIDIA's own researchers, upgraded to Blackwell in 2024, and later adopted NVLink Fusion. In 2026 it joined OpenShell.

impact.zh: 讓全世界的企業不用買機器就能用 AI；它自研晶片，也讓 AI 晶片市場不只有 NVIDIA 一個選擇。
impact.en: Lets businesses everywhere use AI without buying hardware, and its in-house chips mean NVIDIA isn't the only option in AI silicon.

dialogue.zh: 施主要多少內力？本寺隨時供應。
dialogue.en: How much inner power do you seek? The temple always provides.

details.zh: AWS 把電腦、儲存空間、資料庫等「按用量計費」出租，讓公司不用自己買機器。AI 時代它一方面大量採購 NVIDIA GPU 出租，另一方面自己設計 Trainium 晶片，用來降低成本，是 NVIDIA 的大客戶，也是潛在對手。
details.en: AWS rents computing, storage and databases by usage so companies don't need their own hardware. In the AI era it both buys NVIDIA GPUs at scale and designs its own Trainium chips to cut costs — a top NVIDIA customer and a potential rival.

title.zh: GPU vs. 自研晶片（ASIC）

body.zh: GPU 是「萬用型」：什麼 AI 模型都能跑，軟體生態（CUDA）最完整。ASIC 是「專用型」：只為特定工作設計，像 AWS 的 Trainium3（3 奈米製程，一台 UltraServer 可裝 144 顆）。專用晶片可能更省錢、省電，但彈性和軟體支援較少。所以大雲端業者通常兩種都用；AWS 的下一代 Trainium4 甚至會支援 NVIDIA 的 NVLink Fusion 連線技術。
body.en: GPUs are general-purpose: they run any AI model and have the richest software (CUDA). ASICs are specialists built for one job, like AWS's 3nm Trainium3 (144 chips per UltraServer). Specialists can be cheaper and more efficient but less flexible. So big clouds use both — and AWS's next Trainium4 will even support NVIDIA's NVLink Fusion interconnect.

title.zh: 雲端大廠的軍備競賽

body.zh: Amazon 2026 年資本支出上看 2,200 億美元，自由現金流甚至轉負。大雲端公司寧可先燒錢蓋機房，也不願在 AI 競賽中缺貨；這筆錢很大一部分最後流向 NVIDIA、記憶體廠和台灣的伺服器代工廠。
body.en: Amazon expects up to US$220B of 2026 capex, even turning free cash flow negative. Hyperscalers would rather overbuild than run short in the AI race — and much of that money flows to NVIDIA, memory makers and Taiwan's server builders.

title.zh: 4,960 億美元的訂單能見度

body.zh: AWS 未完成訂單近 5,000 億美元。執行長 Jassy 在 2026 年 7 月財報會議表示，2027 年新增產能大多已被預訂。這讓上游供應鏈（包括 NVIDIA 和鴻海、廣達）對未來兩年的需求更有把握。
body.en: AWS backlog is nearly US$500B, and CEO Andy Jassy said on the July 2026 call that new 2027 capacity is largely reserved — giving suppliers like NVIDIA, Foxconn and Quanta more confidence in demand for the next two years.

title.zh: 一邊買 GPU，一邊做自己的晶片
title.en: Buying GPUs while building its own

body.zh: AWS 是 NVIDIA 的大客戶，也用 Trainium 訓練 Anthropic 的模型。自研晶片讓它有議價籌碼，但下一代 Trainium4 也要支援 NVIDIA 的 NVLink Fusion，顯示「競爭中合作」才是常態。
body.en: AWS is a top NVIDIA customer yet trains Anthropic's models on Trainium. Its own chips give it leverage, but Trainium4 will support NVIDIA NVLink Fusion — co-opetition is the norm.

title.zh: 產能不夠，訂單先排隊
title.en: Not enough capacity, so orders queue

body.zh: Amazon 執行長 Jassy 表示，2026 年產能仍無法滿足所有需求。雲端大廠的瓶頸已經不是「有沒有客戶」，而是電力、機房與晶片能多快到位。
body.en: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says 2026 capacity still won't meet all demand — the hyperscaler bottleneck is no longer customers but how fast power, buildings and chips arrive.

plain.zh: Google 的雲端服務，出租運算與 AI 服務，同時擁有自家 TPU 晶片和大量 NVIDIA GPU。
plain.en: Google's cloud: it rents compute and AI services, offering both its own TPU chips and vast fleets of NVIDIA GPUs.

nvidiaBond.zh: Google Cloud 提供從 Blackwell（A4、A4X）到 Vera Rubin（A5X）的 NVIDIA 系統；2026 年 4 月宣布 A5X 多站點叢集最多可擴充到 96 萬顆 Rubin GPU，並預覽在 NVIDIA Blackwell 上於客戶機房執行 Gemini。它也是 NVIDIA OpenShell 夥伴。
nvidiaBond.en: Google Cloud offers NVIDIA systems from Blackwell (A4, A4X) to Vera Rubin (A5X); in April 2026 it said A5X multisite clusters can scale to 960,000 Rubin GPUs and previewed Gemini running on-premises on NVIDIA Blackwell. It is also an OpenShell partner.

impact.zh: Google 同時是 NVIDIA 的大客戶和最強的自研晶片對手。TPU 能賣給 Anthropic 等外部客戶，代表 AI 晶片市場出現了 NVIDIA 以外的真正選項。
impact.en: Google is both a top NVIDIA customer and its strongest custom-chip rival. Selling TPUs to outsiders like Anthropic shows a real alternative to NVIDIA has emerged.

dialogue.zh: 要 GPU 還是 TPU？兩把刀都在這裡。
dialogue.en: GPU or TPU? Both blades are right here.

details.zh: Google Cloud 是全球第三大雲端，成長速度近年最快。它的特別之處是「兩把刀」：一邊出租 NVIDIA GPU，一邊推自家 TPU 晶片。Anthropic 承諾使用最多 100 萬顆 TPU，OpenAI 也把 Google Cloud 列為雲端供應商之一。母公司 Alphabet 第二季資本支出約 449 億美元，單季自由現金流轉負。
details.en: Google Cloud is the world's #3 cloud and among the fastest growing. Its edge is two blades: it rents NVIDIA GPUs and sells its own TPUs. Anthropic committed to up to one million TPUs, and OpenAI counts Google Cloud among its cloud providers. Parent Alphabet spent ~US$44.9B on capex in Q2, turning quarterly free cash flow negative.

title.zh: 為什麼 TPU 要分成「訓練用」和「推論用」兩顆？
title.en: Why split TPUs into training and inference chips?

body.zh: 2026 年 Google 發表第八代 TPU，第一次拆成兩顆：TPU 8t 專門訓練，追求超大規模一起算；TPU 8i 專門推論，追求每一元能回答更多問題，記憶體也更大。原因是 AI Agent 時代，模型每天被呼叫的次數暴增，推論成本變成最大開銷，值得為它特別設計晶片。
body.en: In 2026 Google's eighth-gen TPUs split for the first time: TPU 8t for training at massive scale, TPU 8i for inference — more answers per dollar and more memory. In the agent era, models are called so often that inference becomes the biggest bill, so it earns a chip of its own.

body.zh: Google 是少數能自己設計、量產 AI 晶片並對外出租的公司。Anthropic 承諾使用最多 100 萬顆 TPU，證明 TPU 不只自用。這是 NVIDIA 長期最值得關注的競爭來源。
body.en: Google is one of the few companies that designs, builds and rents its own AI chips. Anthropic's commitment to up to one million TPUs proves TPUs aren't just for in-house use — NVIDIA's most serious long-term competitor.

title.zh: 5,140 億美元訂單 vs. 負的自由現金流
title.en: US$514B backlog vs. negative free cash flow

body.zh: 雲端訂單一季增加超過 500 億美元，但為了蓋機房，Alphabet 第二季自由現金流轉為負值（報導稱近二十年來首見）。投資人每一季都在比較：訂單成長得夠不夠快，能不能撐起這麼大的投資。
body.en: Cloud backlog grew by over US$50B in a quarter, yet data-center spending pushed Alphabet's Q2 free cash flow negative (reportedly the first time in ~20 years). Every quarter investors weigh whether bookings grow fast enough to justify the spend.

title.zh: 對手也是客戶

body.zh: OpenAI 和 Anthropic 都是 Google Gemini 的競爭對手，卻也在 Google Cloud 上跑模型。雲端生意讓 Google 不管哪家 AI 模型勝出，都能收到「房租」。
body.en: OpenAI and Anthropic compete with Gemini yet both run on Google Cloud. The cloud business lets Google collect rent whichever model wins.

title.zh: TPU 從自用變成商品
title.en: TPUs go from in-house to product

body.zh: Google 過去只在自家雲端出租 TPU，2026 年開始直接賣晶片。這讓 TPU 成為 NVIDIA GPU 之外的另一個選擇，但也讓 Google 自家研究員需要排隊等算力。
body.en: Google used to only rent TPUs in its cloud; in 2026 it began selling the chips outright — a real alternative to NVIDIA GPUs, though Google's own researchers now queue for compute.

plain.zh: Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp 的母公司，從開放權重的 Llama 起步，2026 年推出閉源的 Muse 系列模型，並大舉蓋 AI 資料中心追求「超級智慧」。
plain.en: Parent of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp; it started with open-weight Llama models, launched the closed Muse model series in 2026, and is building huge AI data centers in pursuit of "superintelligence."

nvidiaBond.zh: 2026 年 2 月，Meta 與 NVIDIA 簽下多年、跨世代的合作：部署數百萬顆 Blackwell 與 Rubin GPU，並大規模單獨採用 NVIDIA Grace CPU（雲端大廠少見），網路也導入 Spectrum-X 乙太網路交換器。Meta 也是 OpenShell 夥伴。
nvidiaBond.en: In February 2026 Meta and NVIDIA signed a multiyear, multigenerational deal: millions of Blackwell and Rubin GPUs, a large standalone deployment of NVIDIA Grace CPUs (rare among hyperscalers), and Spectrum-X Ethernet switches. Meta is also an OpenShell partner.

impact.zh: Llama 讓開放權重模型成為主流選項，降低全世界使用 AI 的門檻；2026 年 Meta 轉向閉源的 Muse 模型，也顯示開放與閉源路線的取捨。Meta 的巨額採購讓它成為 NVIDIA 最重要的客戶之一。
impact.en: Llama made open-weight models a mainstream option and lowered AI's barriers worldwide; Meta's 2026 shift to closed Muse models shows the trade-off between open and closed. Its massive purchasing makes it one of NVIDIA's most important customers.

dialogue.zh: 秘笈公開，大家一起練！
dialogue.en: The scrolls are open — let's all train!

details.zh: Meta 的錢主要來自廣告，AI 讓廣告投放更精準，也撐起龐大的 AI 投資。它的 Llama 模型開放權重，讓全世界開發者免費使用。2025 年 6 月，Meta 花 143 億美元取得 Scale AI 49% 股份，並找來其執行長 Alexandr Wang 領導新成立的「超級智慧實驗室」。它也在俄亥俄州蓋 1 GW 的 Prometheus、在路易斯安那州蓋最大可達 5 GW 的 Hyperion 資料中心。
details.en: Meta earns mostly from ads; AI makes targeting sharper and funds its huge AI bets. Its Llama models are open-weight and free for developers worldwide. In June 2025 it paid US$14.3B for 49% of Scale AI and hired its CEO Alexandr Wang to lead a new Superintelligence Lab. It is building the 1 GW Prometheus cluster in Ohio and the Hyperion campus in Louisiana, scalable to 5 GW.

title.zh: AI 要用多少電？科技公司開始買核電
title.en: How much power does AI need? Big Tech goes nuclear

body.zh: Meta 的 Prometheus 叢集約 1 GW，Hyperion 未來可達 5 GW，相當於好幾座大型發電廠。電網一下子供應不了這麼多電，所以 Meta 在 2026 年 1 月和 TerraPower、Oklo、Vistra 簽下核電供應協議。AI 的競爭，已經延伸到發電廠和電網。
body.en: Meta's Prometheus cluster is about 1 GW and Hyperion could reach 5 GW — several large power plants' worth. Grids can't supply that overnight, so in January 2026 Meta signed nuclear power deals with TerraPower, Oklo and Vistra. The AI race now reaches power plants and grids.

title.zh: 從開放 Llama 到閉源 Muse
title.en: From open Llama to closed Muse

body.zh: Meta 過去把 Llama 開放出去，吸引開發者圍繞它的技術打造生態系。但 2026 年 4 月超級智慧實驗室推出的 Muse Spark 改為閉源，驅動 Meta AI，並透過 API 提供給合作夥伴。最頂尖的模型越來越貴，連最支持開源的大公司也開始把旗艦模型留在自己手上。
body.en: Meta used to open-source Llama to build a developer ecosystem. But Muse Spark, launched by its Superintelligence Labs in Apr 2026, is closed — it powers Meta AI and is offered to partners via API. As frontier models get costlier, even open source's biggest champion keeps its flagship in-house.

title.zh: 用買公司換人才

body.zh: Meta 花 143 億美元買 Scale AI 49% 股份，很大一部分是為了延攬執行長 Alexandr Wang。頂尖 AI 人才稀缺，「收購式招募」成為科技巨頭的新常態。
body.en: Meta's US$14.3B for 49% of Scale AI was largely about recruiting CEO Alexandr Wang. Top AI talent is so scarce that acqui-hiring has become routine for tech giants.

title.zh: 連 CPU 都買 NVIDIA

body.zh: 雲端大廠的一般 CPU 多半來自 Intel 或 AMD，Meta 卻大規模單獨部署 NVIDIA Grace CPU。NVIDIA 正從「賣 GPU」走向「賣整座資料中心」，CPU、網路一起包。
body.en: Hyperscalers usually buy general CPUs from Intel or AMD, but Meta is deploying NVIDIA Grace CPUs at scale on their own. NVIDIA is moving from selling GPUs to selling the whole data center — CPUs and networking included.

title.zh: 財報好，股價卻跌

body.zh: Meta 廣告生意強勁，但資本支出指引持續墊高、自由現金流大幅縮水，第二季財報後股價下跌。市場開始追問：AI 投資什麼時候能變成看得見的回報？
body.en: Meta's ad business is strong, but ever-rising capex guidance and shrinking free cash flow sent shares down after Q2. Investors increasingly ask when AI spending will show visible returns.

title.zh: 自由現金流快被資本支出吃光
title.en: Capex nearly eats free cash flow

body.zh: Meta 第二季營收年增 28%，但資本支出 311 億美元，自由現金流只剩不到 8 億。廣告本業很賺錢，可是 AI 投資幾乎把現金全部用掉，這是財報後股價下跌的原因之一。
body.en: Meta grew revenue 28%, but US$31.1B of capex left under US$0.8B of free cash flow — a highly profitable ad business is pouring almost all its cash into AI, one reason the stock fell after earnings.

nvidiaBond.en: Azure deploys NVIDIA GPUs at huge scale: its Fairwater AI data center in Wisconsin is planned around hundreds of thousands of GB200 and GB300 GPUs. In November 2025 Microsoft, NVIDIA and Anthropic formed a three-way alliance with Claude scaling on Azure's NVIDIA systems. Microsoft also builds its own Maia 200 inference chip (Jan 2026) and is an OpenShell partner.

impact.zh: 微軟把 AI 放進全世界最多人用的辦公軟體和開發工具，是 AI 從實驗走進日常工作的關鍵推手。它同時投資 OpenAI 和 Anthropic，影響力橫跨模型與雲端兩層。
impact.en: Microsoft puts AI inside the world's most-used office and developer tools, pushing AI from experiments into daily work. Backing both OpenAI and Anthropic gives it reach across models and cloud.

dialogue.zh: 模型、雲端、辦公室，三條路我都顧。
dialogue.en: Models, cloud, office — I keep all three roads.

details.en: Microsoft began investing heavily in OpenAI in 2019, making Azure the main compute behind ChatGPT. After OpenAI's October 2025 restructuring Microsoft holds about 27% (then worth ~US$135B) and OpenAI committed to buy US$250B of Azure — though Microsoft lost its right of first refusal as exclusive compute provider. In November 2025 it also invested in Anthropic, backing two top labs at once.

title.zh: 看懂「未完成訂單」：AI 需求的領先指標
title.en: Reading the backlog: a leading indicator of AI demand

body.zh: 雲端公司常和客戶簽好幾年的合約，還沒提供服務的金額就叫「未完成訂單」（微軟稱 RPO，剩餘履約義務）。它像餐廳的訂位本：還沒入帳，但代表未來的生意。2026 年三大雲的數字都很驚人：微軟 6,780 億、Google Cloud 5,140 億、AWS 4,960 億美元。這也是 NVIDIA 和伺服器廠敢擴產的底氣。
body.en: Clouds sign multi-year contracts; the unbilled portion is the backlog (Microsoft calls it RPO, remaining performance obligation). Think of a restaurant's reservation book: not revenue yet, but future business. In 2026 the big three are staggering — Microsoft US$678B, Google Cloud US$514B, AWS US$496B — giving NVIDIA and server makers the confidence to expand.

title.zh: 兩邊下注的 AI 盟主

body.zh: 微軟同時是 OpenAI 最大股東、也投資 Anthropic。即使 OpenAI 不再只用 Azure，微軟仍透過持股、分潤和雲端合約，從兩家頂尖實驗室的成長中獲利。
body.en: Microsoft is OpenAI's largest shareholder and an Anthropic investor. Even as OpenAI stops relying solely on Azure, Microsoft profits from both labs via equity, revenue share and cloud contracts.

title.zh: 自研晶片 Maia 200：主攻推論

body.zh: Maia 200 用台積電 3 奈米製程，專門跑推論，微軟宣稱每一美元效能比現有系統好約 30%。和 Google、Amazon 一樣，雲端大廠都想用自研晶片降低 AI 服務的成本。
body.en: Built on TSMC 3nm for inference, Maia 200 claims ~30% better performance per dollar than current systems. Like Google and Amazon, Microsoft wants custom chips to cut the cost of serving AI.

title.zh: 6,780 億美元的訂單支撐巨額投資
title.en: A US$678B backlog behind huge spending

body.zh: 單季資本支出超過 500 億美元聽起來驚人，但商業未完成訂單一年成長 84%，代表客戶已經簽約要用。不過扣除 OpenAI 後只成長約 25%，訂單相當集中在單一客戶。
body.en: Quarterly capex above US$50B sounds staggering, but commercial RPO grew 84%, meaning customers have signed up — though excluding OpenAI it grew only ~25%, so bookings are concentrated in one customer.

title.zh: GPU 折舊比蓋房子快

body.zh: 微軟資本支出約三分之二花在 GPU 與 CPU，這些設備只用幾年就要汰換；資料中心建築則可以用 25 年。AI 投資越偏向晶片，未來每年的折舊費用壓力就越大。
body.en: About two-thirds of Microsoft's capex goes to GPUs and CPUs that are replaced within years, while buildings last 25 — the more AI spend tilts to chips, the heavier future depreciation becomes.

impact.en: Showed a late cloud entrant can leap ahead through AI, making dedicated super-clusters for a single lab a new cloud business model.

details.zh: Oracle 以資料庫起家，雲端起步比 AWS、微軟晚，但在 AI 時代押注「替 AI 實驗室蓋超大叢集」。它和 OpenAI 合作，在德州 Abilene 的星際之門（Stargate）園區部署 Zettascale10 架構。
details.en: Oracle built its name on databases and came late to cloud, but in the AI era it bet on building giant clusters for AI labs. With OpenAI it is deploying its Zettascale10 architecture at the Stargate campus in Abilene, Texas.

title.zh: 為什麼 GPU 叢集越大，網路越重要？
title.en: Why does networking matter more as GPU clusters grow?

body.zh: 訓練大模型時，幾十萬顆 GPU 要不停交換計算結果。只要網路慢一點，所有 GPU 都得等，昂貴的算力就被浪費。所以 Oracle 的 Zettascale10 把重點放在連接數十萬顆 GPU 的網路架構上——叢集規模的極限，常常是網路，而不是晶片數量。
body.en: Training a big model means hundreds of thousands of GPUs constantly swapping results. If the network lags, every GPU waits and costly compute is wasted. That's why Oracle's Zettascale10 centers on the fabric linking hundreds of thousands of GPUs — cluster size is often limited by networking, not chip count.

title.zh: 後進者靠「專屬叢集」翻身
title.en: A latecomer reinvented by dedicated clusters

body.zh: Oracle 的雲端市占一直落後三大雲，但它願意替單一 AI 實驗室蓋超大型專屬叢集，拿下 OpenAI 等大單。這種「大客戶、長合約、超大規模」的模式，讓它在 AI 時代快速擴張，也讓營收高度依賴少數客戶。
body.en: Oracle long trailed the big three clouds, but its willingness to build giant dedicated clusters for single labs won deals like OpenAI's. The big-customer, long-contract, mega-scale model drove rapid growth — and heavy dependence on a few customers.

title.zh: 股價大起大落反映 AI 投資焦慮

body.zh: Oracle 股價 2026 年 6 月高點約 248 美元，7 月低點約 115 美元，波動很大。投資人一方面看好龐大的 AI 合約，另一方面擔心蓋機房要燒的錢、舉債與客戶集中風險。
body.en: Oracle's stock ran from about US$248 in June 2026 to about US$115 in July. Investors weigh huge AI contracts against the cash burn, debt and customer concentration of building data centers.

title.zh: 網路決定叢集上限

body.zh: Zettascale10 主打連接數十萬顆 NVIDIA GPU 的網路架構。當叢集大到這個程度，誰能讓 GPU 之間的資料傳得又快又穩，才是決勝關鍵——這也是 NVIDIA 除了 GPU 之外大力推網路產品的原因。
body.en: Zettascale10 is built around a fabric linking hundreds of thousands of NVIDIA GPUs. At that scale, moving data fast and reliably between GPUs decides the winner — one reason NVIDIA sells networking alongside GPUs.

title.zh: 讓客戶出錢買硬體
title.en: Getting customers to fund the hardware

body.zh: Oracle 財務長表示，新簽的 AI 雲端合約多半採預付或由客戶自備硬體，因此不會讓 Oracle 的資本支出一比一增加。這是因應巨額投資壓力的新做法。
body.en: Oracle's CFO says most new AI cloud contracts use prepayment or customer-supplied hardware, so capex doesn't rise one-for-one — a new answer to heavy investment pressure.

nvidiaBond.en: Colossus is built on large numbers of NVIDIA GPUs (starting with 100,000 H100s, then expanding).

impact.zh: 以極快速度蓋出超大叢集，帶動「誰能最快把 GPU 接上電」的競賽。
impact.en: Its record-speed cluster build-outs fueled the race to get GPUs powered up fastest.

dialogue.zh: 火箭加 AI，速度就是我的武器。
dialogue.en: Rockets plus AI — speed is my weapon.

details.zh: xAI 在田納西州孟菲斯蓋了超大型 GPU 叢集 Colossus，用來訓練 Grok。2026 年 2 月 SpaceX 以全股票交易收購 xAI，同年 7 月更名 SpaceXAI，8 月再完成收購 Cursor。投影片同時把它放在 CSPs 和 AI Labs，代表它既有自己的超大算力，也自己訓練前沿模型。
details.en: xAI built Colossus, a giant GPU cluster in Memphis, to train Grok. SpaceX acquired xAI in an all-stock deal in Feb 2026, rebranded it SpaceXAI in July, and closed its Cursor acquisition in August. The slide lists it under both CSPs and AI Labs — it owns massive compute and trains frontier models.

title.zh: 「H100 等效 GPU」是什麼單位？

body.zh: 不同世代的 GPU 速度差很多，直接數「幾顆」會失真。業界常把算力換算成「相當於幾顆 NVIDIA H100」，方便比較。例如一顆新世代晶片可能等於好幾顆 H100，所以「100 萬顆 H100 等效」不一定真的有 100 萬顆實體晶片。
body.en: GPU generations differ greatly in speed, so raw counts mislead. The industry often converts compute into "how many NVIDIA H100s" for comparison. A newer chip may equal several H100s, so "1 million H100-equivalents" may not mean a million physical chips.

title.zh: 以速度著稱的叢集建設

body.zh: Colossus 以極快速度建成並擴充到百萬顆 H100 等效 GPU。在 AI 競賽中，「多快把 GPU 接上電」本身就是競爭力。
body.en: Colossus was built and scaled to a million H100-equivalents at record speed — in the AI race, how fast you power up GPUs is itself an advantage.

title.zh: 從獨立實驗室到大集團的一部分
title.en: From independent lab to conglomerate unit

body.zh: xAI 併入 SpaceX 後，資金與資源更充足，但也從獨立 AI 實驗室變成大集團的一部分。這是 AI 實驗室整合趨勢的代表案例。
body.en: Merging into SpaceX gave xAI more money and resources but ended its independence — a leading example of AI-lab consolidation.

title.zh: 同時在兩個門派

body.zh: 投影片把它放在 CSPs 和 AI Labs 兩邊：擁有超大算力，也自己訓練前沿模型。這類「算力＋模型」垂直整合的玩家越來越多。
body.en: The slide lists it under CSPs and AI Labs — owning giant compute and training frontier models. Such compute-plus-model vertical players are multiplying.

title.zh: 自己用不完就租出去
title.en: Rent out what you don't use

body.zh: Colossus 原本是訓練 Grok 的超級電腦，現在也透過雲端服務合約出租算力，第二季貢獻約 16 億美元。蓋了大量 GPU 的 AI 實驗室，也可能變成另一家 Neocloud。
body.en: Colossus was built to train Grok but now also rents compute under cloud-services deals (~US$1.6B in Q2) — a lab with huge GPU fleets can become a neocloud too.

plain.zh: 開發 AI 助手 Claude 的美國公司，特別重視讓 AI 安全、可靠、聽得懂規矩。
plain.en: The US company behind the AI assistant Claude, known for focusing on making AI safe and reliable.

nvidiaBond.zh: 2025 年 11 月，NVIDIA 宣布最多投資 100 億美元，雙方共同調校 Claude 與未來的 NVIDIA 晶片架構；Claude 也在 Microsoft Azure 上使用 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell 與 Vera Rubin 系統擴充算力。2026 年它是 NVIDIA OpenShell 的夥伴。
nvidiaBond.en: In November 2025 NVIDIA committed up to $10B and the two agreed to co-optimize Claude with future NVIDIA architectures, with Claude scaling on Azure using Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems. In 2026 it joined NVIDIA's OpenShell effort.

impact.zh: 讓「強大」和「安全」一起被討論：企業把重要工作交給 AI 之前，會更在意它是否可靠、可預測。Anthropic 同時使用 NVIDIA GPU、Google TPU 與 Amazon Trainium，也是觀察多晶片策略的例子。
impact.en: Puts safety next to capability in the conversation, which matters as businesses hand AI real work. It also runs on NVIDIA GPUs, Google TPUs and Amazon Trainium — a live example of a multi-chip strategy.

dialogue.zh: 劍要利，心要正。
dialogue.en: A sharp blade needs a steady heart.

details.zh: Anthropic 把「AI 安全」當成公司核心：除了開發 Claude，也投入研究怎麼理解模型內部在想什麼、怎麼讓它遵守原則。Claude 透過 AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft 等雲端平台提供給企業使用；Amazon 是它主要的雲端與訓練夥伴。
details.en: Anthropic puts AI safety at its core: alongside building Claude, it researches how models think inside and how to keep them following principles. Claude is offered to businesses through AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft, with Amazon as its primary cloud and training partner.

title.zh: 怎麼教 AI 守規矩？「憲法式 AI」
title.en: How do you teach AI manners? "Constitutional AI"

body.zh: 傳統做法是請大量人工替 AI 的回答打分數。Anthropic 提出的「憲法式 AI」則是先寫好一份原則清單（像一部憲法），讓 AI 依照這些原則自己檢討、修改回答，再用這些修改過的回答訓練它。好處是規則寫得清楚、可以公開檢視，也減少人工標註的負擔。
body.en: The classic approach is to have many people grade an AI's answers. Anthropic's "Constitutional AI" instead writes down a list of principles — a constitution — and has the AI critique and revise its own answers against them, then trains on those revisions. The rules are explicit and open to scrutiny, and less human labeling is needed.

title.zh: 三種晶片一起用

body.zh: Anthropic 同時使用 NVIDIA GPU、Google TPU（最多 100 萬顆）和 Amazon Trainium。分散供應商可以降低缺貨風險、爭取更好的價格，也讓各家晶片在同一個客戶身上正面比較。
body.en: Anthropic uses NVIDIA GPUs, Google TPUs (up to one million) and Amazon Trainium. Multiple suppliers cut shortage risk and improve pricing — and pit the chips head-to-head at one customer.

title.zh: 估值飆升反映在大股東財報上
title.en: Its valuation shows up in investors' books

body.zh: Amazon 2026 年第二季因 Anthropic 估值上升認列 534 億美元稅前收益。未上市 AI 公司的估值變化，會直接影響上市大股東的獲利數字。
body.en: Amazon booked US$53.4B of pre-tax gains in Q2 2026 from Anthropic's higher valuation — private AI valuations now move public companies' earnings.

title.zh: 安全也是賣點

body.zh: 企業把重要工作交給 AI 之前，最在意可靠與可控。Anthropic 把安全研究當成核心，也參與 NVIDIA OpenShell，讓「可信任」成為企業選擇 AI 供應商的條件之一。
body.en: Before handing AI important work, businesses want reliability and control. Anthropic makes safety research central and joined NVIDIA OpenShell, making trust a factor in choosing an AI vendor.

title.zh: 一年營收成長約 16 倍

body.zh: Anthropic 的年化營收從 2025 年 7 月約 40 億美元、2025 年底約 90 億美元，衝到 2026 年 7 月底約 650 億美元，一年內成長約 16 倍（報導，非經審計數字）。企業大量採用 AI 寫程式與 Agent，是推動成長的主力。
body.en: Anthropic's run-rate went from ~US$4B in July 2025 and ~US$9B at end-2025 to ~US$65B by end-July 2026 — roughly 16× in a year (reported, unaudited), driven by enterprise adoption of AI coding and agents.

nvidiaBond.zh: Gemini 主要在 Google 自家 TPU 上訓練；但 2026 年 4 月起，企業可以在自己的機房、用 NVIDIA Blackwell 與 Blackwell Ultra GPU 執行 Gemini（Google Distributed Cloud，預覽中），讓需要資料不出門的金融、政府單位也能用。
nvidiaBond.en: Gemini is trained mainly on Google's own TPUs, but since April 2026 enterprises can run it in their own data centers on NVIDIA Blackwell and Blackwell Ultra GPUs (Google Distributed Cloud, in preview) — useful for banks and governments that keep data on-site.

impact.zh: Gemini 讓 Google 在 AI 助手競賽中追上，AlphaFold 則證明 AI 能推動基礎科學。DeepMind 是少數同時在產品和科學研究都領先的實驗室。
impact.en: Gemini put Google back in the AI-assistant race, and AlphaFold showed AI can advance basic science. DeepMind is rare in leading on both products and research.

details.zh: DeepMind 早年以 AlphaGo 打敗圍棋冠軍聞名，之後用 AlphaFold 預測蛋白質結構，創辦人 Demis Hassabis 因此與 John Jumper 共同獲得 2024 年諾貝爾化學獎的一半。ChatGPT 爆紅後，Google 把 DeepMind 和 Google Brain 合併，集中火力開發 Gemini。2025 年 11 月推出的 Gemini 3 一次能讀進約 100 萬個 token 的內容。
details.en: DeepMind first won fame when AlphaGo beat a Go champion, then used AlphaFold to predict protein structures — earning co-founder Demis Hassabis a share of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. After ChatGPT took off, Google merged DeepMind with Google Brain to focus on Gemini. Gemini 3, launched in November 2025, can take in about a million tokens at once.

title.zh: 多模態 AI：不只讀字，也看圖、聽聲音
title.en: Multimodal AI: reading, seeing and hearing

body.zh: 早期的聊天 AI 只看得懂文字。「多模態」模型則把文字、圖片、聲音、影片都轉成同一種內部表示，所以你可以丟一段影片問它發生什麼事，或拍一張表格請它整理。Gemini 從一開始就以多模態設計，Gemini 3 還能一次讀進約 100 萬個 token，大約是好幾本書的長度。
body.en: Early chat AIs only read text. Multimodal models turn text, images, audio and video into one shared internal form, so you can hand over a video and ask what happened, or snap a table and ask for a summary. Gemini was built multimodal from the start, and Gemini 3 can read about a million tokens at once — several books' worth.

title.zh: AI 不只聊天，也能拿諾貝爾
title.en: AI that wins Nobel Prizes, not just chats

body.zh: AlphaFold 預測了大量蛋白質結構，幫助藥物和生物研究。它的成功說明 AI 最大的價值，可能不在聊天，而在加速科學發現。
body.en: AlphaFold predicted vast numbers of protein structures, aiding drug and biology research. Its success suggests AI's biggest payoff may be speeding up science, not chatting.

title.zh: 10 億使用者的通路優勢
title.en: The distribution edge of a billion users

body.zh: Gemini App 每月使用者突破 10 億，部分原因是 Google 能把它放進 Android、Gmail、搜尋等既有產品。AI 競爭不只比模型強弱，也比誰能接觸到最多人。
body.en: The Gemini app topped a billion monthly users partly because Google can place it inside Android, Gmail and Search. The AI race is about reach as much as model quality.

title.zh: 自己的晶片訓練，別人的晶片部署
title.en: Train on its own chips, deploy on others'

body.zh: Gemini 在 TPU 上訓練，卻也開放在客戶機房的 NVIDIA GPU 上執行。為了搶企業客戶，Google 願意讓自己的模型跑在對手的晶片上。
body.en: Gemini trains on TPUs but can also run on NVIDIA GPUs in customers' data centers. To win enterprises, Google lets its model run on a rival's silicon.

title.zh: 模型發表時程也會變

body.zh: 報導指 Gemini 3.5 Pro 延後後被放棄，Gemini 4 的實際表現也引起內部討論（Google 否認表現不佳）。前沿模型的研發充滿不確定性，發表時程常常調整。
body.en: Reports say Gemini 3.5 Pro was dropped after delays and Gemini 4 drew internal debate (Google disputes underperformance) — frontier development is uncertain and roadmaps shift.

The first Vera Rubin systems are expected in H2 2026.

details.zh: OpenAI 在 2022 年 11 月推出 ChatGPT，兩個月內引爆全球 AI 熱潮。它的模型需要極大量算力，因此和 Microsoft、NVIDIA、CoreWeave 等多家公司簽下大型算力合約。
details.en: OpenAI launched ChatGPT in November 2022 and sparked a global AI boom within two months. Its models need enormous compute, so it has signed huge capacity deals with Microsoft, NVIDIA, CoreWeave and others.

title.zh: 為什麼 AI 機房改用「GW」來算大小？
title.en: Why are AI data centers now measured in gigawatts?

body.zh: 以前說機房有幾台伺服器；現在 AI 機房太大，乾脆用耗電量來形容。1 GW（十億瓦）大約是一座大型發電廠的發電量。OpenAI 與 NVIDIA 2025 年的意向書提到部署至少 10 GW。原因之一是「推論」：2026 年初每週約 9 億人使用 ChatGPT，每一次回答都在消耗算力和電力，用的人越多，需要的機房就越大。
body.en: Data centers used to be sized by server count; AI ones are so big they're now sized by power. One gigawatt is roughly a large power plant's output, and OpenAI and NVIDIA's 2025 letter of intent cited at least 10 GW. Part of the reason is inference: with ~900 million weekly (early 2026) ChatGPT users, every answer burns compute and electricity.

title.zh: 算力合約遍布整條供應鏈
title.en: Compute deals across the supply chain

body.zh: OpenAI 同時和 Microsoft、NVIDIA、CoreWeave（三份合約合計最高約 224 億美元）等簽下算力合約，不把雞蛋放在同一個籃子裡。它的採購決定，直接牽動 GPU、雲端與伺服器代工廠的訂單。
body.en: OpenAI has compute deals with Microsoft, NVIDIA, CoreWeave (up to ~US$22.4B across three contracts) and others rather than relying on one supplier — its purchasing decisions move orders across GPUs, clouds and server ODMs.

title.zh: 9 億使用者，5,000 萬人付費（2026 年 2 月）

body.zh: 2026 年 2 月，ChatGPT 每週約 9 億人使用，付費訂閱約 5,000 萬人。推論成本隨使用量增加，怎麼把免費使用者變成收入，是 AI 公司最大的商業課題之一。
body.en: As of Feb 2026, ~900M people used ChatGPT weekly but only ~50M paid. Inference costs rise with usage, so turning free users into revenue is one of AI's biggest business problems.

title.zh: 「循環式」大交易

body.zh: NVIDIA 以 300 億美元入股 OpenAI，OpenAI 再大量採購 NVIDIA 系統。這類交易讓雙方綁得更緊，但也讓市場討論 AI 需求是否被資金循環放大。NVIDIA 最後選擇金額較小、不綁部署進度的股權投資，而不是原本最多 1,000 億美元的意向書。
body.en: NVIDIA put US$30B into OpenAI, which buys NVIDIA systems at scale — tying them closer but raising questions about whether AI demand is amplified by circular financing. NVIDIA ultimately chose a smaller equity stake not tied to deployments over the original up-to-US$100B LOI.

title.zh: 兆元估值也會下修

body.zh: 據報導，OpenAI 在 2026 年 10 月把新一輪的投前估值喊價從 1.4 兆下調到 1.25 兆美元（OpenAI 未證實）。即使是最熱門的 AI 公司，投資人也會對價格討價還價。
body.en: OpenAI reportedly cut its pre-money asking valuation for a new round from US$1.4T to US$1.25T in Oct 2026 (unconfirmed by OpenAI) — even the hottest AI company faces investor pushback on price.

details.zh: LeCun 長年在 Meta 領導 AI 研究，他認為只靠大型語言模型到不了真正的智慧。AMI Labs 以他 2022 年提出的 JEPA 架構為基礎發展「世界模型」，初期鎖定機器人、製造與穿戴裝置。
details.en: LeCun long led AI research at Meta and argues language models alone won't reach true intelligence. AMI Labs builds "world models" on his 2022 JEPA framework, starting with robotics, manufacturing and wearables.

title.zh: 什麼是「世界模型」？

body.zh: 大型語言模型擅長預測下一個字；世界模型則想學會「世界怎麼運作」——東西掉下來會怎樣、推一下會怎樣。有了這種理解，AI 才能在真實環境裡規劃行動，例如讓機器人預想動作的後果再出手。
body.en: Language models predict the next word; world models try to learn how the world works — what happens when things fall or get pushed. With that understanding, AI can plan in the real world, like a robot imagining an action's result before acting.

body.zh: AMI Labs 的第一個夥伴是數位醫療新創 Nabla，並鎖定機器人、製造與穿戴裝置。世界模型的價值，在需要理解真實環境的場景最容易被驗證。
body.en: AMI Labs' first partner is digital-health startup Nabla, with robotics, manufacturing and wearables next — world models prove their worth where AI must understand real environments.

body.en: AMI Labs raised ~US$1B at seed with papers but no product — investors are betting on Yann LeCun's thesis that AI should learn how the world works from video and sensors, not just predict the next word.

title.zh: AI 怎麼「畫」出圖片？擴散模型
title.en: How does AI paint? Diffusion models

body.zh: 擴散模型的訓練方式是：先把圖片一步步加雜訊直到變成一片雜點，再讓 AI 學會反過來「去雜訊」。生成時，AI 從純雜訊出發，依照你的文字描述一步步清理，最後變出一張圖。
body.en: Diffusion models are trained by adding noise to images step by step until they're static, then learning to reverse it. To generate, the AI starts from pure noise and cleans it up step by step, guided by your text, until an image appears.

body.en: When AI startups cite "US$900M run-rate," they usually mean the latest month's revenue times 12. It shows momentum, but it isn't a full year's earnings and isn't audited — fast growers look big on it, so read carefully.

details.zh: Cursor 建立在大家熟悉的 VS Code 編輯器上，加入可以理解整個程式專案的 AI。它從「自動補完下一行」一路發展到能自己修改多個檔案、執行測試的 AI 代理，成為成長最快的 AI 新創之一。2026 年 6 月 SpaceX 宣布收購，8 月完成，併入 SpaceXAI 部門。
details.en: Cursor builds on the familiar VS Code editor and adds AI that understands a whole codebase. It grew from finishing your next line to agents that edit many files and run tests, becoming one of the fastest-growing AI startups. SpaceX announced a deal in June 2026 and closed it in August, folding Cursor into its SpaceXAI unit.

title.zh: AI 寫程式的三個階段
title.en: The three stages of AI coding

body.zh: 第一階段是「自動補完」：你打字，AI 猜下一行。第二階段是「對話」：你問問題，AI 解釋或給一段程式。第三階段是「Coding Agent」：你交代一個任務，AI 自己規劃步驟、改好幾個檔案、跑測試、修錯誤，最後交給你檢查。越往後，AI 做越多事，但人類把關越重要。
body.en: Stage one is autocomplete: you type, AI guesses the next line. Stage two is chat: you ask, AI explains or drafts a snippet. Stage three is the coding agent: you assign a task and the AI plans steps, edits several files, runs tests and fixes bugs before handing it back. The more AI does, the more human review matters.

title.zh: 寫程式是 AI 最早賺錢的應用

body.zh: Cursor 從創立到被收購只花約四年，估值從數十億美元衝到約 600 億。寫程式能直接提升工程師生產力，企業願意付費，是最早證明 AI 能大規模賺錢的領域之一。
body.en: Cursor went from founding to a ~US$60B acquisition in about four years. Coding directly boosts engineer productivity, so companies pay — one of the first proofs AI can earn at scale.

title.zh: 被火箭公司買下的意義
title.en: Why a rocket company bought it

body.zh: SpaceX 收購 Cursor，讓它擁有算力（Colossus）、模型（Grok）之外的熱門應用。在 AI 競爭中，誰掌握開發者每天使用的工具，誰就能持續收集回饋、改進模型。
body.en: Buying Cursor gave SpaceX a hit application on top of compute (Colossus) and models (Grok). Owning the tools developers use daily means a steady stream of feedback to improve models.

title.zh: 投資人與客戶的雙重關係

body.zh: NVIDIA 既投資 Cursor、也是它的企業客戶。這種「投資自己用的工具」的模式，在 AI 產業相當常見，也讓合作關係更緊密。
body.en: NVIDIA both invested in Cursor and uses it as a customer — investing in the tools you rely on is common in AI and tightens partnerships.

title.zh: 市占被追趕

body.zh: Anthropic 的 Claude Code、OpenAI 的 Codex 等由模型公司直接推出的寫程式 Agent，正和 Cursor 搶同一批企業客戶。即使是明星產品，也面臨上游模型公司直接競爭。
body.en: Coding agents launched by the model makers themselves, such as Anthropic's Claude Code and OpenAI's Codex, now compete with Cursor for the same business customers — even star products face upstream model makers head-on.

details.zh: 一般語言模型一個字一個字地寫；Inception 的 Mercury 用擴散方式同時生成並反覆修正整段內容，公司稱速度可快 5 到 10 倍，在 NVIDIA H100 上每秒可達約 1,000 個 token。
details.en: Most language models write word by word; Inception's Mercury generates and refines a whole passage at once via diffusion. The company claims 5–10× speedups, reaching ~1,000 tokens per second on NVIDIA H100s.

title.zh: 一個字一個字 vs. 整段一起改
title.en: Word by word vs. refining the whole passage

body.zh: 傳統語言模型是「自回歸」：寫完上一個字才能寫下一個，速度受限。擴散語言模型則先產生一份粗略草稿，再整段同時反覆修正，比較能善用 GPU 一次算很多東西的特性，所以有機會快很多。
body.en: Traditional models are autoregressive: each word waits for the last, limiting speed. Diffusion language models draft the whole passage roughly, then refine all of it in parallel — better using a GPU's ability to compute many things at once.

body.zh: 幾乎所有大型語言模型都是「一個字一個字」生成。Inception 用擴散方式整段生成，若速度優勢持續，可能改變 AI 推論的成本結構。
body.en: Nearly all LLMs generate word by word; Inception generates whole passages via diffusion. If its speed edge holds, it could reshape inference costs.

title.zh: 學界明星的創業潮

body.en: More tokens per second means one GPU serves more users — faster inference ultimately shows up as cheaper AI services.

details.en: Silver was DeepMind's VP of reinforcement learning. He argues self-exploring reinforcement learning is a likelier path to superintelligence than scaling language models. The company has no product yet.

title.zh: 強化學習：從嘗試和回饋中學
title.en: Reinforcement learning: learning from trial and reward

body.zh: 強化學習像訓練寵物：AI 做出動作，做對了給獎勵、做錯了扣分，慢慢學會最好的策略。AlphaGo 就是靠自己跟自己下棋（自我對弈）變強，最後下出人類沒想過的棋步。難題在於：真實世界不像圍棋有清楚的輸贏規則。
body.en: Reinforcement learning is like training a pet: the AI acts, gets rewarded or penalized, and gradually learns the best strategy. AlphaGo grew stronger by playing itself, finding moves no human had imagined. The challenge: the real world lacks Go's clear win/lose rules.

title.zh: 英國政府也下場投資

body.zh: 英國企業銀行與主權 AI 基金都參與了 Ineffable 的種子輪。各國政府正直接投資本國的前沿 AI 實驗室，把 AI 視為國家戰略產業。
body.en: The British Business Bank and the UK Sovereign AI Fund joined Ineffable's seed — governments now invest directly in national frontier labs, treating AI as strategic.

title.zh: 不用人類資料的野心
title.en: The ambition of learning without human data

body.zh: 目前的大模型大多從人類寫的文字學習，總有一天會「讀完」。Ineffable 想讓 AI 從自身經驗學習，若成功，就能突破人類資料的上限。
body.en: Today's models learn mostly from human-written text, which will eventually run out. Ineffable wants AI to learn from its own experience — breaking past the ceiling of human data.

title.zh: 高風險、高報酬的賭注

body.zh: 公司成立不到一年、還沒有產品，就拿到 51 億美元估值。自我學習從遊戲走向真實世界仍是未解難題，這是一筆典型的前沿科技賭注。
body.en: Less than a year old with no product, it is valued at US$5.1B. Taking self-play from games to the real world is unsolved — a classic frontier-tech bet.

title.zh: 歐洲也能誕生超大種子輪

body.zh: Ineffable 在倫敦募到 11 億美元種子輪，是歐洲最大紀錄。DeepMind 在倫敦培養了大量頂尖研究員，他們出來創業時，資金也跟著湧入，讓倫敦成為美國以外最重要的 AI 實驗室聚落。
body.en: Ineffable's US$1.1B seed is Europe's largest. DeepMind trained a deep bench of researchers in London; as they spin out, capital follows — making London the key AI lab cluster outside the US.

plain.zh: 由前 DeepMind 成員在倫敦創立的 AI 實驗室，打造能自己做科學研究的 AI 系統 Faraday。
plain.en: A London AI lab founded by DeepMind alumni, building Faraday, an AI system that does scientific research.

nvidiaBond.zh: NVIDIA 的創投部門 NVentures 參與了 Inherent 的 5,000 萬美元種子輪。
nvidiaBond.en: NVIDIA's venture arm NVentures joined Inherent's US$50M seed round.

impact.zh: AI 做科學是新興熱潮，Inherent 代表「讓 AI 重現並推進研究」的方向。
impact.en: AI for science is a rising wave; Inherent represents AI that reproduces and extends research.

dialogue.zh: 格物致知，交給我的 AI。
dialogue.en: Investigate things to gain knowledge — my AI's on it.

value.en: Faraday: an AI agent built to work like a scientist alongside human researchers

details.zh: Inherent 的 Faraday 結合人類引導的科學探索與能自我改進的 AI Agent。公司稱在自家「重現已發表研究」的基準測試上，Faraday 勝過更大的模型，但尚未有獨立驗證。
details.en: Inherent's Faraday combines human-guided scientific exploration with self-improving AI agents. The company says Faraday beat larger models on its own benchmark for reproducing published research, though this hasn't been independently verified.

title.zh: 基準測試（Benchmark）怎麼看？

body.zh: 基準測試是一組標準考題，用來比較不同 AI 的表現。但要注意：如果考卷是公司自己出的，可能剛好對自家模型有利；最可信的是獨立第三方的測試，或公開、可重現的評估方法。
body.en: A benchmark is a standard test set for comparing AIs. But if a company writes its own test, it may favor its own model; the most credible are independent third-party tests or open, reproducible evaluations.

title.zh: AI 做科學是新戰場
title.en: AI for science is a new battleground

body.zh: 除了聊天與寫程式，越來越多新創瞄準「讓 AI 做科學研究」。Inherent、Lila、Periodic Labs 都在這條路上，NVIDIA 也都有投資。
body.en: Beyond chat and coding, startups increasingly target AI that does science — Inherent, Lila and Periodic Labs are all on this path, and NVIDIA backs each.

title.zh: 小團隊、大野心
title.en: A tiny team with big ambitions

body.zh: Inherent 目前只有十多人，計畫年底擴到 20 至 25 人。AI 讓小團隊能挑戰過去需要大型研究機構才能做的事。
body.en: Inherent has about a dozen people, aiming for 20–25 by year end — AI lets small teams tackle work that once needed large institutes.

title.zh: 自家基準測試要謹慎看

body.zh: Inherent 宣稱 Faraday 在自家基準上勝過更大的模型，但尚未有獨立驗證。新創的效能宣稱，最好等第三方測試再下結論。
body.en: Inherent says Faraday beat larger models on its own benchmark, unverified independently — wait for third-party tests before concluding.

title.zh: 「重現論文」是 AI 科學家的考題

body.zh: Inherent 用「能不能重現已發表的研究結果」來評估 Faraday。這比回答問題難得多，因為要自己規劃實驗、寫程式、分析資料。（勝過前沿模型是公司自己的說法，尚無獨立驗證）
body.en: Inherent tests Faraday on whether it can reproduce published findings — far harder than answering questions, since it must plan experiments, write code and analyze data. (The claim that it beats frontier models is the company's own and has not been independently verified.)

plain.zh: 想打造「科學超級智慧」的新創：用 AI 指揮自動化實驗室，日夜不停做實驗。
plain.en: A startup pursuing "scientific superintelligence": AI directing automated labs that run experiments around the clock.

title.zh: 自動化實驗室：AI 設計、機器人動手
title.en: Self-driving labs: AI designs, robots do

body.zh: 傳統研究是人想點子、做實驗、看結果，一輪可能要好幾週。自動化實驗室把這個循環交給 AI 和機器人：AI 提出假設，機器人執行實驗，結果再回饋給 AI 調整下一步，一天可以跑很多輪。
body.en: Traditional research — idea, experiment, result — can take weeks per loop. Self-driving labs hand the loop to AI and robots: AI proposes hypotheses, robots run experiments, and results feed back to the AI, cycling many times a day.

body.zh: Lila 的「AI 科學工廠」讓機器人日夜做實驗。科學研究若能像工廠一樣規模化，發現新藥、新材料的速度可能大幅提升。
body.en: Lila's AI Science Factories run experiments around the clock. If research can scale like manufacturing, discovering drugs and materials could speed up dramatically.

title.zh: 估值可能大跳升

body.zh: 報導指 Lila 洽談以約 85 億美元估值募資，比一年前的 13 億美元高出數倍。AI 科學被視為下一個大機會。

title.zh: 生技創投模式孵化

body.zh: Lila 源自 Flagship Pioneering，這家創投也孵化了 Moderna。用生技產業的「打造公司」模式來做 AI，結合了科學與資本的經驗。
body.en: Lila came out of Flagship Pioneering — the firm that incubated Moderna — applying biotech's company-building model to AI.

title.zh: 只做研發，不做臨床

body.zh: Lila 用 AI 加自動化實驗室發現新分子或新材料，但自己不做臨床試驗，而是把成果授權給合作夥伴。這讓它避開最花錢、最耗時的階段，專心把「發現」這一步做到最快。
body.en: Lila uses AI plus automated labs to discover molecules and materials, then licenses results to partners instead of running clinical trials — skipping the costliest, slowest phase to focus on fast discovery.

body.en: Cursor serves engineers; Lovable lets non-coders build apps. AI expands software-making from tens of millions of engineers to hundreds of millions of ordinary people.

title.zh: 背後仍是大模型

body.en: Apps like Lovable sit on top of large models, so costs and capabilities depend on model providers — the long-term challenge is building a moat above the model.

title.zh: 小團隊、大營收

details.zh: Mistral 是歐洲最受矚目的 AI 新創。它常把模型「權重」公開，讓企業和政府可以把模型放在自己的機房裡跑，資料不必送到外國。2025 年它更推出 Mistral Compute，從模型公司跨足雲端，所以同時屬於三個門派。
details.en: Mistral is Europe's most watched AI startup. It often publishes model weights so companies and governments can run models on their own servers without sending data abroad. In 2025 it launched Mistral Compute, stretching from models into cloud — which is why it sits in three factions at once.

title.zh: 開放權重模型與主權 AI

body.zh: AI 模型的「權重」就是它學到的所有知識，存成一大堆數字。「開放權重」是把這些數字公開讓人下載，你可以在自己的電腦或機房執行、微調，不必透過別人的雲端。這和「主權 AI」有關：許多國家希望關鍵 AI 能自己掌握，不完全依賴美國或中國的公司。
body.en: A model's "weights" are everything it learned, stored as a vast set of numbers. "Open-weight" means publishing those numbers so anyone can download, run and fine-tune the model on their own machines. This ties to "sovereign AI": many countries want control over critical AI rather than relying entirely on US or Chinese firms.

title.zh: 半導體設備龍頭當最大股東
title.en: A chip-equipment giant as top shareholder

body.zh: 荷蘭 ASML 製造全世界最先進晶片都需要的曝光機，卻投資 Mistral 成為最大股東。這是歐洲把「晶片設備」和「AI 模型」綁在一起、建立自主 AI 能力的策略布局。
body.en: ASML makes the lithography machines every advanced chip needs — and became Mistral's largest shareholder. It ties European chip equipment to European AI models, a strategic bid for AI autonomy.

title.zh: 同時做模型和雲端

body.zh: Mistral 推出 Mistral Compute 自建雲端，跨足三個門派。模型公司自己蓋算力，可以掌握成本與供應，但也意味著要投入大量資本。
body.en: With Mistral Compute, Mistral spans three factions. Owning compute gives a model maker control over cost and supply — at the price of heavy capital spending.

title.zh: 開放權重的商業模式

body.zh: 免費開放模型權重，如何賺錢？Mistral 的答案是：賣企業版服務、客製化、雲端與部署支援。開放帶來廣泛採用，企業需求再轉成營收。
body.en: How do you profit from giving away weights? Mistral sells enterprise services, customization, cloud and deployment support — openness drives adoption, enterprise needs drive revenue.

title.zh: 營收要追上估值
title.en: Revenue has to catch up with valuation

body.zh: Sacra 估計 Mistral 2026 年初年化營收約 4 億美元，執行長目標 2026 年營收逾 10 億歐元；D 輪投後估值已逾 210 億歐元。估值倍數很高，代表市場對未來成長期待很高。
body.en: Sacra estimates Mistral's run-rate at ~US$400M in early 2026, with the CEO targeting over €1B in 2026 revenue, while the Series D valued it above €21B — a high multiple that reflects strong growth expectations.

plain.en: Founded by ex-OpenAI and Google DeepMind researchers, using AI and robotic labs to discover new materials, starting with superconductors.

title.zh: 為什麼 AI 找新材料這麼重要？
title.en: Why does AI materials discovery matter?

body.zh: 新材料能帶來更好的電池、晶片和超導體（零電阻導電，可大幅減少電力損耗）。可能的原子組合多到人類試不完，AI 可以先在電腦裡篩選出最有希望的候選，再交給實驗室驗證。
body.en: New materials can mean better batteries, chips and superconductors (zero-resistance conductors that slash power loss). Possible atomic combinations are too many to test, so AI screens promising candidates in silico before labs verify them.

title.zh: AI 需要實驗驗證

body.zh: 電腦預測出的新材料，必須在真實實驗室合成、測試才算數。Periodic Labs 把 AI 和機器人實驗室結合，就是為了縮短「預測到驗證」的距離。
body.en: Materials predicted in silico only count once made and tested in a real lab — Periodic Labs pairs AI with robotic labs to close the gap from prediction to proof.

title.zh: 硬科技的長期回報

body.zh: 超導體等新材料若突破，影響能源、運輸與晶片，但研發週期長、不確定性高。這是比軟體更有耐心的投資。
body.en: Breakthroughs in materials like superconductors could reshape energy, transport and chips, but timelines are long and uncertain — more patient capital than software.

title.en: How is an answer engine different from search?

body.zh: Physical Intelligence 不造機器人，而是做能裝在不同機器人上的基礎模型 π。就像大型語言模型能做很多文字工作，π 希望讓同一個模型學會摺衣服、裝箱等多種動作。但公司也坦言還沒有商業化時程。
body.en: Physical Intelligence doesn't build robots; it builds π, a foundation model for many robot bodies. Like LLMs handle many text tasks, π aims to learn folding, packing and more with one model — though the company has no commercialization timeline yet.

plain.zh: 投影片寫「Prometheus」，推測是 Jeff Bezos 共同領導的 Project Prometheus：專做「物理世界 AI」，加速工程設計與製造。
plain.en: The slide says "Prometheus" — most likely Project Prometheus, co-led by Jeff Bezos, building AI for engineering and manufacturing.

nvidiaBond.zh: 公開資料未見與 NVIDIA 的直接投資或合作公告；它和多數 AI 公司一樣，模型與服務多半跑在 NVIDIA GPU 上，但這點未經個別證實。
nvidiaBond.en: No direct NVIDIA investment or partnership announcement was found in public sources.

impact.zh: 讓 AI 從軟體延伸到航太、汽車與製造業，可能改變實體產品的研發速度。
impact.en: Extends AI from software into aerospace, autos and manufacturing, potentially speeding physical R&D.

dialogue.zh: 把火種交給工程師！
dialogue.en: Bringing fire to the engineers!

details.en: Project Prometheus calls its mission "AI for the physical economy," targeting aerospace, autos, advanced manufacturing and drug discovery with AI that speeds the design and production of complex physical products.

title.zh: 「實體 AI」：從數位走進工廠
title.en: Physical AI: from screens to factories

body.zh: 聊天和寫程式都在電腦裡完成；實體 AI 則要處理真實世界的物理、材料和製造限制，例如設計一個既輕又耐熱的零件。它需要模擬、實驗和大量工程資料，難度更高，但影響實體產業的潛力也更大。
body.en: Chat and code live in computers; physical AI must handle real physics, materials and manufacturing limits — like designing a light, heat-resistant part. It needs simulation, experiments and engineering data: harder, but with bigger potential impact on physical industries.

title.en: A founder back at the helm

body.zh: Jeff Bezos 卸下 Amazon 執行長後，首度以共同執行長身分經營新公司。這個訊號本身，就讓「實體 AI」更受矚目。
body.en: Jeff Bezos is co-CEO of a company for the first time since leaving Amazon's top job — a signal that drew attention to physical AI.

title.zh: 華爾街大型機構直接投資

body.zh: 摩根大通、貝萊德等直接參與募資，且沒有傳統創投領投。AI 新創的資金來源，正從創投擴大到大型金融機構。
body.en: JPMorgan and BlackRock invested directly, with no traditional VC lead — AI funding is broadening from venture firms to large financial institutions.

title.zh: 目標是「人工通才工程師」

body.zh: 報導指 Prometheus 想打造能加速複雜實體產品設計、開發與生產的 AI。若成功，航太、汽車等產業的研發週期可能大幅縮短。
body.en: Reports say Prometheus wants an AI that speeds the design, development and production of complex physical products — potentially shrinking R&D cycles in aerospace and autos.

title.zh: 買工廠來餵資料

body.zh: WSJ 報導 Bezos 另外籌組最多 1,000 億美元的控股公司收購製造業者，讓實際生產資料回饋給 Prometheus 的模型（尚未確認是否完成）。實體 AI 最缺的是真實世界的資料，有些公司選擇直接把資料來源買下來。
body.en: WSJ reported Bezos is raising up to US$100B for a holding company to buy manufacturers and feed operating data back into Prometheus's models (not confirmed as closed). Physical AI is starved for real-world data, so some buy the source outright.

plain.zh: 投影片的「Recursive」是 Recursive Superintelligence：讓 AI 自己做 AI 研究、自我改進的新創。
plain.en: "Recursive" on the slide is Recursive Superintelligence, a startup building AI that does AI research and improves itself.

nvidiaBond.en: NVIDIA took part in Recursive Superintelligence's 2026 funding.

impact.zh: 若 AI 能加速 AI 研究，整個產業的進步節奏都可能改變。
impact.en: If AI accelerates AI research, the whole field's pace could change.

dialogue.zh: 今天的我，打造明天更強的我。
dialogue.en: Today's me builds a stronger tomorrow's me.

title.zh: 「遞迴自我改進」是什麼？

body.zh: 如果 AI 能幫忙設計更好的 AI，新的 AI 又能設計出更更好的 AI，進步速度就可能越來越快——這就是「遞迴自我改進」。它是許多人認為通往超級智慧的路徑，也因此特別需要安全把關。
body.en: If AI can help design better AI, which designs even better AI, progress could accelerate — recursive self-improvement. Many see it as a path to superintelligence, which is exactly why it needs careful safety oversight.

title.zh: 用 AI 加速 AI 研究

body.zh: 如果 AI 能自動設計模型、訓練方法和評估方式，AI 研究的速度可能大幅提升。這是業界認為最可能「加速進步」的方向之一。
body.en: If AI can design models, training methods and evaluations automatically, AI research could accelerate sharply — one of the directions most expected to speed progress.

title.zh: NVIDIA 與 AMD 同時投資
title.en: Backed by both NVIDIA and AMD

body.zh: 兩家 GPU 對手都參與了募資。對晶片廠來說，投資有潛力的實驗室、確保它們使用自家硬體，是重要的市場策略。
body.en: Both GPU rivals joined the round — for chipmakers, investing in promising labs to win them as customers is key strategy.

title.zh: 安全問題更迫切

body.zh: 會自我改進的 AI，進步可能快到人類來不及檢查。這類研究特別需要透明度與安全把關，也是監管者關注的焦點。
body.en: Self-improving AI could advance faster than humans can review — such research especially needs transparency and safety oversight, and draws regulators' attention.

title.zh: 讓 AI 改進 AI

body.zh: Recursive 第一步要自動化「訓練模型」與「最佳化 GPU 程式」這兩件事。如果 AI 能自己找出更有效率的訓練方法，研發速度就可能加快，這也是許多實驗室追求的「遞迴自我改進」。
body.en: Recursive first wants to automate model training and GPU-kernel optimization. If AI can find better ways to train AI, research speeds up — the "recursive self-improvement" many labs chase.

plain.zh: 由前 DeepMind 研究員創立，目標是做出美國的「前沿開放權重模型」。

nvidiaBond.en: NVIDIA led Reflection's US$2B round in Oct 2025 with US$800M, and Reflection joined NVIDIA's Nemotron open-model coalition. In Oct 2026 the FT reported NVIDIA was in early talks to acquire or invest more in Reflection (unconfirmed; talks could collapse).

impact.en: Strengthens America's open-weight camp and speaks to sovereign-AI demand.

dialogue.zh: 好武功，就該公開傳承。
dialogue.en: Great kung fu should be passed on openly.

title.zh: 混合專家（MoE）模型

body.zh: MoE 模型裡有很多「專家」子網路，每次回答只叫醒其中幾個最相關的專家來算。這樣模型總參數可以很大、知識很廣，但每次實際計算量小，跑起來比較省。
body.en: An MoE model has many expert sub-networks and wakes only the most relevant few per answer. Total parameters can be huge, but each answer computes little — making it cheaper to run.

title.zh: 美國的開放模型隊長

body.zh: 中國的 DeepSeek 等開放模型影響力很大。Reflection 主打「美國的前沿開放模型」，呼應許多政府與企業不想依賴中國開放模型的需求。
body.en: Chinese open models like DeepSeek are influential; Reflection pitches America's frontier open models, answering governments and firms that don't want to rely on Chinese ones.

title.zh: NVIDIA 領投的戰略意義

body.zh: NVIDIA 以 8 億美元領投，並把 Reflection 納入 Nemotron 開放模型聯盟。開放模型越普及，越多企業會自己部署——也就需要更多 GPU。
body.en: NVIDIA led with US$800M and brought Reflection into its Nemotron coalition — the more open models spread, the more companies self-host, and the more GPUs they need.

title.zh: 估值有望三倍跳

body.zh: Reflection 2026 年春已以約 250 億美元（投前）估值完成新一輪，約是半年前的三倍。開放權重模型的戰略價值，正被重新評估。
body.en: Reflection closed a round at ~US$25B pre-money in spring 2026, roughly triple its value six months earlier — the strategic value of open weights is being re-rated.

title.zh: 用更少算力對抗中國模型
title.en: Taking on Chinese models with less compute

body.zh: Reflection 主打 Beam 以較低的算力成本，追上中國的頂級開放模型。開放模型的競爭，已經從「誰最大」變成「誰最有效率」。
body.en: Reflection pitches Beam as matching top Chinese open models at lower compute cost — open-model competition is shifting from who's biggest to who's most efficient.

impact.en: Lets enterprises own their AI instead of relying on a few closed models.

dialogue.zh: 為你量身打造，像流水一樣合身。
dialogue.en: Tailored to you — fitting like flowing water.

title.zh: LoRA：只改一小部分就能微調大模型
title.en: LoRA: fine-tuning a big model by changing a small part

body.zh: 完整微調一個大模型要動到幾十億個參數，非常耗資源。LoRA 的做法是凍結原本的模型，只額外訓練一小組「外掛」參數。成本大降，企業就能為不同用途各做一份客製版本。
body.en: Fully fine-tuning a big model touches billions of parameters. LoRA freezes the original and trains only a small add-on set of parameters, cutting costs so companies can keep custom versions for different uses.

title.zh: 讓企業擁有自己的模型

body.zh: 許多企業不想把核心能力交給少數封閉模型。River AI 用開放權重模型加上快速微調，讓企業打造專屬 AI，是「去中心化 AI」的商業版本。
body.en: Many enterprises don't want core capabilities locked in a few closed models. River AI's open-weight models plus fast fine-tuning let them own their AI — a commercial take on decentralized AI.

title.zh: 兩大晶片廠同時押注

body.zh: NVIDIA 與 AMD 都以策略投資人身分參與。企業微調需求若爆發，訓練與推論的算力需求也會跟著成長。
body.en: NVIDIA and AMD both joined as strategic investors — if enterprise fine-tuning booms, training and inference compute demand grows with it.

title.zh: 按 token 計費的新模式
title.en: Billing by token, not GPU hour

body.zh: 多數雲端按 GPU 使用時間收費，River AI 改成按 token 計費，連訓練也是。企業不用懂 GPU，只要為實際處理的資料量付錢。
body.en: Most clouds bill by GPU hour; River AI bills by token, even for training — customers needn't understand GPUs, just pay for the data processed.

title.en: From generating video to simulating worlds

body.en: To generate believable video, AI must grasp light, motion and collisions — effectively learning how the world works. So video models naturally extend into world models that build virtual training grounds for robots and self-driving cars.

body.en: Runway's GWM-1 can test robots — the line between video AI and robotics AI is blurring, as both must understand physics.

body.zh: Runway 用 Lionsgate 的電影與影集片庫訓練專屬模型。片廠把版權內容變成 AI 資產，而不是只擔心被 AI 取代。

details.zh: Sakana（日文「魚」）的名字來自魚群：很多簡單個體一起行動，就能產生聰明的整體行為。它研究用演化方法組合現有模型，以及讓 AI 自動做研究的「AI Scientist」。
details.en: Sakana means "fish" in Japanese — inspired by schools of fish where simple individuals together behave intelligently. It researches evolving new models by combining existing ones and an "AI Scientist" that automates research.

title.zh: 模型合併：讓 AI 像生物一樣演化
title.en: Model merging: evolving AI like living things

body.zh: 訓練一個全新模型很貴。另一種思路是把幾個現有模型的「能力」組合起來，再用類似生物演化的方式反覆挑選、交配出更好的組合。這樣可以用比較少的算力，得到兼具多種專長的模型。
body.en: Training a new model from scratch is costly. Another idea: combine abilities from existing models, then repeatedly select and breed better combinations like biological evolution — reaching multi-skilled models with far less compute.

title.zh: 日本的 AI 旗手

body.zh: Sakana 成立約一年就成為獨角獸，吸引多家日本大企業投資。日本希望在 AI 時代擁有自己的研究實力，Sakana 是重要代表。
body.en: Sakana became a unicorn within about a year and drew many Japanese corporates — a flagship of Japan's push for homegrown AI research.

title.zh: 不靠蠻力的研究路線

body.zh: 比起砸大錢訓練超大模型，Sakana 研究模型合併、演化方法等更省資源的做法。在算力昂貴的時代，效率本身就是競爭力。
body.en: Rather than spend heavily on giant models, Sakana studies resource-light methods like model merging and evolution — in an era of costly compute, efficiency is an edge.

title.zh: Transformer 作者的新篇章

body.zh: 共同創辦人 Llion Jones 是 Transformer 論文作者之一。這篇論文奠定了今天幾乎所有大型語言模型的基礎，作者們如今分散在各大 AI 公司與新創。
body.en: Co-founder Llion Jones co-wrote the Transformer paper that underpins nearly every LLM today — its authors are now spread across major AI firms and startups.

title.zh: 日本金融業的 AI 夥伴

body.zh: 三菱 UFJ 與 Sakana 簽下多年合作，並兩度投資。日本大型企業選擇扶植本土 AI 新創，而不只是採購美國模型。
body.en: MUFG signed a multiyear deal with Sakana and invested twice — Japanese giants are nurturing local AI startups, not just buying US models.

title.zh: AGI 與超級智慧有什麼不同？

body.zh: 「通用人工智慧」（AGI）大致指在多數知識工作上能和人類一樣好的 AI；「超級智慧」則是遠遠超越人類的 AI。兩者都沒有統一定義。正因為超級智慧可能能力極強，如何確保它符合人類利益，就成了 SSI 這類實驗室的核心問題。
body.en: AGI roughly means AI as capable as humans at most knowledge work; superintelligence means AI far beyond humans. Neither has a fixed definition. Because superintelligence could be so powerful, keeping it aligned with human interests is the core question for labs like SSI.

title.zh: 「後訓練」：讓模型從會說話到會做事

body.zh: 模型的「預訓練」是讀大量文字學會語言；「後訓練」則是之後的加強課程：用範例和回饋教它遵守指令、專精某領域、或學會使用工具。很多模型的實用程度，其實取決於後訓練做得好不好。
body.en: Pre-training teaches a model language from vast text; post-training is the follow-up course — examples and feedback teaching it to follow instructions, specialize or use tools. How useful a model is often depends on post-training.

body.en: Thinking Machines raised US$2B at seed — a former OpenAI CTO founding her own lab reflects how talent spinouts are reshaping the industry.

title.zh: 估值談判的起伏
title.en: Valuation talks that ebbed and flowed

body.zh: 報導指它曾尋求 500 億美元估值未果，之後洽談約 400 億美元。即使在 AI 熱潮中，估值也不是只漲不跌。
body.en: It reportedly sought US$50B without success, then discussed ~US$40B — even in the AI boom, valuations don't only go up.

title.zh: 賣工具給研究者

body.zh: Tinker 讓研究者不用管 GPU 叢集就能微調開放模型。把複雜的基礎設施包裝成簡單服務，是 AI 基礎建設公司的重要商業模式。
body.en: Tinker lets researchers fine-tune open models without managing GPU clusters — packaging complex infrastructure as a simple service is a key AI business model.

title.zh: 站在開源巨人的肩膀上

body.zh: 官方說明 Inkling 是從零訓練的模型，架構大致沿用 DeepSeek-V3；後訓練初期也用了包含 Kimi K2.5 在內的開放模型產生的合成資料。開放模型公開的架構與輸出，讓後進者能更快追上——這也是開源 AI 的力量。
body.en: Thinking Machines says Inkling was trained from scratch on an architecture largely following DeepSeek-V3, and early post-training used synthetic data from open models including Kimi K2.5. Open architectures and outputs let newcomers catch up faster — the power of open-source AI.

plain.zh: 幫企業把 AI 模型「上線服務」的推論平台，讓模型穩定、快速又省錢地回應大量使用者。
plain.en: An inference platform that helps companies serve AI models to many users reliably, quickly and cheaply.

impact.en: Exploding inference demand made inference-focused platforms a new hotspot in AI infrastructure.

details.zh: 訓練好模型只是第一步，真正花錢的是每天服務使用者的「推論」。Baseten 專做這一段：自動調度 GPU、加快回應、控制成本。報導指其年化營收在 2026 年第一季從約 2 億美元成長到約 6 億美元。
details.en: Training a model is just the start; serving users every day — inference — is where money goes. Baseten focuses there: scheduling GPUs, speeding responses and controlling cost. Reports say its run-rate grew from ~US$200M to ~US$600M in Q1 2026.

title.zh: 推論的成本帳：GPU 不能閒著
title.en: The economics of inference: idle GPUs cost money

body.zh: GPU 很貴，按時間計費。如果使用量忽高忽低，GPU 常常閒置就是浪費；尖峰時又可能不夠用。推論平台的價值在於自動「擴縮容」：人多時多開 GPU，人少時關掉，讓每一顆 GPU 都盡量在工作。
body.en: GPUs are costly and billed by time. Uneven traffic leaves them idle (waste) or overloaded at peaks. An inference platform autoscales — adding GPUs when busy, releasing them when quiet — so every GPU stays productive.

details.zh: 三位前商品交易員在 2017 年創業，一開始是用 GPU 挖以太幣。2022 年以太坊改制後挖礦不再划算，他們把手上的 GPU 和機房經驗轉去做 AI 雲端，剛好趕上 ChatGPT 帶起的 AI 熱潮。現在它是規模最大的「Neocloud」之一。
details.en: Three former commodities traders started it in 2017 to mine Ethereum with GPUs. When Ethereum's 2022 overhaul ended mining, they pointed those GPUs and data-center skills at AI — just as ChatGPT set off the boom. It is now one of the largest "neoclouds".

title.zh: 為什麼挖礦公司能變成 AI 公司？
title.en: How did a crypto miner become an AI company?

body.zh: 關鍵在「平行運算」。CPU 像幾位博士，擅長一步一步解難題；GPU 像幾千位小學生，每人只做簡單算術，但可以同時一起算。挖加密貨幣和訓練 AI 都是「超大量簡單計算」，所以同一批 GPU、同一套機房管理技術，可以從挖礦直接轉去跑 AI。
body.en: The key is parallel computing. A CPU is like a few PhDs solving one hard problem step by step; a GPU is like thousands of students each doing simple arithmetic at the same time. Crypto mining and AI training are both "huge piles of simple math", so the same GPUs and data-center know-how moved straight from mining to AI.

title.zh: 借錢蓋機房：AI 基建的槓桿風險
title.en: Borrowing to build: the leverage risk

body.zh: CoreWeave 預估 2026 年資本支出 350–390 億美元，大約是當年營收的三倍，主要靠舉債。第二季利息支出約 6.4 億美元。當利率上升、債券殖利率飆到約 15%～16%，借錢成本變高，股價就跟著重挫。這說明 AI 機房生意的關鍵不只是需求，還有「錢從哪裡來、要付多少利息」。
body.en: CoreWeave expects US$35–39B of 2026 capex — about three times its revenue — funded largely with debt, and Q2 interest expense was ~US$640M. When rates rise and bond yields hit ~15–16%, borrowing gets pricier and the stock tumbles. In AI data centers, the question is not only demand but where the money comes from and what it costs.

title.zh: 訂單很多，客戶很集中

body.zh: 未完成訂單超過 1,000 億美元，看起來前景明確；但 2024 年 Microsoft 就占營收 62%，OpenAI 也簽了大合約。少數大客戶撐起大部分生意，一旦客戶改變策略，影響會很大。
body.en: A backlog above US$100B looks like clear visibility, but Microsoft was 62% of 2024 revenue and OpenAI holds a giant contract. When a few customers carry the business, any change in their plans hits hard.

title.zh: 「循環融資」爭議

body.zh: NVIDIA 投資 CoreWeave，CoreWeave 用錢買 NVIDIA 的 GPU，NVIDIA 也承諾向 CoreWeave 購買算力服務。支持者認為這是在扶植客戶；批評者擔心這種「錢在圈內轉」的交易會把需求放大，增加泡沫風險。
body.en: NVIDIA invests in CoreWeave, CoreWeave buys NVIDIA GPUs, and NVIDIA also commits to buying CoreWeave capacity. Supporters call it nurturing customers; critics worry such money-go-round deals inflate demand and bubble risk.

title.zh: 從出租 GPU 到賣軟體
title.en: From renting GPUs to selling software

body.zh: 單純出租 GPU 容易變成比價格的生意，所以 CoreWeave 收購 Weights & Biases、OpenPipe、Marimo 等開發工具，想讓客戶在它的平台上完成訓練、調校到部署，提高黏著度。
body.en: Plain GPU rental risks becoming a price war, so CoreWeave bought developer tools like Weights & Biases, OpenPipe and Marimo to keep customers on its platform from training through tuning to deployment.

plain.zh: 自稱「AI 工廠公司」的雲端業者，負責蓋 OpenAI 星際之門的第一座園區。
plain.en: A self-described "AI factory company" that built the first Stargate campus for OpenAI.

nvidiaBond.zh: NVIDIA 多次參與 Crusoe 募資，包括 2024 年 12 月與 2026 年的新一輪；Abilene 園區部署的是 NVIDIA 系統。
nvidiaBond.en: NVIDIA has joined several Crusoe rounds, including Dec 2024 and 2026; the Abilene campus runs NVIDIA systems.

impact.zh: 示範「從空地到 GW 級 AI 園區」可以多快完成，是星際之門計畫的關鍵執行者。
impact.en: Showed how fast an empty site can become a gigawatt AI campus — a key executor of Stargate.

dialogue.zh: 荒地給我，還你一座 AI 城。
dialogue.en: Give me open land, I'll give you an AI city.

title.zh: 先找電，再蓋機房
title.en: Find the power first, then build

body.zh: 一座 1 GW 的 AI 園區，用電量相當於一座大型發電廠。很多地方電網根本供應不了。所以新一代 AI 資料中心業者常常先找有充足電力、土地與冷卻條件的地點，再把 GPU 搬過去——能源，已經是 AI 的第一道門檻。
body.en: A 1 GW AI campus uses as much power as a large power plant, which many grids can't supply. So new AI builders often hunt for sites with ample power, land and cooling first, then bring the GPUs — energy is now AI's first gate.

title.zh: 估值一年三倍

body.zh: Crusoe 從約 100 億美元漲到約 300 億美元。能把空地快速變成 GW 級 AI 園區的能力，在電力與土地稀缺的時代極具價值。
body.en: Crusoe went from ~US$10B to ~US$30B — turning empty land into gigawatt AI campuses fast is extremely valuable when power and land are scarce.

title.zh: 債務撐起 AI 園區

body.zh: Abilene 園區由 Crusoe 與 Blue Owl 等合資，向摩根大通主導的銀行團取得兩筆共約 94 億美元貸款支應建設。AI 基礎建設的資金，越來越多來自銀行與私募信貸。
body.en: Abilene was financed by two JPMorgan-led loans totaling ~US$9.4B, raised by a venture of Crusoe, Blue Owl and partners — AI infrastructure increasingly runs on bank and private credit.

title.zh: 客戶不只 AI 實驗室

body.zh: 報導指 Crusoe 和量化交易公司 Jane Street 簽下約 130 億美元、五年的雲端合約。金融業的大量運算需求，也成為 Neocloud 的重要客源。
body.en: Crusoe reportedly signed a ~US$13B five-year cloud deal with trading firm Jane Street — finance's heavy compute needs are a key neocloud market too.

title.zh: 客戶一句話，GW 級工程就暫停
title.en: One customer's word pauses a gigawatt project

body.zh: 懷俄明 1.8 GW 園區「應客戶要求」暫停，說明 AI 基建高度依賴少數大客戶的計畫。客戶策略一變，數十億美元的工程也可能喊停。
body.en: Wyoming's 1.8 GW campus paused "at the request of our customer" — AI build-outs hinge on a few big customers' plans, and billion-dollar projects can stop when strategies shift.

plain.zh: 美國 AI 雲端公司，2026 年在亞美尼亞開設獨立國協地區最大的 AI 工廠。
plain.en: A US AI cloud company that opened the largest AI factory in the CIS region, in Armenia, in 2026.

nvidiaBond.zh: Hrazdan AI 工廠以 NVIDIA 技術與 DSX 平台打造；NVIDIA 表示打算直接投資 Firebird，並支援其約 2 GW 的區域布局。
nvidiaBond.en: The Hrazdan AI factory is built on NVIDIA technology and its DSX platform; NVIDIA intends to invest directly and supports Firebird's ~2 GW regional roadmap.

impact.zh: 把 AI 算力帶到過去較少被關注的地區，展現 AI 基礎建設的地緣影響力。
impact.en: Brings AI compute to under-served regions, showing the geopolitics of AI infrastructure.

dialogue.zh: 浴火而生，把算力帶到新大陸。
dialogue.en: Born from fire, carrying compute to new lands.

title.zh: GPU 不是想買就能買：出口管制
title.en: GPUs aren't freely for sale: export controls

body.zh: 最先進的 AI 晶片受美國出口管制，要出貨到某些國家必須申請許可。所以在新地區蓋 AI 工廠，不只是工程問題，也牽涉外交與政策。Firebird 在亞美尼亞的計畫，就被視為一種「算力外交」。
body.en: The most advanced AI chips fall under US export controls, needing licences for some countries. Building AI factories in new regions is diplomacy as much as engineering — Firebird's Armenia project has been called compute diplomacy.

body.en: CoreWeave is a strategic backer of Firebird — leading neoclouds now invest in newcomers, carrying know-how and supply ties into new markets.

title.zh: 六個月蓋好 AI 工廠
title.en: An AI factory in six months

body.zh: Hrazdan 園區約六個多月就建成。NVIDIA 的 DSX 平台把運算、網路、電力與冷卻一起設計，縮短了建置時間。
body.en: Hrazdan was built in just over six months — NVIDIA's DSX platform co-designs compute, networking, power and cooling to cut build times.

title.zh: 把 AI 帶到新地區

body.zh: 亞美尼亞與哈薩克過去不是 AI 重鎮。Firebird 的計畫說明：只要有電力、政策支持與出口許可，AI 算力可以在新地區快速落地。
body.en: Armenia and Kazakhstan weren't AI hubs. Firebird shows that with power, policy support and export licences, AI compute can land fast in new regions.

title.zh: 電力是小國 AI 的天花板
title.en: Power caps a small country's AI

body.zh: Firebird 目標 300 MW，但亞美尼亞總理在 2026 年 6 月表示國家已不像過去有多餘電力。AI 工廠的規模，最終取決於當地電網能供應多少電。
body.en: Firebird targets 300 MW, but Armenia's prime minister said in June 2026 the country no longer has its old power surplus — AI factory scale ultimately depends on the local grid.

plain.zh: 專做 AI 推論的雲端平台，讓企業用開放模型打造又快又便宜的 AI 服務。
plain.en: An AI inference cloud letting companies build fast, affordable AI services on open models.

nvidiaBond.zh: NVIDIA 從 B 輪起就是投資人，也參與 2026 年 D 輪；Fireworks 亦為 OpenShell 夥伴。
nvidiaBond.en: NVIDIA has invested since the Series B and joined the 2026 Series D; Fireworks is also an OpenShell partner.

impact.zh: 讓開放模型在商用上更有競爭力，降低企業使用 AI 的成本。
impact.en: Makes open models more competitive commercially, lowering AI costs for businesses.

dialogue.zh: 快如煙火，一閃就到！
dialogue.en: Fast as fireworks — there in a flash!

title.zh: 同一顆 GPU，怎麼服務更多人？
title.en: How does one GPU serve more people?

body.zh: 推論優化有幾招：把多個使用者的請求「批次」一起算；用較低精度的數字（量化）減少計算量；預先猜測下一個字加速生成。這些技巧讓同樣的 GPU 回答更多問題，直接降低每次回答的成本。
body.en: Inference tricks include batching many users' requests together, using lower-precision numbers (quantization), and speculatively guessing upcoming tokens. Together they let the same GPU answer more queries, cutting cost per answer.

title.zh: 九個月估值四倍

body.zh: Fireworks 估值從 40 億美元漲到 175 億美元，年化營收突破 10 億美元。推論平台已成為 AI 產業成長最快的類別之一。
body.en: Fireworks went from US$4B to US$17.5B, with run-rate past US$1B — inference platforms are among AI's fastest-growing categories.

title.zh: 毛利率比軟體低

body.zh: 報導指其毛利率約 50%，低於一般訂閱軟體的 70% 以上。原因是推論服務要支付大量 GPU 成本，是「軟體＋基礎設施」的混合生意。
body.en: Reports put its gross margin near 50%, below the 70%+ of typical SaaS — inference pays heavy GPU costs, making it a software-plus-infrastructure hybrid.

title.zh: NVIDIA 既是投資人也是對手

body.zh: 報導指出 Fireworks 面臨的對手之一就是 NVIDIA 自己的推論服務。NVIDIA 同時扶植推論新創、也自己做推論，關係很微妙。
body.en: Reports note one of Fireworks' rivals is NVIDIA's own inference offering — NVIDIA both backs inference startups and competes with them.

title.zh: 「客製模型」才是主流用量

body.zh: Fireworks 約 95% 的流量來自客戶用自家資料微調的模型。企業要的不是一個萬能模型，而是很多個為自己工作量身打造的模型。
body.en: About 95% of Fireworks' traffic runs on models customers fine-tuned with their own data — enterprises want many models tailored to their work, not one universal model.

impact.en: Represents sovereign AI compute in the southern hemisphere — and a reminder of AI build-out execution risk.

title.zh: 「宣布產能」和「實際上線」的差距
title.en: Announced capacity vs. what actually gets built

body.zh: AI 熱潮中，很多計畫一宣布就是幾 GW、幾百億。但土地、電力、資金和供應鏈任何一環卡住，計畫都可能縮水或喊停。看新聞時，要分清楚「規劃」、「動工」和「已上線」的數字。
body.en: In the AI boom, many projects are announced at gigawatts and tens of billions. But land, power, financing or supply-chain snags can shrink or cancel them. In the news, distinguish planned, under construction and online.

title.zh: 大計畫的執行風險

body.zh: Project Southgate 原計畫 1.6 GW，最終只建成約 42 MW 就終止合作。AI 基建熱潮中，宣布與實際建成之間常有巨大落差。
body.en: Project Southgate targeted 1.6 GW but ended after ~42 MW — in the AI build-out, announcements and reality can diverge sharply.

title.zh: 私募信貸湧入 AI

body.zh: Blackstone 領頭的 100 億美元債務額度，顯示私募信貸基金正大舉借錢給 AI 基礎建設。這讓擴張更快，也讓風險分布到金融體系。
body.en: A US$10B Blackstone-led facility shows private credit lending heavily to AI infrastructure — faster expansion, with risk spreading into the financial system.

title.zh: 南半球的主權算力

body.zh: Firmus 代表澳洲發展本地 AI 算力的努力。即使合作生變，墨爾本 AI 工廠的 GB300 合約仍讓它保有實際營運的基礎。
body.en: Firmus represents Australia's push for local AI compute — even after the partnership change, its Melbourne GB300 contract keeps real operations going.

title.zh: 一個月內從爆量到撤件

body.zh: Firmus 的 IPO 一開始傳出認購超額，但投資人質疑 440 億澳元估值，加上與 CDC 的合作終止，信心快速消退，最後撤回上市。AI 基礎設施公司雖熱門，公開市場仍會檢驗估值是否合理。
body.en: Firmus's IPO was first said to be oversubscribed, but doubts about an A$44B valuation and the end of the CDC partnership drained confidence until the listing was pulled. Public markets still test AI infrastructure valuations.

plain.en: A US GPU cloud spanning the US and Asia-Pacific, building AI data centers in Taiwan — one of NVIDIA's top-tier cloud partners.

body.en: NVIDIA has 100+ cloud partners worldwide in different tiers. Top-tier Reference Platform partners build full systems to NVIDIA's reference design and pass certification, often getting next-gen GPUs earlier — a key credential for winning big customers.

title.zh: 台灣在地的大型 GPU 雲端
title.en: A large local GPU cloud for Taiwan

body.zh: GMI 在台灣投資 5 億美元建 AI 資料中心，讓台灣企業不必把資料送到海外就能使用大量 GPU。這對重視資料主權的產業特別重要。
body.en: GMI's US$500M Taiwan AI data center lets Taiwanese firms use large GPU fleets without sending data abroad — vital for data-sovereignty-minded industries.

title.zh: 台灣銀行業也投入

body.zh: GMI 的信貸由中國信託領頭。台灣金融業開始為 AI 基礎建設提供資金，也讓本地 AI 生態更完整。
body.en: CTBC led GMI's credit facility — Taiwanese finance is now funding AI infrastructure, rounding out the local AI ecosystem.

title.zh: 跨國主權 AI

body.zh: GMI 同時推動台灣與日本鹿兒島的 AI 工廠，串起台美日。主權 AI 不一定是單一國家的事，也可以是盟友間的分工。
body.en: GMI is building AI factories in Taiwan and Kagoshima, Japan, linking Taiwan, the US and Japan — sovereign AI can be shared among allies, not just one nation.

title.zh: 租機房比自己蓋快

body.zh: GMI 在台灣是租用 Vantage 的機房放 GPU，而不是自己蓋建築。Neocloud 搶的是時間：先租現成電力與空間，GPU 才能早點上線賺錢。
body.en: GMI leases space at Vantage's Taipei facility rather than building its own — neoclouds race the clock, renting ready power and space so GPUs earn sooner.

title.zh: 轉型期的陣痛

body.zh: IREN 最近一季營收年減約 27%，股價從 5 月約 68 美元跌到 10 月約 25 美元。比特幣挖礦收入下降、AI 雲端營收尚未完全接上，是轉型公司常見的空窗期。
body.en: IREN's latest quarter revenue fell ~27% and its shares slid from ~US$68 in May to ~US$25 in October. Mining revenue is fading before AI cloud revenue fully arrives — a common gap for pivoting companies.

title.zh: 一張合約撐起轉型

body.zh: 微軟 97 億美元合約是 IREN 轉型的關鍵，但合約要求準時交付。能否在 Childress 按時部署 GB300，直接決定這次轉型成敗。
body.en: Microsoft's US$9.7B contract anchors IREN's pivot, but it demands on-time delivery. Deploying GB300s at Childress on schedule will decide whether the pivot succeeds.

title.zh: 市場看法分歧

body.zh: IREN 從比特幣挖礦轉型做 AI 雲，股價波動很大，反映市場對轉型能否成功的看法非常分歧。
body.en: IREN is pivoting from bitcoin mining to AI cloud, and its volatile share price reflects deep disagreement over whether the pivot will succeed.

title.zh: 大廠為什麼要向 Neocloud 買算力？
title.en: Why do giants buy compute from neoclouds?

body.zh: 微軟、Meta 自己也蓋資料中心，但蓋一座要好幾年。向 Nebius 這類 Neocloud 簽長約，可以更快拿到現成的 GPU，也把部分建設風險轉給別人。對 Neocloud 來說，大廠長約是向銀行借錢擴產的底氣。
body.en: Microsoft and Meta build their own data centers, but each takes years. Long contracts with neoclouds like Nebius get ready GPUs faster and shift some build risk. For neoclouds, those contracts are what banks lend against.

body.en: Nebius's latest quarter revenue grew ~4.5×, yet it trades above 100× earnings. Markets are pricing years of big contracts ahead — any delivery slip could swing the stock sharply.

title.zh: NVIDIA 入股的雙重意義

body.zh: NVIDIA 以 20 億美元取得約 8.3% 股權，並一起規劃 5 GW 以上的部署。這既是對 Nebius 的背書，也確保 NVIDIA 的新世代 GPU 有大客戶持續採購。
body.en: NVIDIA's US$2B for ~8.3% plus a 5 GW+ deployment plan is both an endorsement and a guarantee that NVIDIA's next-gen GPUs have a committed big buyer.

title.zh: 不只是 GPU 出租

body.zh: Nebius 源自俄羅斯網路公司 Yandex 的國際業務，旗下還有資料標註、自駕與教育等事業。多元業務讓它和純 GPU 出租業者不太一樣。
body.en: Nebius emerged from Yandex's international businesses and also holds stakes in data labeling, autonomous driving and education ventures — unlike pure GPU renters.

title.zh: 「簽約電力」不等於「上線算力」

body.zh: Nebius 的 5 GW 是已有土地與電力承諾的容量，2026 年預計實際接電的只有約 0.8～1 GW。看 Neocloud 新聞時，要分清楚「簽約」、「接電」與「已出租」的數字。
body.en: Nebius's 5 GW is land-and-power commitments; only ~0.8–1 GW is expected to be connected in 2026. In neocloud news, distinguish contracted, connected and rented capacity.

body.en: GPUs are valuable, so neoclouds borrow against them to buy more. Nscale secured a US$1.4B GPU-backed loan. It speeds expansion — but if GPUs lose value fast or customers don't renew, risks multiply.

body.en: Former Meta COO Sheryl Sandberg and former UK deputy PM Nick Clegg joined Nscale's board — tech and policy expertise, reflecting how tied AI build-outs are to government.

body.en: Loughton faltered as grid power may not arrive until the 2030s — whether AI data centers get built increasingly depends on the grid, not chips or money.

title.zh: 「實體清單」是什麼？

body.zh: 美國商務部的「實體清單」列出被認為有國安疑慮的公司。美國企業要賣先進技術（例如 AI 晶片）給這些公司，必須先取得許可。所以 AI 伺服器生意不只看技術和價格，也要看客戶與股東背景是否合規。
body.en: The US Commerce Department's Entity List names firms seen as national-security risks; selling them advanced tech like AI chips requires a licence. So AI-server business depends on compliance — who the customers and owners are — not just tech and price.

title.zh: 整櫃系統的型號怎麼讀

body.zh: 伺服器廠常用型號區分 GPU 平台與散熱方式：同一顆 HGX B300 主機板，可以做成氣冷版（較好部署）或液冷版（密度更高、更省電）。選哪一種，取決於客戶機房能不能接液冷管路。
body.en: Server makers use model numbers to separate GPU platforms and cooling: the same HGX B300 board ships as an air-cooled box (easier to deploy) or liquid-cooled (denser, more efficient). The choice depends on whether the customer's data center has liquid plumbing.

title.zh: 品牌廠的毛利優勢

body.zh: 華碩最近四季毛利率約 15.7%，遠高於純代工廠（例如英業達約 4.8%、和碩約 4.3%）。原因是它賣自有品牌的筆電、主機板，加價空間較大；AI 伺服器比重上升後，毛利率會不會被稀釋，是觀察重點。
body.en: ASUS's trailing gross margin is ~15.7%, far above pure contract makers (Inventec ~4.8%, Pegatron ~4.3%), thanks to its own-brand PCs and motherboards. Whether rising AI-server mix dilutes that margin is the thing to watch.

title.zh: 從電競到 AI 伺服器

body.zh: 第二季伺服器營收年增近 200%，約九成是 AI 伺服器。華碩用主機板起家的設計能力，切入整櫃 GB300 NVL72 與桌上型 AI 電腦，是台灣品牌廠轉型的代表。
body.en: Q2 server revenue rose nearly 200%, about 90% of it AI. ASUS leverages its motherboard design roots to move into GB300 NVL72 racks and desktop AI computers — a model for Taiwanese brand makers.

title.zh: 持股串起台灣供應鏈
title.en: Stakes that tie Taiwan's supply chain together

body.zh: 華碩持有和碩約 16.7%（和碩 2008 年從華碩分拆）與研華約 13%。這些交叉持股讓台灣電子業形成緊密網絡，也讓華碩間接受惠夥伴的成長。
body.en: ASUS holds ~16.7% of Pegatron (spun off from ASUS in 2008) and ~13% of Advantech. Such cross-holdings knit Taiwan's electronics industry together and let ASUS share in partners' growth.

title.zh: HGX 與整櫃的比重

body.zh: 華碩 AI 伺服器約六成是 HGX（8 顆 GPU 的主機板模組），三成是 GB300 NVL72 這類整櫃。HGX 交期短、客戶多元；整櫃單價高、但需要液冷與機房整合能力。比重變化能看出廠商往哪個方向升級。
body.en: About 60% of ASUS AI server revenue is HGX (8-GPU baseboards) and ~30% full racks like GB300 NVL72. HGX ships faster to a broad base; racks carry higher ticket sizes but need liquid cooling and integration skills — the mix shows where a vendor is heading.

title.zh: 伺服器需要大量週轉資金

body.zh: 華碩發行 15 億美元可轉債與 11 億美元交換債（以研華持股為標的），合計約 26 億美元，為 AI 伺服器與 AI PC 擴張備足資金。整櫃伺服器動輒數百萬美元一櫃，代工廠必須先墊錢買 GPU 等料件，等客戶驗收才收款，因此財務能力也是競爭力。
body.en: ASUS raised ~US$2.6B via a US$1.5B convertible bond and a US$1.1B exchangeable bond backed by its Advantech stake, funding AI server and AI PC expansion. Each rack costs millions; vendors pre-buy GPUs and parts and get paid after acceptance, so balance-sheet strength is a competitive edge.

After Atos's financial troubles, the French state signed a deal in July 2025 and completed the purchase on March 31, 2026 for an enterprise value of up to ~€404M, preserving sovereign supercomputing and AI capability. JUPITER was built by Bull (then Eviden) with ParTec at Germany's Jülich Supercomputing Centre.

title.zh: Exascale 有多快？

body.zh: 「Exascale」是每秒能做 10¹⁸ 次（百億億次）浮點運算。若全世界 80 億人每秒算一次，要算上約 4 年，才等於 exascale 電腦 1 秒的計算量。這種機器用於氣候模擬、新藥研發，也越來越多用來訓練 AI。
body.en: Exascale means 10¹⁸ calculations per second. If all 8 billion people did one calculation per second, it would take about 4 years to match one second of an exascale machine. They model climate, design drugs — and increasingly train AI.

title.zh: 歐洲科技主權的象徵
title.en: A symbol of European tech sovereignty

body.zh: JUPITER 由歐洲出資、歐洲廠商打造，雖然核心晶片仍來自 NVIDIA。歐洲想在 AI 和超算保有自主能力，Bull 這類本土系統整合商就格外重要。
body.en: JUPITER was funded and built in Europe, though its core chips come from NVIDIA. For Europe's push for AI and HPC autonomy, homegrown integrators like Bull matter a lot.

title.zh: 液冷技術的老手

body.zh: Bull 的 BullSequana 系統長期採用直接液冷。在 AI 機櫃功耗飆升的時代，超算業者累積的液冷經驗，正被整個 AI 產業借鏡。
body.en: Bull's BullSequana systems have long used direct liquid cooling. As AI rack power soars, supercomputing's liquid-cooling experience is being borrowed across the AI industry.

title.zh: 超級電腦被視為國家資產

body.zh: 法國政府把 Bull 收歸國有，是因為它能設計製造超級電腦，牽涉核能模擬、國防與氣候研究。AI 與高效能運算越來越被當作戰略產業，各國不願讓關鍵能力落入外國手中。
body.en: France nationalized Bull because it designs and builds supercomputers used for nuclear simulation, defense and climate research — AI and HPC are increasingly strategic, and states won't let key capabilities go abroad.

details.zh: 戴爾的「Dell AI Factory」和 NVIDIA 合作，幫企業和主權 AI 客戶在自家機房部署 AI。它也替 IREN、Firebird 等雲端業者供應 NVIDIA 系統。執行長表示，記憶體（DRAM、NAND）供應限制仍是瓶頸。
details.en: Dell's AI Factory with NVIDIA helps enterprises and sovereign-AI clients deploy AI on-premises, and it supplies NVIDIA systems to clouds like IREN and Firebird. Management says memory (DRAM, NAND) supply remains a constraint.

title.zh: AI 伺服器的新瓶頸：記憶體

body.zh: 一台 AI 伺服器除了 GPU，還需要大量 HBM、DRAM 和固態硬碟。AI 熱潮讓記憶體需求暴增、價格上漲，就算 GPU 到貨，記憶體不夠也出不了貨。這說明 AI 供應鏈任何一環卡住，都會拖慢整體。
body.en: AI servers need lots of HBM, DRAM and SSDs besides GPUs. The AI boom has sent memory demand and prices soaring — even with GPUs in hand, short memory stalls shipments. Any weak link slows the whole AI chain.

title.zh: AI 讓老牌 PC 廠重新起飛
title.en: AI relaunched a veteran PC maker

body.zh: 戴爾最近一季營收年增約 58%，AI 伺服器全年預估 740 億美元。對一家以 PC 起家的公司來說，AI 伺服器已經成為最大的成長引擎，股價在 2026 年也大幅上漲。
body.en: Dell's latest quarter revenue rose ~58% and AI servers are guided to US$74B for the year. For a PC-born company, AI servers are now the biggest growth engine, and its stock surged in 2026.

title.zh: 賣給企業，不只賣給雲端大廠
title.en: Selling to enterprises, not just hyperscalers

body.zh: 和多數台灣代工廠主攻雲端大廠不同，戴爾還有龐大的企業與政府客戶。「Dell AI Factory」讓一般企業在自家機房部署 AI，這塊市場若擴大，AI 需求會從少數巨頭擴散到各行各業。
body.en: Unlike Taiwanese makers focused on hyperscalers, Dell also serves vast enterprise and government customers. Its AI Factory lets ordinary companies deploy AI on-premises — if that grows, AI demand spreads from a few giants to every industry.

title.zh: 訂單多不等於出得了貨

body.zh: 950 億美元的未出貨訂單很驚人，但執行長也坦言記憶體供應仍是限制。AI 供應鏈任何一環卡住，訂單就無法轉成營收——這是觀察 AI 伺服器廠時常被忽略的風險。
body.en: A US$95B backlog is staggering, but management says memory supply still constrains output. When any link in the AI chain jams, orders can't become revenue — an often-overlooked risk for server makers.

title.zh: AI 也帶動「傳統」伺服器

body.zh: 戴爾的傳統伺服器與網路營收年增 122%。AI Agent 需要大量 CPU 伺服器來跑工具、資料庫與網頁服務，加上舊機房汰換，非 GPU 伺服器也一起成長。
body.en: Dell's traditional servers and networking grew 122%. AI agents need lots of CPU servers to run tools, databases and web services, plus data-center refreshes — non-GPU servers are growing too.

plain.zh: 台灣的鴻海集團，全球最大的電子代工廠；現在 AI 伺服器已是它最重要的成長動能。
plain.en: Taiwan's Hon Hai — the world's largest electronics contract maker, now powered largely by AI servers.

nvidiaBond.zh: 2023 年雙方宣布合作打造「AI 工廠」：用 NVIDIA 的晶片和網路組裝伺服器賣給全球客戶，也在電動車（DRIVE Hyperion）和工廠機器人（Isaac）上採用 NVIDIA 平台。
nvidiaBond.en: In 2023 they teamed up to build "AI factories": servers built on NVIDIA chips and networking for customers worldwide, plus NVIDIA platforms for its EVs (DRIVE Hyperion) and factory robots (Isaac).

impact.zh: NVIDIA 設計晶片，但要有人把它們大量做成整櫃機器。代工廠的產能和良率，直接決定全世界能多快拿到 AI 算力，這也是台灣在 AI 供應鏈中的關鍵位置。
impact.en: NVIDIA designs the chips, but someone must mass-produce the racks. Assemblers' capacity and yields set how fast the world gets AI compute — a key reason Taiwan matters so much in the AI supply chain.

dialogue.zh: 一錘一櫃，準時交貨！
dialogue.en: One swing, one rack — always on time!

details.zh: 鴻海過去以替 Apple 組裝 iPhone 聞名。AI 熱潮後，它成為 NVIDIA 整櫃 AI 伺服器的主要組裝廠之一，把 GPU、CPU、網路、散熱與電源整合成可以直接上線的機櫃，再出貨給雲端大廠。
details.en: Foxconn was long best known for assembling iPhones. In the AI boom it became one of the main assemblers of NVIDIA's rack-scale AI servers, integrating GPUs, CPUs, networking, cooling and power into ready-to-run racks for cloud giants.

title.zh: 現在的 AI 電腦，是一整個機櫃
title.en: Today's AI computer is a whole rack

body.zh: 以 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 為例：一個機櫃裡有 72 顆 Blackwell GPU 和 36 顆 Grace CPU，用 NVLink 高速連在一起，運作起來像「一顆超大 GPU」。整櫃耗電約 120 千瓦，必須用液體散熱。這麼複雜的東西，要靠鴻海這類廠商把上千個零件精準組裝、測試後才能出貨。
body.en: Take NVIDIA's GB200 NVL72: one rack holds 72 Blackwell GPUs and 36 Grace CPUs linked by NVLink so they act like one giant GPU. It draws about 120 kW and needs liquid cooling. Makers like Foxconn assemble and test thousands of parts before it ships.
