title.zh: 從 iPhone 工廠到 AI 工廠
title.en: From iPhone factory to AI factory

body.zh: 2026 年第二季，鴻海的雲端網路產品首度占營收一半以上（51%），超過手機等消費電子（29%）。全球最大的電子代工廠，主業已經從手機變成 AI 伺服器。
body.en: In Q2 2026 cloud and networking topped half of Foxconn's revenue (51%), overtaking consumer electronics like phones (29%). The world's largest electronics maker is now primarily an AI-server company.

title.zh: 市占四成的「機櫃一哥」

body.zh: 在 NVIDIA 整櫃 AI 伺服器組裝市場，鴻海市占四成以上，廣達、緯創等緊追在後。黃仁勳形容一櫃 GB300 有約 120 萬個零件、重近 2 噸，規模與良率決定誰能拿到下一代 Vera Rubin 的大單。
body.en: Foxconn assembles over 40% of NVIDIA's rack-scale AI servers, with Quanta and Wistron close behind. Jensen Huang has described a GB300 rack as ~1.2 million parts weighing nearly 2 tons — scale and yield decide who wins the next Vera Rubin orders.

title.zh: 把工廠蓋到美國

body.zh: 鴻海在德州休士頓替 NVIDIA 建 AI 超級電腦工廠，又和軟銀合作把俄亥俄廠轉做星際之門（Stargate）設備。美國關稅與「在地製造」政策，正在重畫 AI 供應鏈地圖。
body.en: Foxconn is building an AI-supercomputer plant for NVIDIA in Houston and turning its Ohio site into a Stargate equipment factory with SoftBank. US tariffs and onshoring policy are redrawing the AI supply-chain map.

title.zh: 營收大增，毛利仍薄

body.zh: 和廣達一樣，AI 伺服器讓營收大增，但毛利率只有約 6%。投資人更看重的是營業利益率改善（第二季 3.75%，年增 0.6 個百分點），代表規模效益開始出現。
body.en: As at Quanta, AI servers lift revenue while gross margin stays near 6%. Investors watch operating margin instead — 3.75% in Q2, up 0.6 points — as a sign of scale benefits.

plain.zh: 台灣的技嘉，以主機板、顯示卡起家，現在伺服器已占營收大宗，其中多數是 AI 伺服器。
plain.en: Taiwan's GIGABYTE, known for motherboards and graphics cards, now earns most revenue from servers — mostly AI.

impact.zh: 顯示台灣電子業從零組件、消費品往 AI 基礎建設轉型的趨勢。
impact.en: Shows Taiwan's electronics firms moving from components and consumer goods to AI infrastructure.

dialogue.zh: 一塊板到一整櫃，手藝不打折。

title.en: The server subsidiary is the growth engine

body.zh: 技嘉持有伺服器子公司技鋼科技（Giga Computing）約 84%。伺服器已占技嘉產品營收七成以上、其中 AI 伺服器超過八成，代表這家顯示卡廠的重心已經移到資料中心。
body.en: GIGABYTE owns ~84% of its server arm Giga Computing. Servers are over 70% of product revenue, more than 80% of it AI — the graphics-card maker's center of gravity has moved to data centers.

title.zh: 整櫃拉高營收、壓低毛利

body.zh: 最近四季毛利率約 10.4%，第二季因整櫃比重升高降到 9.6%。這是 AI 伺服器廠共通的「產品組合效應」：看營收成長的同時，也要看獲利金額有沒有跟上。
body.en: Trailing gross margin is ~10.4%, dipping to 9.6% in Q2 as racks grew. It's the shared mix effect of AI server makers: watch whether profit dollars keep pace with revenue.

title.zh: Neocloud 是新客戶群
title.en: Neoclouds are a new customer base

body.zh: 技嘉的 AI 伺服器有不少賣給 Neocloud 業者。Neocloud 擴張快、但財務槓桿高，客戶結構和大雲端不同，也讓供應商的風險分布不同。
body.en: Much of GIGABYTE's AI server volume goes to neoclouds — fast-growing but highly leveraged customers, giving it a different risk profile than suppliers to the big clouds.

title.zh: 世代交替的空窗期

body.zh: 每次 NVIDIA 換新一代平台（Blackwell → Rubin），伺服器廠要重新設計主機板、散熱與機櫃，並等客戶驗證。換代期間出貨可能放慢，換代後則可能一口氣放量，這是看 AI 伺服器股季度波動的關鍵。
body.en: Every NVIDIA platform shift (Blackwell → Rubin) means new boards, cooling and racks plus customer qualification. Shipments can pause during the transition and surge afterward — a key driver of quarterly swings in AI server stocks.

title.zh: 輕資產的伺服器廠

body.zh: 技嘉一年資本支出只有約 30 億新台幣，遠低於大型代工廠。它主要靠設計與快速出貨賺錢，而不是蓋大量工廠，這讓它能較快跟上 NVIDIA 新平台。
body.en: Gigabyte spends only ~NT$3B a year on capex, far below the big ODMs — it earns on design and speed to ship rather than factory scale, which helps it ride new NVIDIA platforms quickly.

title.zh: 網路是 AI 工廠的神經系統
title.en: Networking is the AI factory's nervous system

body.zh: AI 工廠裡有成千上萬顆 GPU，還要連到儲存、使用者和其他資料中心。網路一慢，GPU 就閒著；網路被攻破，整座工廠都有風險。所以伺服器廠紛紛加碼網路設備，NVIDIA 也賣自己的網路產品。
body.en: AI factories hold thousands of GPUs linked to storage, users and other sites. Slow networks idle GPUs; breached networks endanger the whole factory. So server makers invest in networking — and NVIDIA sells its own networking too.

title.zh: 用網路彎道超車

body.zh: HPE 以約 134 億美元收購 Juniper，網路業務規模倍增，並成為最大獲利來源。它的策略是：伺服器毛利薄，但連接 AI 工廠的網路與管理軟體，利潤和黏著度都更高。
body.en: HPE's ~US$13.4B Juniper deal doubled networking, now its largest profit source. The bet: servers carry thin margins, but the networks and software connecting AI factories are stickier and more profitable.

title.zh: 超級電腦 DNA

body.zh: HPE 旗下有 Cray 超級電腦品牌，長期替國家實驗室打造頂級系統。這些經驗——液冷、高速網路、大規模系統整合——正好是 AI 工廠需要的能力。
body.en: HPE owns the Cray brand and has long built top systems for national labs. That know-how — liquid cooling, fast interconnects, massive integration — is exactly what AI factories need.

title.zh: 股價 2026 年翻倍以上

body.zh: HPE 股價從 2 月約 20 美元漲到 10 月約 73 美元的高點，最近一季營收年增約 34%。市場開始把它視為 AI 網路與基礎設施的受惠者，而不只是傳統伺服器廠。
body.en: HPE rose from ~US$20 in February to a ~US$73 high in October, with latest-quarter revenue up ~34%. Markets now see it as an AI networking and infrastructure play, not just a legacy server maker.

title.zh: 訂單、營收、backlog 是三件事

body.zh: HPE 當季 AI 系統接到 24 億美元新訂單，但只認列約 16 億營收，剩下累積成 68 億美元未出貨訂單（backlog）。訂單代表需求，營收代表已交貨，backlog 代表未來幾季的營收來源。
body.en: HPE booked US$2.4B of AI system orders but recognized ~US$1.6B of revenue, leaving US$6.8B backlog. Orders show demand, revenue shows delivery, backlog shows revenue still to come.

title.zh: 薄利多銷的極致

body.zh: 英業達最近四季營收約 8,177 億元新台幣，毛利率卻只有約 4.8%。代工廠的競爭力在於規模、良率與交期，每一個百分點的毛利都很關鍵。
body.en: Inventec's trailing revenue is ~NT$817.7B but gross margin only ~4.8%. A contract maker competes on scale, yield and delivery — every margin point counts.

title.zh: 押注 ASIC 伺服器

body.zh: 英業達預估 2026 年 ASIC 伺服器將超過 AI 伺服器營收一半，並在美國德州設新線。若雲端大廠自研晶片持續擴大，英業達這類專做 ASIC 機櫃的廠商會是直接受惠者。
body.en: Inventec expects ASIC servers to exceed half its AI server revenue in 2026 and opened a new Texas line. If clouds keep expanding custom chips, ASIC-rack specialists like Inventec benefit directly.

title.zh: 全球布局分散風險

body.zh: 英業達在泰國、捷克、越南、墨西哥與美國都有子公司或產線。地緣政治與關稅變化下，「哪裡都能生產」本身就是競爭力。
body.en: Inventec has subsidiaries or plants in Thailand, Czechia, Vietnam, Mexico and the US. Amid geopolitics and tariffs, being able to build anywhere is itself a competitive edge.

title.zh: 整櫃越多，毛利率越低

body.zh: 英業達第二季毛利率從 5.08% 降到 4.23%，原因是整櫃出貨比重上升：整櫃裡的 GPU 等昂貴零件墊高營收，但代工廠能加的價有限。所以營收創新高、毛利率下降，兩者可以同時發生。
body.en: Inventec's gross margin slipped from 5.08% to 4.23% as rack shipments rose: pricey GPUs inflate revenue while the ODM's markup stays small — record revenue and falling margins can happen together.

details.zh: 聯想的 Neptune 液冷系統用最高約 45°C 的溫水散熱，公司宣稱比氣冷省電最多 40%。它和 NVIDIA 在 GTC 推出搭載 Neptune 的 ThinkSystem SR780a 伺服器，在 Top500、Green500 超級電腦榜上也名列前茅。
details.en: Lenovo's Neptune cools with water up to ~45°C, which it claims cuts power up to 40% vs. air. With NVIDIA it launched the Neptune-equipped ThinkSystem SR780a at GTC, and its systems rank high on the Top500 and Green500 lists.

title.zh: 為什麼用「溫水」也能散熱？
title.en: How can warm water cool chips?

body.zh: 晶片工作時可達 80°C 以上，所以 45°C 的水仍然比它冷，可以把熱帶走。用溫水的好處是不需要大量耗電的冰水機，還能把廢熱拿去供暖。這讓資料中心更省電，也更環保。
body.en: Chips run above 80°C, so 45°C water is still cooler and carries heat away. Warm water skips power-hungry chillers, and the waste heat can even warm buildings — saving energy and emissions.

body.en: Neptune warm-water cooling claims up to 40% power savings vs. air, with reusable waste heat. As AI's energy use becomes a public issue, efficiency itself sells.

title.zh: 「成長 10 倍」要怎麼看？低基期效應

body.zh: 如果去年只賣 1 塊，今年賣 10 塊，就是成長 10 倍。剛起步的業務因為「基期低」，成長率看起來會非常驚人。比較公司時，要同時看成長率和實際金額，才不會被數字誤導。

impact.en: Cloud giants don't want loose GPUs; they want racks that go live the moment they're plugged in. Quanta combines system integration, rack-level testing, liquid cooling and mass production, directly shaping how fast AI data centers come online — and its shift from notebooks to AI servers is the clearest example of Taiwan's electronics industry reinventing itself.

details.zh: 林百里與梁次震 1988 年共同創立廣達，從筆電代工起家，替 Apple、Dell 等品牌製造筆電，是全球筆電製造的領導廠商。2011 年它為 Facebook 製造開放運算計畫（OCP）首批伺服器，之後以雲達（QCT）品牌直接服務資料中心。AI 熱潮讓營收結構大翻轉：客戶以前五大雲端業者為主，2026 年新興雲端（Neocloud）的 GPU 伺服器、以及大型雲端客戶自研晶片（ASIC）的伺服器專案也開始小量出貨。值得注意的是，AI 伺服器單價高、毛利率卻只有約 5%；而且從 2026 年第三季起，部分高價零件改由客戶自行提供（代料），帳上營收成長可能因此放緩，但不代表出貨變少。
details.en: Barry Lam and C.C. Leung co-founded Quanta in 1988 as a notebook maker, building laptops for Apple, Dell and others and leading global notebook manufacturing. In 2011 it built the first Open Compute Project servers for Facebook, then served data centers directly under the QCT brand. AI flipped its revenue mix: the top five cloud providers are its main customers, and in 2026 GPU servers for neoclouds and big clouds' custom-chip (ASIC) server projects began small-volume shipments. Note the economics: AI servers carry huge price tags but only ~5% gross margin, and from Q3 2026 some high-value parts are customer-supplied (consignment), which can slow reported revenue growth without shrinking shipments.

title.zh: AI 伺服器的 L6 → L10 → L11 → L12
title.en: AI servers, level by level: L6 → L10 → L11 → L12

body.zh: 伺服器代工用「L 層級」描述交貨時做到哪一步。L6：把主機板裝進機殼、電源和風扇的半成品；L10：裝好 CPU、GPU、記憶體並完成測試、可以開機的完整伺服器；L11：把多台伺服器連同交換器、電源和液冷管路裝進一整個機櫃，接好線、整櫃測試後出貨；L12：多個機櫃串成叢集，連軟體一起驗證。黃仁勳形容一櫃 GB300 有 120 萬個零件、重近 2 噸，等於一座小型資料中心，所以現在 AI 伺服器的出貨主力是 L11。各廠商對每一層的範圍定義略有不同。
body.en: Server makers use "L levels" to describe how complete a delivery is. L6: a motherboard in a chassis with power and fans — a semi-finished unit. L10: a complete, tested server with CPUs, GPUs and memory that boots. L11: many servers plus switches, power and liquid-cooling lines installed in one rack, cabled and tested as a whole. L12: multiple racks joined into a cluster and validated with software. Jensen Huang described a GB300 rack as 1.2 million parts weighing nearly 2 tons — a small data center — which is why most AI servers now ship at L11. Exact scope varies by manufacturer.

title.zh: 賣得愈多，賺得愈薄？

body.zh: 2026 年第二季營收年增約一倍，毛利率卻只有約 5%。原因是 GPU 等昂貴零件的成本大多只是「經手」，代工廠真正賺的是整合、測試與良率。從第三季起部分零件改為客戶代料，帳上營收成長可能因此放緩，但不代表生意變差（第三季營收仍季增約 8%）。看 AI 代工股，要看獲利金額與每股盈餘，而不只是營收。
body.en: Q2 2026 revenue roughly doubled year on year, yet gross margin was only ~5%: costly parts like GPUs mostly pass through, and the real earnings come from integration, testing and yield. With some parts shifting to consignment from Q3, reported revenue growth may slow without the business weakening (Q3 revenue still rose ~8% QoQ). For AI server makers, watch profit and EPS — not just revenue.

title.zh: 不只押 NVIDIA，也押 ASIC
title.en: Betting on NVIDIA — and on ASICs

body.zh: 廣達的 AI 伺服器以 NVIDIA 整櫃系統為主，但 2026 年大型雲端客戶的自研晶片（ASIC）伺服器專案也開始小量出貨。對代工廠來說，不管最後是 GPU 還是 ASIC 勝出，晶片都需要有人做成整櫃，所以它站在「兩邊都賺」的位置。
body.en: Quanta's AI servers center on NVIDIA racks, but in 2026 it also began small-volume shipments of big clouds' custom-chip (ASIC) servers. Whichever wins — GPUs or ASICs — someone must turn chips into racks, so the server maker earns either way.

title.zh: 瓶頸從晶片變成電力與廠房
title.en: The bottleneck shifts from chips to power and plants

body.zh: 廣達把產能擴到美國、墨西哥、泰國，2026 年資本支出上修到 400 億元。雲達總經理楊麒令提到，美國田納西廠因電力限制，擴產較保守。AI 擴張的限制愈來愈不是「有沒有 GPU」，而是「有沒有電、有沒有地、能不能靠近客戶」。
body.en: Quanta is expanding in the US, Mexico and Thailand, with 2026 capex raised to NT$40B. QCT's president noted Tennessee expansion is cautious due to power limits. AI's constraint is increasingly not GPUs but power, land and proximity to customers.

title.zh: 代工廠也進入「重資本」時代

body.zh: 過去代工被視為輕資產；現在廣達發行約 21.6 億美元 GDR 籌資（2026 年 8 月完成）、簽約以約 197 億元購買華亞園區廠房。市場因此擔心股本稀釋與 AI 過度投資，股價從 6 月高點 438 元跌到 7 月 279 元。這反映投資人對 AI 基礎建設「錢要燒多久、回報何時來」的焦慮。
body.en: Contract manufacturing used to be asset-light. Now Quanta raised ~US$2.16B via GDRs (completed Aug 2026) agreed to spend ~NT$19.7B on Hwa Ya plants. Dilution and overinvestment fears sent shares from NT$438 in June to NT$279 in July — a window into investor anxiety over how long AI build-outs burn cash before paying off.

title.zh: 提前卡位下一個運算世代
title.en: Positioning for the next computing era

body.zh: 廣達把投資延伸到量子電腦（Quantinuum、Rigetti）、AI 智慧眼鏡（Vuzix）和機器人（達明）。其中 Quantinuum 那輪募資，NVIDIA 的創投部門也參與。代工廠用投資換取技術與未來訂單，是台灣供應鏈從「被動接單」走向「主動布局」的訊號。
body.en: Quanta has extended its bets to quantum computing (Quantinuum, Rigetti), AI smart glasses (Vuzix) and robotics (Techman). NVIDIA's venture arm joined the same Quantinuum round. Investing for technology and future orders signals Taiwan's supply chain moving from taking orders to shaping the future.

plain.zh: 美國伺服器製造商，擅長快速把最新的 NVIDIA 晶片做成整櫃機器，也是液冷散熱的推手。
plain.en: A US server maker that turns the newest NVIDIA chips into full racks fast, and a big champion of liquid cooling.

nvidiaBond.zh: 2025 年 2 月宣布全面量產採用 NVIDIA Blackwell（HGX B200）的整櫃系統，並配合液冷；9 月開始大量出貨 Blackwell Ultra 世代（HGX B300、GB300 NVL72）。
nvidiaBond.en: In February 2025 it reached full production of liquid-cooled racks built on NVIDIA Blackwell (HGX B200), and in September began volume shipments of Blackwell Ultra (HGX B300, GB300 NVL72).

impact.zh: 晶片越來越燙，散熱和電力變成 AI 擴張的瓶頸。液冷普及，決定新機房能裝多少 AI 算力。
impact.en: As chips run hotter, cooling and power become the bottleneck. Wider liquid cooling decides how much AI compute new data centers can hold.

dialogue.zh: 火裡鍛造，水裡冷卻，出爐就能上陣！
dialogue.en: Forged in fire, cooled in water, battle-ready out of the forge!

details.zh: Supermicro 用「積木式」設計，可以很快把新晶片組成各種伺服器，常常是最早推出 NVIDIA 新世代產品的廠商之一。它在矽谷有自己的工廠，並把散熱、電源、網路整套打包賣給機房。
details.en: Supermicro uses a building-block design to quickly turn new chips into many server types, and is often among the first to ship NVIDIA's latest generation. It builds in Silicon Valley and sells cooling, power and networking as one package.

title.zh: 為什麼 AI 機房要用「水」散熱？
title.en: Why do AI data centers cool with liquid?

body.zh: 一般辦公室伺服器一櫃耗電大約十幾千瓦，用風扇吹就夠。但一櫃 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 約 120 千瓦，熱到風扇吹不走。液冷是讓冷卻液流過貼在晶片上的金屬冷板，把熱直接帶走。這樣機櫃能塞進更多 GPU，也比較省電。
body.en: A typical server rack draws a dozen-odd kilowatts and fans are enough. A GB200 NVL72 rack draws about 120 kW — too hot for air. Liquid cooling runs coolant through metal cold plates on the chips to carry heat away, so racks can pack in more GPUs and use less energy.

title.zh: 速度是護城河

body.zh: Supermicro 的積木式設計讓它常常最早推出 NVIDIA 新世代產品。在 GPU 一年一代的節奏下，比對手早幾個月出貨，就可能拿下關鍵訂單。
body.en: Supermicro's building-block design often makes it first to ship NVIDIA's newest generation. With GPUs on a yearly cadence, shipping months earlier can win key orders.

title.zh: 美國在地製造的另一種模式

body.zh: 與台灣代工廠赴美設廠不同，Supermicro 本來就在矽谷生產，2025 年還宣布擴建第三座園區。在關稅與在地化壓力下，這是它的獨特優勢。
body.en: Unlike Taiwanese makers building new US plants, Supermicro already manufactures in Silicon Valley and announced a third campus in 2025 — a distinct advantage amid tariffs and onshoring.

title.zh: 賣「整座資料中心」提高毛利
title.en: Selling whole data centers lifts margins

body.zh: Supermicro 推 DCBBS（資料中心建構模組）：除了伺服器，也一起賣液冷、電力、網路與軟體服務。第四季毛利率回升到 17.5%，公司歸功於這種整套方案。從賣盒子轉向賣解決方案，是硬體廠提升獲利的常見路線。
body.en: Supermicro's DCBBS bundles servers with liquid cooling, power, networking and services; it credited the bundle for Q4 GAAP gross margin rebounding to 17.5%. Moving from boxes to solutions is a common path to better hardware margins.

title.zh: 在美國製造 AI 超級電腦

body.zh: NVIDIA 計畫四年內在美國生產最多約 5,000 億美元的 AI 基礎設施，夥伴包括台積電、鴻海、緯創、Amkor、矽品。原因包括關稅、供應鏈安全與貼近客戶。台灣廠商因此大舉赴美設廠，台灣的研發加上美國的組裝，成為新分工。
body.en: NVIDIA plans to produce up to ~US$500B of AI infrastructure in the US within four years with TSMC, Foxconn, Wistron, Amkor and SPIL — driven by tariffs, supply security and proximity to customers. Taiwanese firms are building US plants: Taiwanese R&D plus US assembly is the new division of labor.

body.en: Wistron's trailing revenue is ~NT$3.03 trillion, with Q2 revenue up ~62% and Q3 roughly doubling. Its early bet on NVIDIA GPU modules and boards put it on the AI wave.

title.zh: 緯創＋緯穎的雙引擎

body.zh: 緯創持有緯穎約 35%。緯創擅長 NVIDIA GPU 相關產品，緯穎專攻雲端大廠的 ASIC 客製伺服器——集團同時卡位 GPU 與 ASIC 兩條路線。
body.en: Wistron owns ~35% of Wiwynn. Wistron excels at NVIDIA GPU products while Wiwynn specializes in hyperscalers' custom ASIC servers — the group straddles both GPU and ASIC tracks.

title.zh: 美國製造的先行者

body.zh: NVIDIA 宣布在美國生產 AI 超級電腦時，點名鴻海與緯創。德州 D1 工廠已量產 GB300，還為 Vera Rubin 預留產線，緯創因此成為「美國製造」政策的核心執行者之一。
body.en: When NVIDIA announced US-made AI supercomputers it named Foxconn and Wistron. The Texas D1 plant already builds GB300 with lines reserved for Vera Rubin — making Wistron a core executor of Made-in-America policy.

title.zh: 代工費改按售價比例計算
title.en: ODM fees tied to selling price

body.zh: 外資報告指出，緯創與部分客戶改用「售價比例」計算代工附加價值。過去機櫃越貴，代工廠的利潤率越被稀釋；改成比例計算後，單價上升也能帶動代工利潤。這是 AI 伺服器代工商業模式的重要變化。（外資解讀，公司未逐條證實）
body.en: A brokerage report says Wistron and some customers now price ODM value-add as a share of selling price. Pricier racks used to dilute ODM margins; a percentage model lets profit scale with ASP — a notable shift in the AI ODM business model. (Broker interpretation, not confirmed line by line by the company.)

title.zh: 筆電變弱，伺服器撐起一切

body.zh: 緯創預期 2026 下半年筆電出貨年減 10%～20%，通用伺服器持平，成長幾乎都來自 AI 伺服器。一家公司內部，不同產品線的景氣可以完全相反。
body.en: Wistron expects H2 2026 notebook shipments down 10–20% and general servers flat — nearly all growth comes from AI servers. Within one company, product lines can move in opposite directions.

title.zh: 開放運算計畫（OCP）：雲端大廠的開源硬體
title.en: The Open Compute Project: open-source hardware for clouds

body.zh: OCP 是 Facebook 在 2011 年發起的社群，把資料中心伺服器、機櫃的設計公開分享，讓大家用更省電、更便宜的標準化硬體。雲端大廠可以依 OCP 規格找代工廠客製，緯穎就是這類代工的代表。
body.en: OCP, started by Facebook in 2011, openly shares data-center server and rack designs so everyone can use cheaper, more efficient standard hardware. Clouds order custom builds to OCP specs — Wiwynn is a prime example.

title.zh: 投資 AI 未來關鍵技術

body.zh: 緯穎持有 GPU 雲端業者 Lambda 與光學傳輸新創 Ayar Labs 的少量股權。Ayar Labs 做用光取代電線傳資料的晶片，若成功，可能解決 AI 機櫃內部頻寬與耗電的瓶頸。
body.en: Wiwynn holds small stakes in GPU cloud Lambda and optical-I/O startup Ayar Labs. Ayar Labs moves data with light instead of copper — if it works, it could ease bandwidth and power limits inside AI racks.

title.zh: ASIC 比重高是雙面刃
title.en: Heavy ASIC exposure cuts both ways

body.zh: 緯穎的 AI 營收約九成來自 ASIC 伺服器，高度綁定少數雲端大廠的自研晶片計畫。客戶擴產時成長快，客戶調整時也最先受影響。
body.en: About 90% of Wiwynn's AI revenue comes from ASIC servers, tied to a few hyperscalers' custom-chip plans. It grows fastest when they expand — and feels it first when they pause.

title.zh: 記憶體漲價，代工廠怎麼辦

body.zh: AI 伺服器的 HBM 與 DRAM 越來越貴。緯穎改用「代管」模式：記憶體由客戶自己買，代工廠只負責組裝，營收數字變小，但毛利率不會被昂貴零件稀釋。看代工廠財報時，要分清楚營收變化是「生意變少」還是「計算方式改了」。
body.en: HBM and DRAM keep getting pricier. Under consignment the customer buys the memory and the ODM only assembles — revenue shrinks on paper but margins aren't diluted by expensive parts. When reading ODM results, ask whether revenue fell or the accounting changed.

title.en: A stock dividend makes a pricey share cheaper

body.zh: 緯穎 9 月配發近 2 股股票股利，股價從 7,800 元調整為約 2,600 元，但公司總市值不變。這讓一般投資人更容易買到一張，但也因為畸零股以面額 10 元折現引發爭議，金管會表示將檢討。
body.en: Wiwynn's ~1.98-share-per-share stock dividend (roughly 3-for-1) in September reset the price from NT$7,800 to ~NT$2,600 without changing market value — easier for retail to buy a lot, though cashing odd lots at NT$10 par drew complaints and an FSC review.

title.zh: AI 網路：乙太網路 vs. InfiniBand

body.en: Two main ways link many GPUs: InfiniBand — fast, low-latency, common in supercomputers — and Ethernet, the familiar enterprise standard. NVIDIA's Spectrum-X tunes Ethernet for AI so enterprises can build AI factories with tech they know.

body.en: Cisco bought data and security firm Splunk in 2024 and embeds security in switches and NVIDIA DPUs. The bigger AI factories get, the harder it is to separate networking from security — favoring integrated vendors.

title.zh: 乙太網路的 AI 之戰

body.zh: AI 叢集網路過去由 InfiniBand 主導，現在乙太網路快速追上。思科和 NVIDIA 的 Spectrum-X 合作，讓企業用熟悉的乙太網路蓋 AI 工廠——這場標準之爭攸關龐大市場。
body.en: InfiniBand once dominated AI cluster networking; Ethernet is catching up fast. Cisco's work with NVIDIA Spectrum-X lets enterprises build AI factories on familiar Ethernet — a standards fight over a huge market.

title.zh: 光通訊也是 AI 瓶頸

body.zh: Cisco 的 AI 訂單有四成是光通訊模組。GPU 叢集越大，機櫃之間、資料中心之間要傳的資料越多，銅線不夠用時就要靠光纖。光通訊因此成為 AI 投資的熱門環節。
body.en: 40% of Cisco's AI orders are optics. Bigger GPU clusters move more data between racks and sites; when copper runs out, fiber takes over — making optics a hot AI investment layer.

details.zh: CrowdStrike 在每台電腦裝上一個輕量程式，把可疑行為傳到雲端，用 AI 分析是不是攻擊。現在它把同樣的想法用在 AI Agent 身上：盯住 AI 弟子有沒有做出不該做的事。
details.en: CrowdStrike puts a lightweight agent on every computer, sends suspicious behavior to the cloud, and uses AI to judge whether it's an attack. Now it applies the same idea to AI agents — watching for agents doing things they shouldn't.

title.zh: AI Agent 的頭號風險：提示注入
title.en: AI agents' top risk: prompt injection

body.zh: 「提示注入」是把壞指令藏在 AI 會讀到的內容裡，例如網頁、Email 或文件，讓 AI 誤以為是主人的命令。如果 AI 只會聊天，頂多亂講話；但 AI Agent 能寄信、改資料、花錢，被騙的後果就嚴重得多。資安組織 OWASP 把它列為大型語言模型應用的第一大風險。常見對策是限制 AI 的權限、把它關在沙盒裡執行，並持續監控它的行為。
body.en: Prompt injection hides malicious instructions in content an AI reads — a web page, email or document — so it mistakes them for its owner's commands. A chatbot might just say something odd, but an agent can send email, change data or spend money. OWASP ranks it the top risk for LLM applications. Common defenses: limit permissions, run agents in a sandbox, and monitor their behavior.

body.zh: CrowdStrike 最近一季營收年增約 26%、毛利率約 75%，但 GAAP 獲利仍很低，本益比沒有參考意義。軟體公司常以訂閱營收成長來定價，獲利仍在爬升中。

title.zh: 從軟體到晶片層級的防護
title.en: Protection from software down to silicon

body.zh: 規劃接上 NVIDIA Sentry（BlueField-4）後，CrowdStrike 的防護能從作業系統延伸到硬體層。駭客即使攻破軟體，硬體層的監控仍能發現異常——這是 AI 時代的縱深防禦。
body.en: Once it integrates NVIDIA Sentry (BlueField-4) as planned, CrowdStrike's protection extends from the OS to hardware — even if attackers break the software, hardware-level monitoring can still spot anomalies. Defense in depth for the AI era.

title.zh: ARR 是訂閱軟體的體溫計
title.en: ARR is the thermometer for subscription software

body.zh: ARR（年度經常性收入）代表客戶每年固定付的訂閱金額。CrowdStrike 的「淨新增 ARR」年增 51%，比營收成長更快，代表未來營收的動能正在加速。
body.en: ARR is the recurring subscription revenue customers pay each year. CrowdStrike's net new ARR grew 51% — faster than revenue — signaling accelerating future revenue.

plain.zh: 法國達梭系統，3D 設計與「虛擬雙生」軟體龍頭，讓企業先在電腦裡造飛機、汽車和工廠。
plain.en: France's Dassault Systèmes, a leader in 3D design and virtual-twin software that lets companies build planes, cars and factories in the computer first.

nvidiaBond.zh: 2026 年 2 月與 NVIDIA 宣布長期策略聯盟，打造工業 AI 平台；NVIDIA 也採用達梭的系統工程工具設計 AI 工廠。名列 GTC Berlin OpenShell 夥伴投影片；NVIDIA 10/21 公告指其與 OpenShell 合作打造 Agent 軟體平台。
nvidiaBond.en: Announced a long-term alliance with NVIDIA in Feb 2026 to build an industrial AI platform; NVIDIA also uses Dassault's systems-engineering tools to design AI factories. On the GTC Berlin OpenShell partner slide; NVIDIA's Oct 21 release says it is building agentic software platforms with OpenShell.

impact.zh: 讓 AI 懂物理、懂工程，推動製造業與科學研究的 AI 化。
impact.en: Grounds AI in physics and engineering, advancing AI in manufacturing and science.

dialogue.zh: 先在虛擬世界造一遍，真實世界一次成功。
dialogue.en: Build it once in the virtual world, get it right in the real one.

details.zh: 2026 年 2 月，達梭與 NVIDIA 宣布長期策略聯盟，結合虛擬雙生與 NVIDIA 的 AI 硬體、開放模型和加速函式庫，打造經科學驗證的「世界模型」，用於生物、材料、工程與製造。黃仁勳親自出席 3DEXPERIENCE World 發表。
details.en: In Feb 2026 Dassault and NVIDIA announced a long-term alliance combining virtual twins with NVIDIA AI hardware, open models and accelerated libraries to build science-validated world models for biology, materials, engineering and manufacturing. Jensen Huang joined the 3DEXPERIENCE World unveiling.

title.zh: 虛擬雙生（數位雙生）是什麼？

body.zh: 數位雙生是在電腦裡建一個和真實產品或工廠一模一樣、會跟著物理定律運作的模型。先在虛擬世界測試設計、模擬故障，再去真實世界施工，可以省下大量時間和成本。AI 加進來後，還能自動找出更好的設計。
body.en: A digital twin is a physics-faithful model of a real product or factory in the computer. Testing designs and simulating failures virtually before building saves huge time and cost — and AI can then search for better designs automatically.

title.zh: 股價回升中的 AI 轉型
title.en: An AI pivot as the stock recovers

body.zh: 達梭營收成長只有個位數（第二季固定匯率年增約 4%），股價 2026 年初一度跌到約 16 歐元，10 月已回到年內高點附近。和 NVIDIA 結盟發展工業 AI，是它重新找回成長的關鍵嘗試。
body.en: Dassault grows only in single digits (~+4% in constant currency in Q2); its stock fell to ~€16 early in 2026 before returning near its yearly high in October. Its industrial-AI alliance with NVIDIA is a key bid to restart growth.

title.zh: 軟體高毛利 vs. 硬體薄利

body.zh: 達梭毛利率約 84%，和伺服器代工廠的 4–15% 天差地遠。AI 供應鏈裡，賣軟體與知識的公司毛利最高，但成長要靠客戶願意為 AI 功能多付錢。
body.en: Dassault's gross margin is ~84%, worlds apart from server makers' 4–15%. In the AI chain, software and know-how earn the richest margins — but growth depends on customers paying more for AI features.

title.zh: NVIDIA 也是它的客戶

body.zh: NVIDIA 採用達梭的系統工程工具來設計 AI 工廠。雙向合作讓達梭不只是「用 AI 的軟體公司」，也成為「AI 基礎建設的設計工具」。
body.en: NVIDIA uses Dassault's systems-engineering tools to design AI factories. The two-way partnership makes Dassault not just an AI-using software firm but a design tool for AI infrastructure itself.

title.zh: 成長慢，但利潤率高

body.zh: 達梭全年成長只有 3～5%，但營業利益率超過 32%。工業設計軟體客戶黏著度高，但汽車等產業景氣不佳時，新授權銷售會放緩。AI 能否帶來新一波成長，是市場觀察重點。
body.en: Dassault grows only 3–5% a year but earns 32%+ operating margins. Design software is sticky, yet new licenses slow when autos and other industries weaken — whether AI restarts growth is the key question.

plain.zh: 美國資安公司，以 FortiGate 防火牆聞名，把防火牆搬進 NVIDIA 的 DPU 晶片裡執行。
plain.en: A US cybersecurity company famed for FortiGate firewalls — now running them on NVIDIA DPUs.

nvidiaBond.zh: FortiGate VM 可直接在 NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU 上執行，保護 AI 工廠。名列 GTC Berlin OpenShell 夥伴投影片；NVIDIA 10/21 公告指其正把 OpenShell 參考架構支援整合進自家 Agent 資安方案。
nvidiaBond.en: FortiGate VM runs directly on NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPUs to protect AI factories. On the GTC Berlin OpenShell partner slide; NVIDIA's Oct 21 release says it is integrating OpenShell Reference Architecture support into its agent-security products.

impact.zh: 把資安防線下沉到硬體層，讓 AI 工廠在高速運轉時也能被保護。
impact.en: Pushes security down to hardware so AI factories stay protected at full speed.

dialogue.zh: 鐵壁在此，萬箭難穿。
dialogue.en: Behind this iron wall, no arrow gets through.

details.en: In Dec 2025 Fortinet announced FortiGate VM running directly on NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPUs. Firewalling and segmentation no longer burden the host CPU, which stays free for AI work.

title.zh: DPU：專門做網路和資安的處理器
title.en: DPUs: processors for networking and security

body.zh: 伺服器裡除了 CPU 和 GPU，還可以有 DPU（資料處理器），專門負責網路封包、加密和資安檢查。把這些雜事交給 DPU，就像替大廚配一位專門洗菜、把關食材的助手：主廚（CPU、GPU）能更專心做菜，安全也更有保障。
body.en: Besides CPUs and GPUs, servers can have a DPU (data processing unit) handling network packets, encryption and security checks. It's like giving the head chef an assistant who preps and inspects ingredients — the chefs (CPU, GPU) focus on cooking, and safety improves.

value.zh: 75 億美元；最近一季營收年增 26%；毛利率 80.2%

title.zh: 硬體級資安的優勢

body.zh: Fortinet 長年自研資安專用晶片，現在又把防火牆搬進 NVIDIA DPU。在 AI 工廠裡，資安檢查必須跟上極高的流量，專用硬體就是它的強項。
body.en: Fortinet has long built its own security chips and now runs firewalls on NVIDIA DPUs. In AI factories, security checks must keep up with extreme traffic — where dedicated hardware shines.

title.zh: 股價大漲後估值偏高
title.en: Rich valuation after a big run

body.zh: Fortinet 股價 2026 年從約 75 美元漲到 195 美元的高點，本益比約 64 倍。市場對資安的熱情很高，但也提高了失望的風險。
body.en: Fortinet climbed from ~US$75 to a ~US$195 high in 2026, at ~64× earnings. Enthusiasm for security is high — and so is the risk of disappointment.

title.zh: AI 工廠的「隔離」思維

body.zh: 把資安功能放在獨立的 DPU 上，即使主機被入侵，防護層仍保持隔離運作。這種「把守衛和被保護的人分開」的設計，是 AI 基礎建設越來越重視的原則。
body.en: Running security on a separate DPU keeps protection isolated even if the host is compromised. Separating the guard from the guarded is a growing principle in AI infrastructure.

title.zh: 防火牆換機潮

body.zh: Fortinet 產品營收年增 52%，因為客戶換成效能更高的 FortiGate。AI 流量變大、加密流量變多，舊防火牆檢查不過來，企業只好升級硬體。
body.en: Fortinet's product revenue jumped 52% as customers upgraded to faster FortiGates — heavier, more encrypted AI traffic overwhelms older firewalls.

plain.zh: 百年科技老店 IBM，主攻企業 AI（watsonx）、混合雲與量子電腦。
plain.en: IBM, the century-old tech giant focused on enterprise AI (watsonx), hybrid cloud and quantum computing.

On the GTC Berlin OpenShell partner slide; NVIDIA's Oct 21 release says it is building agentic software platforms with OpenShell.

impact.zh: 協助大型企業把既有資料和系統接上 AI，是企業 AI 轉型的重要推手。
impact.en: Helps big enterprises connect existing data and systems to AI — a key driver of enterprise AI transformation.

dialogue.zh: 百年功力，再練 AI 新招。
dialogue.en: A century of skill, now learning AI's new moves.

title.zh: GPU 不只跑 AI，也能加速資料分析
title.en: GPUs speed up data analysis, not just AI

body.zh: 企業每天要查詢、彙整大量表格資料，傳統上都用 CPU。這類工作其實也是「大量同時計算」，換到 GPU 上可以快好幾倍。AI 要準，資料先要整理得又快又好，所以加速資料處理也是 AI 基礎建設的一環。
body.en: Companies query and aggregate huge tables daily, traditionally on CPUs. That's also massively parallel work, so GPUs can speed it up several-fold. Good AI needs fast, clean data — accelerating data processing is part of AI infrastructure.

title.zh: 百年老店的混合雲 AI 路線

body.zh: IBM 不跟雲端大廠比規模，而是主打「混合雲＋企業 AI」：讓企業在自家機房與多個雲端之間靈活部署 AI。收購 Red Hat 與 HashiCorp 都是為了這條路線。
body.en: IBM doesn't compete with hyperscalers on scale; it pushes hybrid cloud plus enterprise AI, letting companies deploy AI across their data centers and multiple clouds. Buying Red Hat and HashiCorp served that strategy.

title.zh: GPU 加速資料，不只加速 AI
title.en: GPUs speed data, not only AI

body.zh: 雀巢案例中，查詢時間從 15 分鐘縮到 3 分鐘、成本省下 83%（公司說法）。這說明 AI 時代的 GPU 需求，也會來自傳統的資料分析工作。
body.en: In the Nestlé case, query time dropped from 15 to 3 minutes and costs fell 83% (company figures) — showing GPU demand will also come from traditional data analytics.

title.zh: 成長溫和但穩定

body.zh: IBM 最近一季營收年增約 5%，遠低於 AI 新創與雲端大廠。它的價值在於深厚的企業客戶關係與顧問服務，是 AI 導入大型組織的「翻譯者」。
body.en: IBM's latest quarter revenue grew ~5%, far below AI startups and clouds. Its value lies in deep enterprise relationships and consulting — a translator bringing AI into large organizations.

title.zh: 公司不再公布的數字也是訊號

body.zh: IBM 過去每季公布生成式 AI 累計業務金額，2026 年起不再揭露。公司調整揭露方式不一定是壞事，但投資人會追問原因。讀財報時，「少了什麼」和「多了什麼」一樣重要。
body.en: IBM used to report its cumulative generative AI book every quarter, then stopped in 2026. A disclosure change isn't necessarily bad, but investors ask why — what's missing matters as much as what's new.

dialogue.zh: 每一分錢、每一個 Agent，都要看緊。

title.zh: 銀行用 AI Agent，為什麼特別要管？
title.en: Why banks must tightly govern AI agents

body.zh: 在銀行，AI Agent 可能接觸客戶資料、執行交易。一旦出錯或被提示注入攻擊，損失可能很大，還涉及法規。所以銀行特別需要事先劃好 Agent 的權限邊界、即時監控，並能在越界時立刻隔離——這正是 OpenShell 與 Sentry 想解決的問題。
body.en: In banking, agents may touch customer data and execute transactions. Errors or prompt injection could be costly and regulated. Banks need predefined permission boundaries, real-time monitoring and instant isolation when limits are crossed — exactly what OpenShell and Sentry target.

value.zh: 1,907 億美元；最近一季營收年增 10%
value.en: US$190.7B; latest quarter revenue +10% YoY

title.zh: 銀行也是 AI 基建的金主

body.zh: 摩根大通 2025 年主導兩筆合計約 94 億美元的 Crusoe Abilene 園區貸款，據 FT 報導也參與 Project Prometheus 募資。AI 機房動輒數百億美元，銀行的放款意願直接影響 AI 擴張速度。
body.en: JPMorgan led two 2025 loans totaling ~US$9.4B for Crusoe's Abilene campus and, per the FT, joined Project Prometheus's funding. AI data centers cost tens of billions, so banks' willingness to lend directly shapes how fast AI expands.

title.zh: 從 AI 使用者到安全技術合作者
title.en: From AI user to safety collaborator

body.zh: 摩根大通與 NVIDIA 合作發展開源 Agent 安全技術。金融業對風險控管要求最嚴，它怎麼管 AI Agent，常會成為其他產業的參考。
body.en: JPMorganChase is collaborating with NVIDIA on open-source agent-safety technology. Finance has the strictest risk controls, so how it governs AI agents often becomes a reference for other industries.

title.zh: 穩健的大型金融股

body.zh: 摩根大通市值約 8,800 億美元、本益比約 14 倍，最近一季營收年增約 10%。和 AI 科技股相比，它的估值保守得多，AI 是提升效率的工具，而非主要成長故事。
body.en: JPMorgan is worth ~US$880B at ~14× earnings, with latest-quarter revenue up ~10%. Far more conservatively valued than AI tech stocks, it treats AI as an efficiency tool rather than its main growth story.

title.zh: AI 從「創新預算」變成「基礎建設」
title.en: AI moves from innovation to infrastructure

body.zh: 報導指摩根大通把 AI 支出從「可選的創新投資」改列為「核心基礎建設」。當大型企業這樣分類，AI 預算就不容易因景氣而被砍。
body.en: Reports say JPMorgan reclassified AI spending from discretionary innovation to core infrastructure — once a big enterprise does that, AI budgets are harder to cut in a downturn.

plain.zh: 專做「身分與登入管理」的資安公司，現在也替 AI Agent 發身分、管權限。
plain.en: An identity and login security company that now issues identities and permissions for AI agents too.

nvidiaBond.zh: 名列 GTC Berlin OpenShell 夥伴投影片；NVIDIA 10/21 公告指其正把 OpenShell 參考架構支援整合進自家 Agent 資安方案。實作細節與上市時間尚未公布。
nvidiaBond.en: On the GTC Berlin OpenShell partner slide; NVIDIA's Oct 21 release says it is integrating OpenShell Reference Architecture support into its agent-security products. Implementation details and timing have not been published.

impact.zh: 把「人的身分管理」延伸到 AI Agent，是企業安心導入 Agent 的前提。
impact.en: Extends identity management from people to agents — a prerequisite for trusting agents at work.

dialogue.zh: 沒有令牌，誰都別想進門。
dialogue.en: No token, no entry — for anyone.

details.en: Okta for AI Agents helps companies discover, register and govern every agent, with least-privilege tokens, automated access reviews, a one-click kill switch and detailed audit logs.

title.zh: AI Agent 也需要「身分證」
title.en: AI agents need ID cards too

body.zh: 員工上班要刷卡、權限分等級；AI Agent 也一樣。每個 Agent 都該有自己的身分、只拿到完成任務所需的最小權限，並留下紀錄。出事時，還要能一鍵關掉它。這叫「非人類身分」管理，是 Agent 時代的新資安課題。
body.en: Employees badge in with tiered access; agents should too. Each agent needs its own identity, the minimum permissions for its task, and an audit trail — plus a kill switch. This non-human identity management is a new security frontier.

title.en: Non-human identity is a new market

body.zh: 企業裡的 AI Agent 數量可能很快超過員工。每個 Agent 都需要身分、權限與稽核，Okta 把身分管理延伸到 AI，是在搶一塊全新的市場。
body.en: AI agents may soon outnumber employees, each needing identity, permissions and audits. Extending identity management to AI, Okta is chasing a brand-new market.

title.zh: 股價強彈

body.zh: Okta 股價從 2026 年 4 月約 63 美元的低點，漲到 10 月約 232 美元的高點；同期它在 4 月底正式推出 Okta for AI Agents。市場把它視為 Agent 時代資安的受惠者之一。
body.en: Okta rose from a ~US$63 low in April 2026 to a ~US$232 high in October; over the same period it made Okta for AI Agents generally available (Apr 30). Markets see it as one of the agent-era security beneficiaries.

title.zh: 和 NVIDIA 的整合進行中

body.zh: NVIDIA 10 月公告指 Okta 正把 OpenShell 參考架構支援整合進 Agent 資安方案，但尚未公布完成時間與細節。名列合作夥伴到產品真正上線，中間還有一段距離。
body.en: NVIDIA's October release says Okta is integrating OpenShell Reference Architecture support into its agent-security products, with no timing or details yet — there's a gap between being named a partner and shipping.

title.zh: Agent 也需要「帳號」

body.zh: 每個 AI Agent 要讀信箱、開工單、查資料庫，都需要權限。Okta 主張由中立的身分平台統一管理人和 Agent 的權限，避免每個 Agent 各自拿到過大的鑰匙。
body.en: Every AI agent that reads email, files tickets or queries databases needs permissions. Okta argues a neutral identity platform should manage humans and agents together so no agent holds overly broad keys.

title.zh: 可稽核的 AI：每一步都查得到

body.zh: 政府和關鍵產業用 AI，必須能回答「AI 為什麼這樣判斷？用了哪些資料？誰批准的？」。可稽核性就是把資料授權、模型輸出與人員決策都留下紀錄，必要時能刪除資料、追查責任。這也是主權 AI 的核心要求。
body.en: When governments and critical industries use AI, they must answer: why did it decide this, using what data, approved by whom? Auditability logs data permissions, model outputs and human decisions — with erasure and accountability when needed. It's core to sovereign AI.

body.zh: Palantir 最近一季營收年增約 93%、毛利率約 85%，但本益比超過 170 倍，市值約 4,700 億美元。市場對它的 AI 平台寄予極高期待，任何成長放緩都可能讓股價劇烈波動。
body.en: Palantir's latest quarter revenue rose ~93% at ~85% gross margin, yet it trades above 170× earnings with a ~US$470B market cap. Sky-high expectations mean any slowdown could jolt the stock.

title.zh: 主權 AI 的軟體層
title.en: The software layer of sovereign AI

body.zh: 硬體可以買 NVIDIA GPU，但政府還需要能控管資料、留下稽核紀錄的軟體。Palantir 把 Nemotron 開放模型放進主權 AI 作業系統，填補的正是這一層。
body.en: Governments can buy NVIDIA GPUs, but they also need software that controls data and keeps audit trails. Putting Nemotron open models into its Sovereign AI OS, Palantir fills exactly that layer.

title.zh: NVIDIA 也是用戶

body.zh: NVIDIA 在自己的供應鏈營運中部署了 Palantir 的系統，用來更早發現瓶頸、評估替代方案。供應商與客戶互相採用，是 AI 產業緊密綁定的縮影。
body.en: NVIDIA runs Palantir's system in its own supply-chain operations to spot bottlenecks earlier — suppliers and customers adopting each other's tools, a snapshot of how tightly bound AI firms are.

title.zh: 什麼是「40 法則」

body.zh: 軟體業常用「營收成長率 + 利潤率」是否超過 40% 來判斷公司健不健康。Palantir 第二季是 93% 成長加 62% 利潤率，分數 155%，是極少見的高成長又高獲利。這也是它享有極高估值的原因之一。
body.en: Software investors check whether revenue growth plus profit margin exceeds 40%. Palantir's Q2 hit 93% + 62% = 155% — rare high growth with high profit, one reason for its premium valuation.

plain.zh: 全球資安龍頭之一，以次世代防火牆與「零信任」架構聞名，替 AI 工廠和 AI 應用加上防護。
plain.en: A global security leader known for next-gen firewalls and zero trust, protecting AI factories and AI apps.

impact.en: Brings zero trust into AI factories so security keeps pace as AI use grows.

title.zh: 零信任：預設誰都不相信
title.en: Zero trust: trust no one by default

body.zh: 傳統資安像城牆：進了城就被信任。零信任則是每一次存取都要驗證身分與權限，不管你在城內城外。AI Agent 可能被騙、被入侵，所以對 Agent 也要套用零信任，每個動作都檢查。
body.en: Traditional security is a city wall: once inside, you're trusted. Zero trust verifies identity and permission on every access, inside or out. Agents can be tricked or compromised, so they get zero trust too — every action checked.

details.en: Red Hat and NVIDIA offer Red Hat AI Factory with NVIDIA; Red Hat said it intends to deliver day-zero support for Vera Rubin. The OpenShell reference architecture runs on Red Hat's Linux and Kubernetes.

title.zh: Kubernetes：替成千上萬個程式排班

body.zh: 現代軟體常拆成許多小「容器」，分散在很多台機器上執行。Kubernetes 就像總排班表，決定每個容器跑在哪台機器、壞了自動重啟、流量大自動加開。AI 服務和 AI Agent 也大量用它來部署和管理。
body.en: Modern software is split into many small containers across many machines. Kubernetes is the master scheduler — placing containers, restarting failures, scaling with traffic. AI services and agents are widely deployed and managed with it.

value.zh: 699 億美元；最近一季營收年增 5%；毛利率 58.0%
value.en: US$69.9B; latest quarter revenue +5% YoY; gross margin 58.0%

title.zh: 開源也能賺大錢
title.en: Open source can be big business

body.zh: Red Hat 的軟體原始碼公開，卻靠訂閱、支援與認證賺錢，2019 年被 IBM 以約 340 億美元收購。它證明了企業願意為「穩定、可信、有人負責」的開源軟體付費。
body.en: Red Hat's code is open, yet it earns through subscriptions, support and certification — and IBM paid ~US$34B for it in 2019. It proved enterprises will pay for reliable, accountable open source.

title.zh: AI 的「到處都能跑」

body.zh: 企業的 AI 可能跑在自家機房、AWS、Azure 或邊緣設備。Red Hat 的 OpenShift 讓同一套 AI 應用能在這些地方一致部署，降低被單一雲端綁住的風險。
body.en: Enterprise AI may run on-premises, on AWS, Azure or at the edge. Red Hat OpenShift deploys the same AI apps consistently across them, reducing lock-in to any one cloud.

title.zh: 首日支援新 GPU 的意義

body.zh: Red Hat 表示計畫在 Vera Rubin 上市當天就提供支援。新 GPU 一上市，企業就能用熟悉的平台部署，縮短從「買到 GPU」到「真正用上」的時間。
body.en: Red Hat said it intends to support Vera Rubin on launch day — enterprises can deploy new GPUs on a familiar platform right away, shortening the gap between buying GPUs and using them.

title.zh: 開源公司的成長也會放緩

body.zh: Red Hat 的成長從 2025 年的 14% 放緩到 11%。一種可能的解讀是：企業 AI 雖然熱，但很多預算先流向 GPU 硬體，軟體平台的收入要等專案上線後才會跟上。
body.en: Red Hat's growth slowed from 14% to 11%. One possible reading: enterprise AI is hot, but much of the budget goes first to GPU hardware; platform software revenue follows once projects go live.

plain.zh: 德國的 SAP，全球最大的企業管理軟體（ERP）公司，管理企業的財務、採購、庫存與人資。
plain.en: Germany's SAP, the world's largest enterprise resource planning (ERP) software company, running companies' finance, purchasing, inventory and HR.

nvidiaBond.en: OpenShell is embedded in and co-developed for SAP Business AI Platform; NVIDIA agent blueprints come to Joule Studio, and NVIDIA cuOpt optimizes supply chains. Listed on the OpenShell partner slide at the Oct 2026 GTC Berlin keynote.

impact.en: Brings agents into companies' most critical systems, affecting how countless businesses run.

dialogue.zh: 帳目分毫不差，Agent 也要守規矩。
dialogue.en: Books to the penny — and agents follow the rules.

details.en: At SAP Sapphire in May 2026 SAP and NVIDIA expanded ties: OpenShell is embedded in SAP Business AI Platform and co-developed by SAP engineers, with NVIDIA agent blueprints coming to Joule Studio. They also pair NVIDIA cuOpt with supply-chain planning and connect Joule agents to robots.

title.zh: ERP：企業的中央帳房

body.zh: ERP 把財務、採購、生產、庫存、人資整合在同一套系統。因為它掌握企業最核心的資料與流程，AI Agent 一旦接上 ERP，就能真正幫忙下訂單、對帳、排產——但也因此必須嚴格控管權限與稽核。
body.en: ERP unifies finance, purchasing, production, inventory and HR in one system. Holding a company's core data and processes, ERP lets connected agents actually place orders, reconcile accounts and plan production — which is why permissions and audits must be strict.

title.zh: AI Agent 進入企業核心

body.zh: SAP 的 ERP 掌握全球大量企業的財務、採購與供應鏈。當 AI Agent 能直接在 SAP 系統裡下單、對帳，AI 就從「輔助工具」變成「企業營運的一部分」。
body.en: SAP's ERP runs finance, purchasing and supply chains for countless companies. When agents can place orders and reconcile accounts inside SAP, AI moves from helper tool to part of operations.

title.zh: 安全治理是 SAP 的賣點

body.zh: SAP 把 OpenShell 嵌入平台並共同開發，強調「Agent 能不能安全執行」和「該不該執行」分開判斷。對企業客戶來說，可控、可稽核比功能炫目更重要。
body.en: SAP embeds and co-develops OpenShell, separating "can this run safely" from "should it happen at all." For enterprises, control and auditability matter more than flashy features.

title.zh: 股價 2026 年先跌後漲

body.zh: SAP 股價 7 月一度跌到約 128 歐元，10 月回升到約 215 歐元的年內高點，最近一季營收年增約 13%。市場對 AI 是否會衝擊傳統企業軟體曾有疑慮，之後逐漸轉為看好 Agent 帶來的新機會。
body.en: SAP fell to ~€128 in July before recovering to a ~€215 year high in October, with latest-quarter revenue up ~13%. Fears that AI would disrupt traditional enterprise software gave way to optimism about agent opportunities.

title.zh: AI 變成大合約的標配
title.en: AI becomes standard in big deals

body.zh: SAP 前 50 大合約有九成以上帶 AI。企業買 ERP 時，順便買 AI 功能與資料平台，代表 AI 正從「額外選購」變成「預設配備」。
body.en: Over 90% of SAP's top-50 deals include AI — enterprises buying ERP now take AI and data-platform add-ons by default.

plain.zh: 專做企業工作流程自動化的平台，處理 IT、人資、客服等內部流程，現在大量導入 AI Agent。
plain.en: A platform automating enterprise workflows — IT, HR, customer service — now packed with AI agents.

nvidiaBond.zh: 與 NVIDIA 共同開發 Apriel Nemotron 15B 推理模型，並整合 NVIDIA Llama Nemotron 模型。2026 年 10 月正式推出個人 Agent「ServiceNow Arc」，可在 NVIDIA OpenShell 安全執行環境中運行，由 Super Intelligence Control Tower 治理。
nvidiaBond.en: Co-developed the Apriel Nemotron 15B reasoning model with NVIDIA and integrated NVIDIA Llama Nemotron models. In Oct 2026 it made ServiceNow Arc generally available; Arc can run inside the NVIDIA OpenShell secure runtime and is governed by its Super Intelligence Control Tower.

impact.zh: 把 AI Agent 帶進企業每天的請假、報修、客服流程，讓 Agent 真正「上班」。
impact.en: Brings agents into everyday leave requests, IT tickets and service desks — agents actually at work.

details.en: In May 2025 ServiceNow and NVIDIA released Apriel Nemotron 15B, an open 15-billion-parameter reasoning model trained with NVIDIA NeMo and ServiceNow domain data for faster, cheaper enterprise agents.

title.zh: 小模型也能很聰明
title.en: Small models can be smart too

body.zh: 不是每件事都需要最大的模型。150 億參數的模型比前沿大模型小很多，跑起來更快、更便宜，用專業資料後訓練後，在特定工作上也能有不錯的推理能力。企業常會「大小模型搭配」：簡單任務用小模型，難題才找大模型。
body.en: Not every task needs the biggest model. A 15B model is far smaller than frontier models — faster and cheaper — and with specialist post-training it reasons well on specific jobs. Companies often mix: small models for routine tasks, big ones for hard problems.

value.zh: 147 億美元；最近一季營收年增 24%；毛利率 74.8%

title.zh: 流程平台是 Agent 的天然舞台
title.en: Workflow platforms are agents' natural stage

body.zh: 請假、報修、採購審核這些流程，本來就有固定步驟和權限。ServiceNow 把 AI Agent 放進這些流程，讓 Agent 在既有規則內辦事，比從零打造更容易被企業接受。
body.en: Leave requests, IT tickets and purchase approvals already have defined steps and permissions. Placing agents inside these workflows lets them act within existing rules — easier for enterprises to accept than starting from scratch.

title.zh: 自己做小模型

body.zh: ServiceNow 和 NVIDIA 合作訓練 150 億參數的 Apriel Nemotron。用小模型處理大量例行工作，可以降低成本、加快回應，也減少依賴外部大模型。
body.en: With NVIDIA, ServiceNow trained the 15B-parameter Apriel Nemotron. Using a small model for routine work cuts cost and latency and reduces dependence on outside frontier models.

title.zh: 股價創年內新高

body.zh: ServiceNow 股價 10 月 23 日收在約 159 美元的年內高點（4 月低點約 83 美元），分析師平均評等為「強力買進」。市場看好它把 AI Agent 變成實際營收的能力。
body.en: ServiceNow closed at a ~US$159 year high on Oct 23 (April low ~US$83), with a Strong Buy consensus — markets back its ability to turn agents into revenue.

title.zh: Agent 從試用走到正式上線

body.zh: ServiceNow 說 Agent 部署數 9 個月成長 9 倍。企業 AI 的關鍵指標正從「多少人試用」轉向「多少流程真的交給 Agent」。
body.en: ServiceNow says agentic deployments grew 9× in nine months — the key enterprise metric is shifting from trials to how many workflows actually run on agents.

title.zh: AI 驅動的自適應工廠

body.zh: 傳統工廠照固定程序生產。自適應工廠則讓 AI 從感測器即時讀取資料，在數位雙生裡先模擬調整方案，再自動改變產線設定——例如訂單變了、機器快壞了，工廠能自己應變。
body.en: Traditional factories follow fixed routines. An adaptive factory lets AI read sensors in real time, simulate changes in a digital twin, then reconfigure lines automatically — adapting when orders change or machines wear.

title.zh: 工業 AI 的軟硬整合

body.en: Siemens has both factory-automation hardware and industrial design software, plus an Industrial AI OS with NVIDIA. Connecting sensors and controllers all the way to digital twins is its unique edge in physical AI.

title.zh: 用收購補強軟體

body.zh: 西門子在 2025 年收購模擬軟體公司 Altair 與科學資料平台 Dotmatics，強化模擬與 AI 能力。工業巨頭正從「賣機器」轉向「賣軟體與數據」。
body.en: In 2025 Siemens bought simulation firm Altair and scientific-data platform Dotmatics, strengthening simulation and AI. Industrial giants are shifting from selling machines to selling software and data.

title.zh: 穩健成長的工業股

body.zh: 西門子最近一季營收年增約 7%，市值約 1,960 億歐元。它的 AI 故事是「慢而穩」：靠大量工廠客戶逐步導入，而不是爆發式成長。
body.en: Siemens's latest quarter revenue grew ~7% and its market cap is ~€196B. Its AI story is slow and steady — gradual adoption across a vast factory base rather than explosive growth.

title.zh: 垂直整合：為什麼火箭公司要買 AI 公司？
title.en: Vertical integration: why would a rocket company buy AI firms?

body.zh: 「垂直整合」是把上下游都握在自己手裡。SpaceX 有 Starlink 這個全球網路、有自己的算力（Colossus）、有模型（Grok）、也有開發工具（Cursor）。從連網、算力、模型到應用一條龍，就能減少依賴別人，也能把 AI 用在自家火箭和衛星上。
body.en: Vertical integration means owning the whole chain. SpaceX has a global network (Starlink), compute (Colossus), models (Grok) and developer tools (Cursor). Owning connectivity, compute, models and apps reduces dependence on others and puts AI to work on its own rockets and satellites.

details.zh: 自動駕駛車要同時看懂攝影機、雷達的畫面，在幾毫秒內做決定。車廠在資料中心訓練 AI，在車上用 NVIDIA 晶片執行。2026 年 GTC，Uber 宣布與 NVIDIA 合作在多個城市推出機器人計程車；GTC Berlin 上，Bolt 宣布計畫 2027 年起在馬德里以 Lucid 車款蒐集道路資料（須經監管批准）。
details.en: Self-driving cars must read cameras and radar and decide within milliseconds. Automakers train AI in data centers and run it in cars on NVIDIA chips. At GTC 2026 Uber announced robotaxis with NVIDIA in many cities; at GTC Berlin, Bolt said it plans to start collecting road data with Lucid cars in Madrid in 2027 (subject to regulatory approval).

title.zh: L2 到 L4：自動駕駛分級

body.zh: 自動駕駛常分成 0 到 5 級。L2 是車幫你控制方向和速度，但人要隨時接手；L4 是在特定區域內完全不需要人駕駛，機器人計程車就屬於這一級。級數越高，AI 要處理的意外狀況越多，需要的訓練資料和模擬也越龐大。
body.en: Driving automation runs from level 0 to 5. L2 steers and brakes but needs a human ready; L4 drives itself within defined areas — robotaxis are L4. Higher levels mean more edge cases, needing far more training data and simulation.

title.zh: 機器人計程車的規模之爭

body.zh: Uber 計畫用 NVIDIA Hyperion 在多個城市推出機器人計程車，Bolt 也計畫 2027 年起在馬德里蒐集資料、進軍歐洲。自駕從「車廠的事」變成「叫車平台的事」，誰掌握車隊與乘客，誰就有主導權。
body.en: Uber plans robotaxis on NVIDIA Hyperion in many cities, and Bolt plans to start collecting data in Madrid in 2027 on its way into Europe. Self-driving is shifting from automakers to ride-hail platforms — whoever owns the fleet and riders holds the power.

title.zh: 車子變成「輪子上的電腦」

body.zh: 自駕車需要車上的高效能晶片即時判斷，也需要資料中心持續訓練與更新。汽車業的 AI 需求同時來自「車上」與「雲端」兩端。
body.en: Self-driving cars need powerful onboard chips for real-time decisions and data centers to keep training and updating — auto AI demand comes from both car and cloud.

title.zh: 模擬比路測更重要

body.zh: 罕見危險狀況（例如突然衝出的行人）很難在真實道路收集夠多資料。用世界模型與合成資料在虛擬世界反覆練習，是讓自駕安全的關鍵。
body.en: Rare dangers like a pedestrian darting out are hard to capture on real roads; practicing endlessly in simulated worlds with synthetic data is key to safe self-driving.

title.zh: Robotaxi 的三方分工
title.en: Who does what in a robotaxi

body.zh: Robotaxi 通常是三方合作：車廠造車（如 Nissan、BYD）、軟體公司開發自駕（如 Wayve）、叫車平台營運（如 Uber）。NVIDIA 提供共同的運算平台，讓不同公司的零件能組在一起。
body.en: Robotaxis are usually a three-way deal: automakers build cars (Nissan, BYD), software firms build the driver (Wayve), and ride-hail platforms run the service (Uber). NVIDIA supplies the common compute platform that ties them together.

plain.zh: 國防單位用 AI 分析情報、偵測威脅，並在沒有網路的前線現場即時判斷。
plain.en: Defense organizations use AI to analyze intelligence, detect threats and decide in real time at the edge without connectivity.

nvidiaBond.zh: 國防與安全應用廣泛採用 NVIDIA Jetson 邊緣運算平台；Palantir 也與 NVIDIA 推出 AI OS 參考架構，並把 Nemotron 開放模型整合進主權 AI 作業系統。
nvidiaBond.en: Defense and security applications widely use NVIDIA Jetson edge computing; Palantir also released an AI OS reference architecture with NVIDIA and integrated Nemotron open models into its sovereign AI OS.

impact.zh: AI 正改變國防的速度與方式，也讓「AI 用於軍事的倫理與管制」成為國際關注議題。
impact.en: AI is changing defense's speed and methods — and making the ethics and control of military AI a global concern.

dialogue.zh: 守住邊境，判斷要快，也要有人把關。
dialogue.en: Guard the border — decide fast, but keep humans in charge.

details.zh: 國防 AI 很多需要在前線、車上或無人機上運作，不能依賴遠端雲端，因此常用 NVIDIA Jetson 這類耐用的邊緣運算晶片。國防應用也特別需要嚴格的人類監督與倫理規範。
details.en: Much defense AI must run at the front, in vehicles or on drones without relying on remote clouds, so it often uses rugged edge chips like NVIDIA Jetson. Defense uses especially require strict human oversight and ethical rules.

title.zh: 邊緣 AI：不連網也能思考
title.en: Edge AI: thinking without the cloud

body.zh: 「邊緣運算」是把 AI 放在資料產生的地方直接計算，例如攝影機、車輛、機器人旁邊，而不是把資料傳回遠端雲端。好處是反應快、不怕斷線、資料不外流；挑戰是設備體積、耗電都受限，所以需要省電又強的晶片。
body.en: Edge computing runs AI where data is created — beside cameras, vehicles or robots — instead of sending it to a distant cloud. It's faster, works offline and keeps data local; the challenge is tight size and power limits, needing efficient yet capable chips.

title.zh: 邊緣運算是國防 AI 的核心
title.en: Edge computing is defense AI's core

body.zh: 前線無法依賴穩定網路，AI 必須在設備上直接運算。NVIDIA Jetson 這類低功耗高效能晶片，因此成為國防 AI 的重要基礎。
body.en: Front lines can't rely on stable networks, so AI must compute on the device — making low-power, high-performance chips like NVIDIA Jetson key to defense AI.

title.zh: 人類監督不可少

body.zh: 國防 AI 的決策可能影響生命安全。許多國家與國際組織的政策框架都強調，使用致命武力時必須保持適當的人類控制。
body.en: Defense AI decisions can affect lives. Many national and international policy frameworks stress keeping appropriate human control over the use of lethal force.

title.zh: 軍民兩用技術

body.zh: 同一套影像辨識或無人機技術，可以用在搜救、救災，也能用在軍事。AI 晶片的出口管制，部分原因就是這種「軍民兩用」特性。
body.en: The same image recognition or drone tech serves search-and-rescue and the military — that dual-use nature is part of why AI chips face export controls.

plain.zh: 能源業一方面用 AI 管理電網與電廠，另一方面也忙著替 AI 資料中心供電。
plain.en: The energy sector uses AI to manage grids and plants — while racing to power AI data centers.

nvidiaBond.zh: NVIDIA 投資 Emerald AI，並與能源業者合作彈性 AI 工廠；Schneider Electric 與 NVIDIA 共同發表 AI 工廠電力與冷卻參考設計。
nvidiaBond.en: NVIDIA backs Emerald AI and works with utilities on flexible AI factories; Schneider Electric co-developed AI factory power and cooling reference designs with NVIDIA.

impact.zh: 電力決定 AI 能長多大；能源業正成為 AI 競賽的關鍵玩家。
impact.en: Power decides how big AI can grow — energy companies are now key players in the AI race.

dialogue.zh: 爐火要旺，也要穩。
dialogue.en: Keep the fire strong — and steady.

details.en: AI data centers reach hundreds of MW to gigawatts, making power one of AI's biggest bottlenecks. In Mar 2026 NVIDIA and startup Emerald AI announced flexible AI factories with utilities like AES, Constellation, NextEra and Vistra; Schneider Electric released power and cooling reference designs for Vera Rubin racks with NVIDIA.

title.zh: AI 機房也能幫電網「削峰」
title.en: AI data centers can help the grid shave peaks

body.zh: 電網最怕用電尖峰。有些 AI 工作（例如部分訓練任務）可以稍微延後或放慢。如果資料中心在尖峰時段主動減少用電，就能減輕電網壓力，也比較容易獲准接上電網。在 2025 年 5 月美國鳳凰城的測試中，一個 AI 叢集在用電尖峰時降低了 25% 用電、持續三小時。
body.en: Grids fear demand peaks. Some AI jobs, like parts of training, can be paused or slowed. If data centers cut usage at peaks, they ease grid stress and win grid connections more easily. In a May 2025 Phoenix trial, an AI cluster cut power 25% for three hours during peak demand.

title.zh: 電力成為 AI 最大瓶頸

body.zh: 黃仁勳曾表示 AI 需要的電力將大幅增加。許多 AI 園區的建設進度，取決於能不能接上電網，而不是能不能買到 GPU。
body.en: Jensen Huang has said AI will need far more power. Many AI campuses are paced by grid connections, not GPU availability.

title.zh: 資料中心從「用電大戶」變「電網夥伴」
title.en: Data centers from power hogs to grid partners

body.zh: Emerald AI 的測試顯示，AI 叢集可以在尖峰時段減少用電。若資料中心能彈性配合電網，就能更快獲准接電，也減輕對民生用電的衝擊。
body.en: Emerald AI's trials show AI clusters can cut power at peaks. Flexible data centers win grid connections faster and ease the impact on household electricity.

title.zh: 核電與燃氣重新受重視
title.en: Nuclear and gas back in favor

body.zh: AI 讓穩定的基載電力重新受重視：科技公司紛紛簽下核電長約，燃氣發電設備的需求也大增。能源轉型與 AI 擴張之間的取捨，成為新的政策議題。
body.en: AI has revived interest in steady baseload power: tech companies are signing long-term nuclear deals and demand for gas generation equipment has surged. Balancing the energy transition with AI growth is a new policy question.

title.zh: 會「讓電」的資料中心比較快接上電網
title.en: Data centers that yield power connect faster

body.zh: 電力公司最怕尖峰時段被資料中心吃光電。如果 AI 工廠承諾在電網吃緊時降載，電力公司就比較願意讓它提早併網。彈性用電因此成為加快 AI 工廠上線的新方法。（目前多為合作框架，具體專案時程仍少）
body.en: Utilities fear data centers draining the grid at peak. If an AI factory promises to throttle under stress, it can connect sooner — flexibility is becoming a way to speed AI factories online. (Mostly a framework so far, with few firm project timelines.)

plain.zh: 銀行、保險、證券業用 AI 抓詐騙、評估風險、服務客戶，也開始導入 AI Agent。
plain.en: Banks, insurers and brokers use AI to catch fraud, assess risk and serve customers — and are starting to deploy agents.

nvidiaBond.zh: 金融機構採用 NVIDIA GPU 與 AI 軟體做詐騙偵測與風險分析；摩根大通、花旗等加入 NVIDIA 的 Agent 安全計畫。
nvidiaBond.en: Financial firms use NVIDIA GPUs and AI software for fraud detection and risk analysis; JPMorgan, Citi and others joined NVIDIA's agent-safety effort.

impact.zh: AI 讓金融服務更快、更安全，但也讓「AI 出錯誰負責」成為監管焦點。
impact.en: AI makes finance faster and safer — and puts "who's accountable when AI errs" at the center of regulation.

dialogue.zh: 帳要算清，騙子休想混過。
dialogue.en: Every account balanced — no swindler slips through.

details.zh: 金融業掌握大量敏感資料，對 AI 的準確、安全和可稽核要求最高。2026 年 9 月，摩根大通、花旗等金融機構加入 NVIDIA 的開放 Agent 安全計畫；NVIDIA 也提供用圖神經網路偵測詐騙的 AI 藍圖。
details.en: Finance holds vast sensitive data and demands the most from AI on accuracy, security and auditability. In Sept 2026 JPMorgan, Citi and others joined NVIDIA's open agent-safety effort; NVIDIA also offers an AI blueprint for fraud detection with graph neural networks.

title.zh: 用「關係圖」抓詐騙

body.zh: 詐騙集團常用很多帳戶互相轉帳來掩飾。圖神經網路把帳戶、交易、裝置畫成一張關係網，AI 可以看出「這群帳戶之間的連結很不尋常」，比只看單筆交易更容易抓到集團式詐騙。
body.en: Fraud rings shuffle money across many accounts to hide. Graph neural networks map accounts, transactions and devices as a network, letting AI spot unusually connected clusters — catching organized fraud better than checking single transactions.

title.zh: 金融業對 AI 的要求最嚴
title.en: Finance sets the strictest AI bar

body.zh: 銀行處理客戶資產與個資，任何錯誤都可能造成損失與法律責任。金融業導入 AI 的方式——重視稽核、權限與安全——常成為其他產業的參考。
body.en: Banks handle customer assets and personal data, so errors bring losses and liability. How finance adopts AI — with audits, permissions and safety — often becomes the model for others.

title.zh: 銀行也是 AI 的金主

body.zh: 摩根大通 2025 年主導兩筆、合計約 94 億美元的 Crusoe Abilene 園區建設貸款（含聯貸），據 FT 報導也參與 Project Prometheus 募資。金融業同時是 AI 的使用者與資金提供者。
body.en: In 2025 JPMorgan led two construction loans totaling ~US$9.4B (including a syndicated loan) for Crusoe's Abilene campus, and per the FT took part in Project Prometheus's funding — finance is both an AI user and an AI funder.

title.zh: 詐騙與防詐的 AI 對決

body.zh: 詐騙集團也會用 AI 生成假聲音、假影片。銀行用 AI 偵測詐騙，形成一場持續升級的攻防戰。
body.en: Fraudsters use AI to fake voices and videos too; banks use AI to detect fraud — an escalating arms race.

title.zh: 銀行為什麼要自己蓋 AI 工廠
title.en: Why banks build their own AI factories

body.zh: 金融資料受嚴格監管，很多不能放到公有雲。銀行選擇在自家機房部署 GPU，並用機密運算讓資料在運算過程中也保持加密，兼顧 AI 能力與法規要求。
body.en: Financial data is tightly regulated and often can't go to public cloud. Banks deploy GPUs on-prem and use confidential computing so data stays encrypted even during processing.

plain.zh: 遊戲業用 AI 讓畫面更逼真、角色更聰明，甚至做出會跟你對話合作的 AI 隊友。
plain.en: Game makers use AI for sharper graphics, smarter characters — even AI teammates you can talk to.

nvidiaBond.zh: 遊戲是 GPU 的起源；NVIDIA 提供 ACE 等數位角色技術，Krafton 用它打造 AI 隊友。
nvidiaBond.en: Games are where GPUs began; NVIDIA offers digital-character tech like ACE, which Krafton used for its AI teammate.

impact.zh: AI 隊友和 NPC 可能徹底改變遊戲體驗，也讓遊戲成為一般人最早接觸本地 AI 的地方。
impact.en: AI teammates and NPCs could transform play — and games may be where most people first meet local AI.

dialogue.zh: 隊友是 AI，默契一樣滿分。
dialogue.en: My teammate's an AI — and we're perfectly in sync.

details.zh: 遊戲是 NVIDIA 的起點，GPU 最早就是為遊戲畫面而生。現在 AI 反過來改變遊戲：Krafton 用 NVIDIA ACE 打造《PUBG》的 AI 隊友「PUBG Ally」，能聽懂語音、配合作戰並記住玩家習慣，在玩家電腦上本地運作。
details.en: Games are NVIDIA's origin — GPUs were born for game graphics. Now AI is reshaping games: Krafton used NVIDIA ACE to build PUBG Ally, an AI teammate that understands voice, cooperates in battle and remembers players, running locally on their PCs.

title.zh: 在你的電腦上跑的「小模型」
title.en: Small models running on your own PC

body.zh: PUBG Ally 用的是約 20 億參數的小型語言模型，經過「量化」壓縮，目標是在只有 8GB 顯示記憶體的電腦上也能和遊戲一起跑。好處是反應快、不用連雲端；挑戰是要在有限資源下保持聰明。
body.en: PUBG Ally uses a ~2-billion-parameter small language model, quantized to fit alongside the game on PCs with as little as 8 GB of VRAM. It's fast and needs no cloud — the challenge is staying smart with limited resources.

title.zh: GPU 的故鄉

body.zh: NVIDIA 最早靠遊戲顯示卡起家，GPU 平行運算的能力後來才被用在 AI。遊戲產業孕育了後來支撐 AI 的 GPU。
body.en: NVIDIA started with gaming graphics cards; GPU parallel computing was later applied to AI. Gaming incubated the GPUs that now power AI.

title.zh: 玩家電腦就是 AI 電腦

body.zh: PUBG Ally 在玩家的電腦上本地執行 AI。數量龐大的遊戲電腦，可能成為最普及的「本地 AI」平台。
body.en: PUBG Ally runs AI locally on players' PCs — the vast installed base of gaming PCs could become the most widespread local-AI platform.

title.zh: AI 隊友會改變遊戲設計
title.en: AI teammates will change game design

body.zh: 會聽、會說、會記住你的 AI 隊友，讓單人遊戲也能有團隊感。遊戲設計師需要重新思考：當 NPC 有了「個性」，故事該怎麼寫？
body.en: AI teammates that listen, talk and remember make solo play feel social — designers must rethink storytelling when NPCs have personalities.

title.zh: 畫面有一大半是 AI 畫的
title.en: AI draws much of the frame

body.zh: DLSS 的多重畫格生成，是 GPU 實際只算一張畫面，AI 再補出好幾張中間畫面。6 倍模式（RTX 50 系列）代表大多數畫格都是 AI 生成的，玩家卻能得到更流暢的畫面。
body.en: DLSS multi-frame generation renders one frame and has AI fill in several more — in 6× mode (RTX 50 Series) most frames on screen are AI-generated, yet play feels smoother.

plain.zh: 醫院、藥廠與醫療器材公司，用 AI 找新藥、看醫療影像、減輕醫護人員的負擔。
plain.en: Hospitals, drugmakers and device makers using AI to find medicines, read scans and lighten clinicians' workload.

nvidiaBond.zh: 藥廠和醫療器材商大量採購 NVIDIA 系統；NVIDIA 也提供醫療專用的軟體與模擬平台（例如 Isaac for Healthcare、Cosmos）。
nvidiaBond.en: Drugmakers and device makers buy NVIDIA systems at scale, and NVIDIA offers healthcare-specific software and simulation platforms such as Isaac for Healthcare and Cosmos.

impact.zh: 可能讓新藥研發更快，也讓缺乏專科醫師的地區有機會用上自動化的影像檢查。但醫療 AI 必須經過嚴格驗證，才能真正用在病人身上。
impact.en: Could speed up new medicines and bring automated imaging to places short on specialists — but medical AI must pass rigorous validation before it reaches patients.

dialogue.en: Divine blades as needles, inner power as medicine!

details.zh: 醫療是 AI 最有潛力、也最需要謹慎的領域：開發一款新藥常要花十年以上，AI 可以先在電腦裡篩選大量候選分子；影像 AI 則幫忙判讀 X 光、超音波。這些都需要大型 GPU 系統與專門的軟體工具。
details.en: Healthcare is among AI's most promising and most delicate fields. A new drug can take over a decade; AI can screen huge numbers of candidate molecules in silico first, while imaging AI helps read X-rays and ultrasound. All of it needs large GPU systems and specialized software.

title.zh: 合成資料：用模擬世界訓練醫療 AI
title.en: Synthetic data: training medical AI in simulation

body.zh: 醫療資料很難取得，又牽涉隱私。「合成資料」是用電腦模擬出逼真的資料來訓練 AI。例如 GE HealthCare 用 NVIDIA 的模擬平台，在虛擬環境裡反覆訓練、測試自動化的 X 光和超音波設備，等夠可靠了再進到真實醫院。
body.en: Medical data is scarce and private. "Synthetic data" means generating realistic data by simulation to train AI. GE HealthCare, for example, uses NVIDIA simulation tools to train and test autonomous X-ray and ultrasound systems in a virtual world before they reach real hospitals.

title.zh: 藥廠蓋自己的 AI 超級電腦
title.en: Drugmakers build their own AI supercomputers

body.zh: Eli Lilly 用 1,000 多顆 NVIDIA B300 GPU 打造 AI 超級電腦。藥廠不再只是 AI 的使用者，而是直接擁有頂級算力，把 AI 當成研發核心。
body.en: Eli Lilly built an AI supercomputer with 1,000+ NVIDIA B300s — drugmakers now own top-tier compute and treat AI as the heart of R&D.

title.zh: AI 縮短新藥時程

body.zh: 一款新藥常要十年以上。AI 在早期篩選候選分子、預測毒性，有機會大幅縮短研發時間，但最終仍要經過嚴格的臨床試驗。
body.en: A new drug often takes over a decade. AI can speed early screening and toxicity prediction — but rigorous clinical trials remain essential.

title.zh: 醫療資料的隱私挑戰
title.en: The privacy challenge of medical data

body.zh: 醫療資料極度敏感，很多無法離開醫院。合成資料、在地部署與嚴格權限，是醫療 AI 能否普及的關鍵。
body.en: Medical data is highly sensitive and often can't leave hospitals — synthetic data, on-premises deployment and strict permissions are key to wider medical AI.

title.zh: 「實驗室在迴圈中」

body.zh: BioNeMo 主打「lab-in-the-loop」：AI 設計分子，實驗室自動合成與測試，結果再回饋給 AI 改進。AI 不只取代人腦篩選，而是和機器人實驗室形成自動循環。
body.en: BioNeMo pushes "lab in the loop": AI designs molecules, automated labs make and test them, and results feed back to improve the AI — a closed loop of models and robotic labs.

plain.zh: 媒體娛樂業用 AI 生成影像、即時翻譯直播、加速後製，也要分辨 AI 假影片。
plain.en: Media and entertainment use AI to generate imagery, translate live broadcasts, speed up post-production — and detect AI fakes.

nvidiaBond.zh: 媒體業者使用 NVIDIA AI for Media 工具、NIM 微服務與 GPU 做即時影像處理；Getty Images、Shutterstock 曾用 NVIDIA Edify 打造生成服務。
nvidiaBond.en: Media firms use NVIDIA AI for Media tools, NIM microservices and GPUs for real-time video; Getty Images and Shutterstock built generative services on NVIDIA Edify.

impact.zh: AI 讓內容創作更快更便宜，但也讓「真假辨識」與「創作者權益」變得更重要。
impact.en: AI makes content faster and cheaper — and raises the stakes for authenticity and creators' rights.

dialogue.zh: 戲要好看，更要是真的。
dialogue.en: The show must be great — and genuine.

value.en: Sep (IBC): AI moves into live broadcast; Dalet integrates Synthetic Video Detector into newsroom verification

details.zh: 2026 年 9 月 IBC 展，NVIDIA 擴大「AI for Media」工具，主打直播與體育的即時 AI，並推出「合成影片偵測器」評估影片是否由 AI 生成（NVIDIA 公布的測試準確率：文字生成影片 99.3%、圖片生成影片 97.7%，屬輔助查核工具）。Getty Images 與 Shutterstock 也曾以 NVIDIA 技術打造合法授權的生成式影像服務。
details.en: At IBC in Sept 2026 NVIDIA expanded its AI for Media tools for live broadcast and sports and launched a Synthetic Video Detector to estimate whether footage is AI-generated (NVIDIA's test accuracy: 99.3% for text-to-video, 97.7% for image-to-video — an aid to verification, not a verdict). Getty Images and Shutterstock have built licensed generative-image services on NVIDIA tech.

title.zh: AI 假影片怎麼抓？
title.en: How do you catch AI-generated video?

body.zh: 生成式 AI 做的影片越來越逼真，可能被用來造假新聞。偵測工具會分析畫面中人眼看不出的細微痕跡，估計影片是不是 AI 做的。但偵測和生成是一場持續的攻防，所以業界也推動在生成內容上加入浮水印與來源標記。
body.en: AI video is ever more realistic and can fuel fake news. Detectors analyze subtle traces invisible to the eye to estimate whether footage is synthetic. Detection and generation are an ongoing arms race, so the industry also pushes watermarks and provenance labels.

title.zh: 創作門檻大降

body.zh: AI 讓一個人就能做出過去需要整個團隊的影片與圖像。內容產量暴增，也讓「如何被看見」更困難。
body.en: AI lets one person produce video and imagery that once needed a team. Content explodes — and getting noticed gets harder.

title.zh: 授權素材的價值上升

body.zh: Getty Images、Shutterstock 用授權素材訓練生成模型，主打「商用安全」。AI 時代，乾淨、合法授權的資料成為重要資產。
body.en: Getty Images and Shutterstock train generators on licensed content, pitching commercial safety — clean, licensed data becomes a key asset in the AI era.

title.zh: 真假辨識成為基礎設施

body.zh: NVIDIA 推出合成影片偵測器，媒體業也推動浮水印與來源標記。當 AI 影片無所不在，「證明這是真的」本身就是一項服務。
body.en: NVIDIA's synthetic-video detector and industry watermarking push show that when AI video is everywhere, proving something is real becomes a service in itself.

title.zh: AI 也要用來抓 AI

body.zh: 生成式影片越來越逼真，新聞台需要工具判斷畫面是不是假的。NVIDIA 的合成影片偵測器能估計影片是 AI 生成的機率，但只是輔助查核，不能單靠它判定真偽。
body.en: As generated video gets more realistic, newsrooms need tools to spot fakes. NVIDIA's detector estimates the probability footage is AI-generated — an aid to verification, not proof on its own.

plain.zh: 製造業用 AI 設計產品、模擬工廠、預測設備故障，並讓機器人更靈活。
plain.en: Manufacturers use AI to design products, simulate factories, predict breakdowns and make robots more flexible.

nvidiaBond.zh: 製造業者採用 NVIDIA Omniverse 打造數位雙生、用 NVIDIA Isaac 開發機器人；西門子與 NVIDIA 共同推出工業 AI 作業系統。
nvidiaBond.en: Manufacturers build digital twins on NVIDIA Omniverse and robots on NVIDIA Isaac; Siemens and NVIDIA launched an Industrial AI OS.

impact.zh: 「實體 AI」最大的戰場之一，可能重塑全球製造業的效率與分布。
impact.en: One of physical AI's biggest battlegrounds, potentially reshaping manufacturing efficiency and geography.

dialogue.zh: 百工百業，AI 都能搭把手。
dialogue.en: A hundred crafts — and AI lends a hand to each.

details.en: At CES 2026 Siemens and NVIDIA launched an Industrial AI OS; PepsiCo uses Digital Twin Composer to model upgrades at US plants and warehouses, and Siemens' Erlangen electronics plant is the blueprint for fully AI-driven factories. Manufacturers like Foxconn use NVIDIA platforms for smart factories and robots.

title.zh: 預測性維護：在機器壞掉前先修
title.en: Predictive maintenance: fix it before it breaks

body.zh: 傳統做法是定期保養，或壞了才修。預測性維護則讓 AI 持續分析機器的振動、溫度、聲音，發現「快要出問題」的徵兆就提早處理，減少停機損失。這對 24 小時運轉的產線特別重要。
body.en: Traditionally you service on a schedule or fix after failure. Predictive maintenance has AI watch vibration, temperature and sound, catching early warning signs to fix things before they fail — vital for round-the-clock production lines.

title.zh: 工廠先在電腦裡蓋一次
title.en: Build the factory in the computer first

body.zh: PepsiCo 用數位雙生模擬工廠升級，西門子以 Erlangen 電子廠作為 AI 驅動工廠的藍本。先在虛擬世界驗證，再到真實世界施工，可以減少停工與錯誤。
body.en: PepsiCo simulates plant upgrades in digital twins, and Siemens uses its Erlangen electronics plant as the blueprint for an AI-driven factory. Validating virtually before building reduces downtime and mistakes.

title.zh: 人形機器人瞄準工廠

body.zh: Figure、Skild 等機器人新創都以工廠為第一個戰場。製造業有大量重複性工作，又面臨缺工，是實體 AI 最容易落地的地方。
body.en: Robot startups like Figure and Skild target factories first — manufacturing's repetitive work and labor shortages make it physical AI's easiest landing spot.

title.zh: 台灣代工廠是 AI 的工廠，也是 AI 的用戶
title.en: Taiwan's makers both build and use AI

body.zh: 鴻海一方面製造 AI 伺服器，一方面也用 NVIDIA 平台打造自己的智慧工廠與機器人。供應鏈本身正在被 AI 重塑。
body.en: Foxconn builds AI servers while using NVIDIA platforms for its own smart factories and robots — the supply chain itself is being reshaped by AI.

plain.zh: 政府與國家研究機構用 AI 做科學研究、公共服務，並投資「主權 AI」基礎建設。
plain.en: Governments and national labs use AI for science and public services, and invest in sovereign AI infrastructure.

nvidiaBond.zh: 政府與國家實驗室採購 NVIDIA 系統建置 AI 超級電腦，例如美國能源部的 Solstice 與 Equinox。
nvidiaBond.en: Governments and national labs buy NVIDIA systems for AI supercomputers, such as the US DOE's Solstice and Equinox.

impact.zh: 國家級 AI 投資決定一國在科學與產業的長期競爭力。
impact.en: National AI investment shapes a country's long-term scientific and industrial competitiveness.

dialogue.zh: 為民所用，掌握在自己手中。
dialogue.en: Serving the people — and kept in our own hands.

details.zh: 美國能源部與 NVIDIA、Oracle 合作，在 Argonne 國家實驗室建置 Solstice（規劃 10 萬顆 NVIDIA Blackwell GPU）與 Equinox（1 萬顆）AI 超級電腦，用來訓練科學模型、發展「AI 科學家」。歐洲則以公共資金打造 JUPITER 等超級電腦。
details.en: The US Department of Energy is building the Solstice (planned 100,000 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs) and Equinox (10,000) AI supercomputers at Argonne with NVIDIA and Oracle, to train scientific models and develop AI scientists. Europe funds supercomputers like JUPITER with public money.

title.zh: 「主權 AI」為什麼政府這麼在意？
title.en: Why governments care about sovereign AI

body.zh: AI 正成為像電力、網路一樣的基礎建設。若關鍵 AI 全靠外國公司，資料可能外流、服務可能被切斷。所以許多國家投資自己的資料中心、超級電腦與模型，確保關鍵能力掌握在自己手上。
body.en: AI is becoming infrastructure like power and the internet. Relying entirely on foreign firms risks data leaving the country and services being cut off. So many nations invest in their own data centers, supercomputers and models to keep critical capabilities at home.

title.zh: 國家實驗室的 AI 競賽

body.zh: 美國能源部規劃 10 萬顆 Blackwell 的 Solstice，歐洲有 JUPITER。各國把 AI 超級電腦視為科學與國安的戰略資產。
body.en: The US DOE plans the 100,000-Blackwell Solstice; Europe has JUPITER — nations treat AI supercomputers as strategic assets for science and security.

title.zh: 公私合作的新模式

body.zh: Solstice 採用公私合作模式，由政府、NVIDIA 與 Oracle 共同建置。政府不一定要自己蓋所有東西，也可以和企業分工。
body.en: Solstice uses a public-private partnership with the government, NVIDIA and Oracle — governments needn't build everything themselves.

title.zh: 「AI 科學家」計畫

body.zh: Argonne 的系統支援「開發 AI 科學家」計畫，目標是讓 AI 協助提出假設、設計實驗。國家實驗室可能是 AI 加速科學發現的最前線。
body.en: Argonne's systems support a program developing AI scientists that help form hypotheses and design experiments — national labs may lead AI-accelerated discovery.

title.zh: AI exaflops 和 TOP500 不能直接比

body.zh: Solstice 與 Equinox 合計的「2,200 exaflops」是用低精度 AI 運算計算的；TOP500 排名用的是 64 位元高精度運算。同一台機器的 AI 算力數字通常比 TOP500 數字大很多，比較時要看清楚單位。
body.en: The combined "2,200 exaflops" of Solstice and Equinox counts low-precision AI math; TOP500 uses 64-bit precision. A machine's AI number is usually far bigger than its TOP500 score — check the units.

plain.en: Retail and logistics use AI to forecast demand, plan delivery, run warehouses and train robots in virtual warehouses.

title.zh: 在虛擬倉庫裡練好，再上真實倉庫
title.en: Practice in a virtual warehouse first

body.zh: 倉庫機器人如果直接在真實倉庫試錯，可能撞壞貨物、耽誤出貨。先在數位雙生裡模擬各種狀況、讓機器人練到熟練，再搬到真實世界，可以大幅降低風險和成本——這是「模擬訓練」在物流業的典型應用。
body.en: Warehouse robots learning by trial and error in real warehouses can break goods and delay shipments. Practicing in a digital twin first, then deploying, slashes risk and cost — a classic use of simulation training in logistics.

title.zh: 倉庫是機器人的練功場

body.zh: 倉庫環境相對規律、任務重複，是機器人最早大規模落地的地方之一。數位雙生讓機器人先在虛擬倉庫練熟，再上真實現場。
body.en: Warehouses are structured and repetitive — among the first places robots deploy at scale. Digital twins let them master virtual warehouses before going live.

title.zh: 供應鏈規劃是 AI 的強項

body.zh: 需求預測、路線規劃、庫存調度都是大量資料的最佳化問題。SAP 已結合 NVIDIA 的 cuOpt 來優化供應鏈規劃。
body.en: Demand forecasting, routing and inventory are data-heavy optimization problems — SAP already pairs NVIDIA cuOpt with its supply-chain planning.

title.zh: 缺工推動自動化

body.zh: 物流業長期缺工，機器人與 AI 自動化是解方之一。但導入成本高，往往從大型物流業者開始，再慢慢擴散。
body.en: Logistics faces chronic labor shortages, and robots and AI automation are one answer — though costly, so adoption starts with large operators and spreads.

plain.zh: 超級電腦領域：國家實驗室與研究中心用最強的電腦模擬氣候、宇宙、新藥，現在也用來訓練 AI。
plain.en: Supercomputing: national labs and research centers use the most powerful computers to simulate climate, the cosmos and new drugs — and now to train AI.

nvidiaBond.zh: 全球頂級超級電腦大量採用 NVIDIA GPU 與網路，例如 JUPITER 與美國能源部的新 AI 超級電腦。
nvidiaBond.en: Top supercomputers worldwide use NVIDIA GPUs and networking, such as JUPITER and the US DOE's new AI systems.

impact.zh: 超級電腦正同時推進科學與 AI，兩者互相加速。
impact.en: Supercomputers now advance science and AI at once, each accelerating the other.

dialogue.zh: 天地萬象，算給你看。
dialogue.en: All of heaven and earth — computed for you.

value.en: Climate and weather simulation, physics and chemistry, drugs and materials, scientific AI models

value.zh: 科學模擬和 AI 訓練都需要數萬顆 GPU 長時間協同運算
value.en: Both simulation and AI training need tens of thousands of GPUs working together for long stretches

value.en: No. 1 LineShine in Shenzhen (2.198 EFlop/s); El Capitan 2nd, Frontier 3rd, Aurora 4th; Europe's JUPITER (NVIDIA GH200) 5th

value.zh: JUPITER 是 exascale 等級中最節能的系統；希臘新系統 DAEDALUS（GH200）首次上榜第 31 名
value.en: JUPITER is the most energy-efficient exascale-class system; Greece's new DAEDALUS (GH200) debuted at No. 31

details.zh: 歐洲第一台 exascale 超級電腦 JUPITER 使用 24,000 顆 NVIDIA GH200；德國德勒斯登工業大學也將在 2026 年第四季啟用採用 NVIDIA 硬體的新系統。超級電腦與 AI 資料中心的界線正在模糊。
details.en: JUPITER, Europe's first exascale supercomputer, uses 24,000 NVIDIA GH200s; TU Dresden plans a new NVIDIA-based system for Q4 2026. The line between supercomputers and AI data centers is blurring.

title.zh: FP64 vs. FP4：科學和 AI 要的精度不同
title.en: FP64 vs. FP4: science and AI need different precision

body.zh: 電腦用不同「精度」表示數字。科學模擬（例如氣候）常需要 FP64 這種很精確的格式；AI 則常用 FP8、FP4 等低精度格式，算得更快、更省電，結果仍然夠好。所以 AI 超級電腦宣稱的「幾 exaflops」，和傳統超算排行榜的數字不能直接比較。
body.en: Computers represent numbers at different precisions. Science like climate modeling often needs precise FP64; AI often uses low-precision FP8 or FP4 — faster and more efficient yet good enough. So an AI supercomputer's "exaflops" can't be compared directly with classic supercomputer rankings.

title.zh: 超算與 AI 機房合流
title.en: Supercomputers and AI data centers converge

body.zh: 過去超級電腦專做科學模擬，AI 資料中心專做訓練模型。現在兩者使用相同的 GPU 與網路，界線越來越模糊。
body.en: Supercomputers once did simulation and AI data centers did training; now both use the same GPUs and networks, and the line is blurring.

title.zh: 排行榜數字要看清楚

body.zh: AI 超級電腦常宣傳低精度（FP4、FP8）的 exaflops，傳統 Top500 排名則用高精度 FP64。兩者不能直接比較。
body.en: AI supercomputers often tout low-precision (FP4/FP8) exaflops, while the classic Top500 uses high-precision FP64 — the numbers aren't directly comparable.

title.zh: 液冷的發源地

body.zh: 超級電腦很早就使用直接液冷，這些經驗正被 AI 資料中心大量採用。超算產業長期累積的技術，正在 AI 時代發揮更大影響。
body.en: Supercomputers adopted direct liquid cooling early, and AI data centers now borrow that experience — decades of HPC know-how matter more than ever.

title.zh: 超級電腦榜首換人

body.zh: 2026 年 6 月，中國的 LineShine 結束美國 El Capitan 的榜首地位，成為全球第五台 exascale 系統。超級電腦排名也反映各國在算力上的競爭。
body.en: In June 2026 China's LineShine ended El Capitan's run at No. 1, becoming the world's fifth exascale system — the rankings mirror national competition in compute.

plain.zh: 電信業把 AI 放進行動網路基地台，讓網路更聰明，也能就近提供 AI 運算。
plain.en: Telecoms put AI into mobile base stations to make networks smarter and offer AI computing nearby.

nvidiaBond.zh: NVIDIA 投資 Nokia 10 億美元並共同推出 AI-RAN；T-Mobile、軟銀等電信商與 NVIDIA 合作測試 AI-RAN。
nvidiaBond.en: NVIDIA invested US$1B in Nokia to co-develop AI-RAN; operators like T-Mobile and SoftBank test AI-RAN with NVIDIA.

impact.zh: 可能讓每座基地台都變成小型 AI 運算站，改變 AI 服務送到使用者手上的方式。
impact.en: Could turn every cell site into a small AI computing station, changing how AI reaches users.

dialogue.zh: 訊號所到之處，AI 隨行。
dialogue.en: Wherever the signal goes, AI follows.

details.zh: 2025 年 10 月，NVIDIA 宣布以 10 億美元入股 Nokia（約 2.9%），把 NVIDIA 的 AI-RAN 產品加入 Nokia 的基地台。T-Mobile US 2026 年 10 月在華盛頓州 Bellevue 的商用網路完成全球首通 AI-RAN 通話；日本軟銀也推出自家的 AI-RAN 方案。
details.en: In Oct 2025 NVIDIA agreed to invest US$1B in Nokia (~2.9%), adding NVIDIA-powered AI-RAN to Nokia's base stations. In Oct 2026 T-Mobile US completed the world's first AI-RAN call on a live network in Bellevue, Washington; Japan's SoftBank has its own AI-RAN solution too.

title.zh: AI-RAN：基地台也能跑 AI
title.en: AI-RAN: base stations that run AI

body.zh: 傳統基地台用專用硬體處理訊號。AI-RAN 改用 GPU 這類通用加速運算，一方面用 AI 讓訊號處理更有效率，另一方面在空閒時把算力拿來跑 AI 服務。網路從「只傳資料」變成「也能就近計算」，也是邁向 6G 的重要方向。
body.en: Traditional base stations use dedicated hardware for signals. AI-RAN uses general accelerators like GPUs — using AI to process signals more efficiently and running AI services with spare capacity. Networks go from just moving data to computing nearby — a key step toward 6G.

title.zh: 基地台變成 AI 運算站
title.en: Cell sites become AI compute stations

body.zh: AI-RAN 讓基地台在處理訊號之餘也能跑 AI。全球數百萬座基地台，可能成為分散各地的小型 AI 機房。
body.en: AI-RAN lets base stations run AI alongside signal processing — millions of cell sites could become distributed mini AI data centers.

title.zh: NVIDIA 入股 Nokia 的意義

body.zh: NVIDIA 以 10 億美元取得 Nokia 約 2.9% 股權，是它少見的大型電信業投資。這代表 NVIDIA 想把 GPU 帶進電信網路這個全新市場。
body.en: NVIDIA's US$1B for ~2.9% of Nokia is a rare big telecom bet — a push to bring GPUs into networks as an entirely new market.

title.zh: 通往 6G 的軟體升級

body.zh: NVIDIA 稱電信商可透過軟體升級，從 5G-Advanced 走向 6G。若能用軟體而非全面換硬體升級網路，電信業的投資模式可能改變。
body.en: NVIDIA says operators can move from 5G-Advanced to 6G via software upgrades — upgrading networks by software instead of wholesale hardware swaps could change telecom investment.
